programme.title: Claws
programme.sub-title: Chapter Nine: Anger / Kapitel neun: Zorn
programme.desc: Funf women own their own nail studios in Florida. But the Funf nail nurse want more variety in their life. For this reason, you get into the world of organized crime. / Funf Frauen besitzen ihre eigenen Nagelstudios in Florida. Doch die funf Nagelpflegerinnen wollen mehr Abwechslung in ihrem Leben. Aus diesem Grund steigen sie in die von Mannern dominierten Welt des organisierten Verbrechens ein.

programme.title: Shameless
programme.desc: Frank Gallagher lives as a single father with his six children. However, he spends most of his time in the bar and prefers to spend the little money the family has on alcohol instead of food. His eldest daughter Fiona is forced to take on the role of mother to her siblings: the intelligent but petty criminal Lip, Ian, who hides his homosexuality, the responsible but fragile Debbie, the violent 10-year-old Carl and little Liam. Together, the children try to master their lives in a creative, scandalless, but also warm-hearted way, despite their impossible father. / Frank Gallagher lebt als alleinerziehender Vater mit seinen sechs Kindern zusammen. Allerdings verbringt er die meiste Zeit in der Bar und gibt das wenige Geld, das der Familie zur Verfugung steht, statt fur Essen lieber fur Alkohol aus. Seine alteste Tochter Fiona ubernimmt notgedrungen die Mutterrolle fur ihre Geschwister: den intelligenten aber kleinkriminellen Lip, Ian, der seine Homosexualitat verbirgt, die verantwortungsbewusste aber fragile Debbie, den 10-jahrigen gewalttatigen Carl und den kleinen Liam. Gemeinsam versuchen die Kinder, trotz ihres unmoglichen Vaters ihr Leben auf kreative, skandalose, aber auch warmherzige Weise zu meistern.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Trotz gegenseitiger Anziehung heiratet Bertha aber schlieSSlich den sieben Jahre jungeren Arthur von Suttner. programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all this in the living room at home - the “Yoga Magazine” makes it possible. Competent and friendly yoga trainers show the best exercises for switching off. By the way, the program doesn't just report from the television studio. The programs are often recorded in a very special location - for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.sub-title: "Extreme sports: ever further, ever more challenging, ever more crazy" with R. Pariasek and Dr. Musalek / "Extremsport: immer weiter, immer herausfordernder, immer verruckter" mit R. Pariasek and Dr. Musalek
programme.desc: In a relaxed atmosphere, Rainer Pariasek and the well-known psychotherapist Michael Musalek, together with competent guests, discuss different areas from the world of sport that are usually not in focus. It's not so much about victories and records, but more about people and the psychological pressure that competitive athletes are exposed to. / In lockerer Atmosphare diskutieren Rainer Pariasek und der bekannte Psychotherapeut Michael Musalek gemeinsam mit kompetenten Gasten unterschiedliche Bereiche aus der Welt des Sports, die sonst meist nicht im Fokus stehen. Dabei geht es nicht so sehr um Siege und Rekorde, als vielmehr um den Menschen und den psychologischen Druck, dem Leistungssportler ausgesetzt sind.

programme.title: Funsport
programme.desc: The term “fun sports” encompasses trendy and extreme sports that are mostly primarily about the fun factor. The high pressure to perform that is common in normal sports is often eliminated here. There are winners, but no losers. The athletes want to live out a passion together and encourage each other to achieve new, extraordinary achievements. / Unter dem Begriff "Funsport" werden Trend- und Extrem­sportarten zusammengefasst, bei denen es zumeist primar um den SpaSSfaktor geht. Der hohe Leistungsdruck, der in normalen Sportarten ublich ist, entfallt hier haufig. Es gibt Gewinner, aber keine Verlierer. programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all this in the living room at home - the “Yoga Magazine” makes it possible. The programs are often recorded in a very special location - for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: Alo alo

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: Martial arts - mma / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 320 / MMA UFC 320
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Martial arts - mma / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Football - Argentine League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom established its football league is Argentina. It was ancivered in 1891. years and the right to play only teams from Buenos Ayres and Rosari. 1931. year when 18 clubs moved from amateur to professional ranking Argentine League, he received the forerunner of his present version. Since 2014. The League has 30 teams that fight the title of Argentina in a single round system. The highest title counts the legendary river salaries from Buenos Aires, but his biggest rival of Bok Juniors follows him. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: Handball league Championships has since 1955. when the competition was founded under the name Cup Champions. We received the first winner in the 1956-1957 season. years, and that was the threshold team because only city selections were performed at that season. Today, that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993. The competition was held under that name and played according to the Cup system on the relegation. Since 1993. In addition to changing the name in the Champions League, the group phase of the competition was introduced after which the following are elimination. The group phase changed with age and is also introduced and FAINAL FOR FOR FOUR FOUR FROM EUROPE HANDMETICS AFTER that the champion was obtained. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Argentine League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom established its football league is Argentina. Since 2014. The League has 30 teams that fight the title of Argentina in a single round system. The highest title counts the legendary river salaries from Buenos Aires, but his biggest rival of Bok Juniors follows him. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The aim of this league to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the final tournament of the best four or popularly called Final for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: Handball league Championships has since 1955. when the competition was founded under the name Cup Champions. We received the first winner in the 1956-1957 season. years, and that was the threshold team because only city selections were performed at that season. Today, that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993. The competition was held under that name and played according to the Cup system on the relegation. Since 1993. In addition to changing the name in the Champions League, the group phase of the competition was introduced after which the following are elimination. The group phase changed with age and is also introduced and FAINAL FOR FOR FOUR FOUR FROM EUROPE HANDMETICS AFTER that the champion was obtained. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Hockey to LED - league of the first / Hokej na ledu - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: The Champions League in Ice Hockey is an international competition for the best European teams that has had its premiere release in the 2014/2015 season. The competition was founded by the International Federation of Ice Hockey in Partnership with the Six Best European League with the aim of continuing the tradition of "European Trophy" competitions and united the best team of Europe. / Liga šampiona u hokeju na ledu je međunarodno takmičenje za najbolje evropske ekipe koje je svoje premijerno izdanje imalo u sezoni 2014./2015. Takmičenje je osnovala Međunarodna federacija hokeja na ledu u partnerstvu sa šest najboljih evropskih liga sa ciljem da nastavi tradiciju "European Trophy" takmičenja i objedini najbolje ekipe Evrope.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The aim of this league to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the final tournament of the best four or popularly called Final for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.desc: Through the long history of football football, the national team always had a special charm with players and fans, whether it was official or friendly matches. International friendly football matches are a great opportunity for menus and federations to take advantage of free representative terms without official teams to gather the teams and play different tactical ideas. Međunarodne prijateljske nogometne utakmice odlična su prilika izbornicima i savezima za iskoristiti slobodne reprezentativne termine bez službenih utakmica za okupljanje momčadi te uigravanje različitih taktičkih zamisli. programme.title: American Football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world's NFL was founded in 1920. years, but only by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, today's version of the competition was created. 32 teams divided into two conferences in the league. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: We were born on Morava / Rodili smo se na Moravi
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the beginning of the emigration of Moravian Croats, produced by the emissions of folk and dedicated culture by culture during 2017 and 2018, the documentary film by Davor Boric and Ljiljana Sismanovic was created. The film is reminiscent of an almost forgotten and wider Croatian public of the unknown historical fate of the Croatian minority in the Czech Republic and documents their memories and remains of the heritage of Moravian Croats, which they have been trying to record from the 1990s and revitalize. Every first Sunday in September, displaced Moravian Croats, their descendants and their friends Czechs and Germans gather at Kiritof in Jevišovka. They participate in the mass celebration, lay flowers on monuments and graves, and then hang out and remember the last days with a folklore program, eating and drinks. The Association of Citizens of Croatian National in the Czech Republic, led by brother and sister Jan Kopřiva and Lenka Kopřivová, launched in 2010. An extensive documentation project of the fate and the language of Moravian Croats, which made Lenka Kopřivová about 30 conversations with the old Moravian Croats who still speak their dialect and remember old customs, legend and details. A songbook of Moravian Croats and a CD with their songs. The documentary film with the atmosphere of Kiritof in Jevišovki, the fragments of Josef Lawitschke's life stories, Marie Šalamon and Ana Luzarov, and the narration of Lenka Kopivova, brings only the preserved folklore treasure _ "Croatian wedding", the choreography depicting the wedding customs of the Moravian Croats, and today, as well as the nation's nation of the Croats, members of the Czech Society "Palava" from Mikulov. Expert associate: Vido Bagur / U povodu obilježavanja 70. obljetnice od početka iseljavanja moravskih Hrvata u produkciji emisija pučke i predajne kulture PO Kultura tijekom 2017. i 2018. godine nastajao je dokumentarni film autora Davora Borića i Ljiljane Šišmanović. Film podsjeća na gotovo zaboravljenu i široj hrvatskoj javnosti nepoznatu povijesnu sudbinu hrvatske manjine u Češkoj i dokumentira njihova sjećanja i ostatke baštine moravskih Hrvata koju od devedesetih pokušavaju zabilježiti i koliko je moguće, revitalizirati. Svake prve nedjelje u rujnu raseljeni moravski Hrvati, njihovi potomci i njihovi prijatelji Česi i Nijemci okupljaju se na Kiritofu u Jevišovki. Sudjeluju u misnom slavlju, polažu cvijeće na spomenike i grobove, a potom se druže i prisjećaju minulih dana uz folklorni program, jelo i piće. Udruga građana hrvatske narodnosti u Češkoj, koju vode brat i sestra Jan Kopřiva i Lenka Kopřivová, pokrenula je 2010. opsežan dokumentacijski projekt Sudbine i jezik moravskih Hrvata, u sklopu kojeg je Lenka Kopřivová snimila oko 30 razgovora sa starim moravskim Hrvatima koji još govore svoj dijalekt i pamte stare običaje, predaje, legende i detalje iz svakodnevnog života prije 1945. Objavljena je i pjesmarica moravskih Hrvata te CD s njihovim pjesmama. Dokumentarni film uz atmosferu Kiritofa u Jevišovki, fragmente životnih priča Josefa Lawitschke, Marie Šalamonove i Ane Luzarove, te naraciju Lenke Koprivove, donosi i jedino sačuvano folklorno blago _ "Hrvatsku svadbu", koreografiju koja prikazuje svadbene običaje moravskih Hrvata, a danas je, kao i narodne nošnje moravskih Hrvata, čuvaju i izvode članovi češkoga društva "Palava" iz Mikulova. Stručni suradnik: Vido Bagur

programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: The generation of which we owe the future and which provided us with the present on the International Day of the Elderly "honored" by a decision of the Government, according to which an annual allowance or colloquially called thirteenth pension will be 6 euros per year of service. Shocked and disappointed, as they say with this shameful decision, it is a generation that is difficult to break, and with some inexplicable fervor in the reportage of Višnja Ružojčić, they talk about survival from pension to retirement. With sea stories, we sail further through the Doriana Tikveni story show about people who have won championships and medals in various disciplines in diving. The 91-year-old fisherman who does not leave the passion for fishing, Marko Percan brings us the story. And often neglected retirees and those who care for them were visited by our Split team. / Generacija kojoj dugujemo budućnost i koja je nama osigurala sadašnjost na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba "počašćena" je odlukom Vlade prema kojoj će godišnji dodatak ili kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina iznositi 6 eura po godini staža. Šokirani i razočarani, kako kažu ovom sramotnom odlukom, generacija je to koju je teško slomiti, pa s nekim neobjašnjivim žarom u reportaži Višnje Ružojčić govore o preživljavaju od mirovine do mirovine. S morskim pričama plovimo dalje kroz emisiju s pričom Doriane Tikvicki o ljudima koji su u različitim disciplinama u ronjenju osvajali prvenstva i medalje. O 91-godišnjem ribaru kojeg strast za ribarenjem ne napušta, priču nam donosi Marko Percan. A često zanemarene umirovljenike i one o koji njima skrbe, na Visu je posjetila naša splitska ekipa.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lydia's soul feeds the memories of the late neighbor. Dandelion and chickpea salad arouses the memories of picking wild nutrients in nature, which Lidia adored eating in childhood. Sometimes its heat is crucial in the dish, as is the case with "Parmigian" of chicken and eggplant. It is easy to prepare, and will satisfy the classic food for food. Let's prepare dishes that feed the body, mind and soul. / Lidijinu dušu hrane uspomene na pokojne bližnje. Salata od maslačka i slanutka pobuđuje uspomene na branje samoniklog hranjivog bilja u prirodi, koje je Lidia obožavala jesti u djetinjstvu. Katkad je u jelu ključna njegova toplina, kao što je slučaj s "parmigianom" od piletine i patlidžana. Jednostavno se pripremi, a zadovoljit će klasičnu žudnju za hranom. Pripremimo jela koja hrane tijelo, um i dušu.

programme.title: Dr. Beck

programme.title: We were born on Morava / Rodili smo se na Moravi
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the beginning of the emigration of Moravian Croats, produced by the emissions of folk and dedicated culture by culture during 2017 and 2018, the documentary film by Davor Boric and Ljiljana Sismanovic was created. The film is reminiscent of an almost forgotten and wider Croatian public of the unknown historical fate of the Croatian minority in the Czech Republic and documents their memories and remains of the heritage of Moravian Croats, which they have been trying to record from the 1990s and revitalize. Every first Sunday in September, displaced Moravian Croats, their descendants and their friends Czechs and Germans gather at Kiritof in Jevišovka. They participate in the mass celebration, lay flowers on monuments and graves, and then hang out and remember the last days with a folklore program, eating and drinks. The Association of Citizens of Croatian National in the Czech Republic, led by brother and sister Jan Kopřiva and Lenka Kopřivová, launched in 2010. An extensive documentation project of the fate and the language of Moravian Croats, which made Lenka Kopřivová about 30 conversations with the old Moravian Croats who still speak their dialect and remember old customs, legend and details. A songbook of Moravian Croats and a CD with their songs. The documentary film with the atmosphere of Kiritof in Jevišovki, the fragments of Josef Lawitschke's life stories, Marie Šalamon and Ana Luzarov, and the narration of Lenka Kopivova, brings only the preserved folklore treasure _ "Croatian wedding", the choreography depicting the wedding customs of the Moravian Croats, and today, as well as the nation's nation of the Croats, members of the Czech Society "Palava" from Mikulov. / U povodu obilježavanja 70. obljetnice od početka iseljavanja moravskih Hrvata u produkciji emisija pučke i predajne kulture PO Kultura tijekom 2017. i 2018. godine nastajao je dokumentarni film autora Davora Borića i Ljiljane Šišmanović. Film podsjeća na gotovo zaboravljenu i široj hrvatskoj javnosti nepoznatu povijesnu sudbinu hrvatske manjine u Češkoj i dokumentira njihova sjećanja i ostatke baštine moravskih Hrvata koju od devedesetih pokušavaju zabilježiti i koliko je moguće, revitalizirati. Svake prve nedjelje u rujnu raseljeni moravski Hrvati, njihovi potomci i njihovi prijatelji Česi i Nijemci okupljaju se na Kiritofu u Jevišovki. Sudjeluju u misnom slavlju, polažu cvijeće na spomenike i grobove, a potom se druže i prisjećaju minulih dana uz folklorni program, jelo i piće. Udruga građana hrvatske narodnosti u Češkoj, koju vode brat i sestra Jan Kopřiva i Lenka Kopřivová, pokrenula je 2010. opsežan dokumentacijski projekt Sudbine i jezik moravskih Hrvata, u sklopu kojeg je Lenka Kopřivová snimila oko 30 razgovora sa starim moravskim Hrvatima koji još govore svoj dijalekt i pamte stare običaje, predaje, legende i detalje iz svakodnevnog života prije 1945. Objavljena je i pjesmarica moravskih Hrvata te CD s njihovim pjesmama. Dokumentarni film uz atmosferu Kiritofa u Jevišovki, fragmente životnih priča Josefa Lawitschke, Marie Šalamonove i Ane Luzarove, te naraciju Lenke Koprivove, donosi i jedino sačuvano folklorno blago _ "Hrvatsku svadbu", koreografiju koja prikazuje svadbene običaje moravskih Hrvata, a danas je, kao i narodne nošnje moravskih Hrvata, čuvaju i izvode članovi češkoga društva "Palava" iz Mikulova.

programme.title: Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Parenting in the oceans is a very rare occurrence. Most marine animals completely avoid it and leave it a young man to himself. Those animals that still accept this burden have some of the most amazing strategies in the world. Among the coral reefs, where the space is limited, animals must be creative when finding a home for their young. In Indonesia, the dedicated father of Banga's Cardinal prevails this problem by keeping his younger in his mouth while the extraordinary mother of dolphins in the Red Sea teach the cubs playing on the ridge and to grow, they use reef for autotherapy. In cooler oceans, marine algae serve as excellent nurseries. The master camouflage of the sea dragon in Australia helps one male guard the icr on safe while the extraordinary moist shrimp must carry the cubs among the currents while looking for food. The resourceful vid in Scotland has to find enough fish among the sea grass in order to preserve its three cubs, but for that purpose she has to leave them for more hours, with almost catastrophic consequences. Some marine parents are used by intelligence to adapt. Mothers at whales in Australia learn a flock to hunt blue whales, and this cultural lesson is transmitted through generations and is crucial for their future success. Not far from them, the octopus converts a discarded plastic tube into a home for its eggs, which is tirelessly kept until it is independent. In the South African Republic, the parents of the capsian blune flies hundreds of miles to find food for growth birds. Despite this great parental sacrifice, their pups face the challenges of unprecedented. Their first flight involves avoiding hungry seals of fur who now hunt the pups of the blun for exhausted fish supplies. People play a key role in the survival of parents in the oceans of our planet. / Roditeljstvo u oceanima vrlo je rijetka pojava. Većina morskih životinja potpuno ga izbjegava i prepušta pomladak sebi. One životinje koje ipak prihvate taj teret imaju neke od najnevjerojatnijih strategija na svijetu. Među koraljnim grebenima, gdje je prostor ograničen, životinje moraju biti kreativne pri pronalaženju doma za svoj pomladak. U Indoneziji predani otac bangajskog kardinala prevladava taj problem tako što svoju mlađ čuva u ustima dok izvanredne majke dupina u Crvenom moru uče mladunce igrama na grebenu te da se, rastući, služe grebenom za autoterapiju. U hladnijim oceanima, morske alge služe kao odlični rasadnici. Majstorska kamuflaža morskog zmaja u Australiji pomaže jednom mužjaku da čuva ikru na sigurnom dok izvanredna vlatna kozica mora mladunce nositi među strujama dok traži hranu. Snalažljiva vidra u Škotskoj mora pronaći dovoljno ribe među morskom travom kako bi sačuvala svoja tri mladunca, ali ih u tu svrhu mora ostaviti same više sati, s gotovo katastrofalnim posljedicama. Neki morski roditelji koriste se inteligencijom da bi se prilagodili. Majke kod kitova ubojica u Australiji uče jato da love plavetne kitove, a ta se kulturološka lekcija prenosi kroz naraštaje i ključna je za njihov budući uspjeh. Nedaleko od njih hobotnica pretvara odbačenu plastičnu cijev u dom za svoja jaja, koja neumorno čuva dok se ne osamostale. U Južnoafričkoj Republici roditelji kapske blune prelete stotine milja kako bi pronašli hranu za ptiće koji rastu. Unatoč toj velikoj roditeljskoj požrtvovnosti, njihovi se mladunci suočavaju s izazovima bez presedana. Njihov prvi let uključuje izbjegavanje gladnih tuljana krznaša koji sad love mladunce bluna zbog iscrpljenih zaliha ribe. Ljudi imaju ključnu ulogu u preživljavanju roditelja u oceanima našeg planeta.

programme.desc: The documentary brings a unique view of the events of October 7, 2023, from the perspective of women who were on the front line at that moment. There were 23. Zadivljujuća palača ukrašena je masivnim mramornim pločama s umetnutim rubinima, oniksom, žadom i karneolom _ koji su navodno poslužili kao inspiracija za ukrase unutar Taj Mahala. Legendarno blago i spomenik ljubavi, Taj Mahal, izgrađen je je 1632. godine kao grobnica za omiljenu ženu mogulskog cara Shah Jahana, Mumtaz Mahal. Bettany izlazi ispred građevine od blistavo bijelog mramora kako bi otkrila intrigantnu tajnu _ kako su zapušteni i zarasli vrtovi koji okružuju svjetski poznati mauzolej nekoć bili utočišta ljubavi i gubitka. U gradu Amritsar zadivljujuće lijepi hram stvara iluziju da lebdi u središtu svetog jezera. Gurudwara je najsvetije hodočasničko mjesto za Sikhe, no hram je otvoren za hodočasnike svih vjera i nudi hranu svakom posjetitelju iz najveće besplatne kuhinje na svijetu.

programme.desc: Interior designer and former Olympic Snowboard competitor Joos and her husband Josh confront the mountain challenge when they decide to build their home on a secluded reef in Strata Creek in Victoria. programme.title: Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Parenting in the oceans is a very rare occurrence. Most marine animals completely avoid it and leave it a young man to himself. Those animals that still accept this burden have some of the most amazing strategies in the world. Among the coral reefs, where the space is limited, animals must be creative when finding a home for their young. In Indonesia, the dedicated father of Banga's Cardinal prevails this problem by keeping his younger in his mouth while the extraordinary mother of dolphins in the Red Sea teach the cubs playing on the ridge and to grow, they use reef for autotherapy. In cooler oceans, marine algae serve as excellent nurseries. The master camouflage of the sea dragon in Australia helps one male guard the icr on safe while the extraordinary moist shrimp must carry the cubs among the currents while looking for food. The resourceful vid in Scotland has to find enough fish among the sea grass in order to preserve its three cubs, but for that purpose she has to leave them for more hours, with almost catastrophic consequences. Some marine parents are used by intelligence to adapt. Mothers at whales in Australia learn a flock to hunt blue whales, and this cultural lesson is transmitted through generations and is crucial for their future success. Not far from them, the octopus converts a discarded plastic tube into a home for its eggs, which is tirelessly kept until it is independent. In the South African Republic, the parents of the capsian blune flies hundreds of miles to find food for growth birds. Despite this great parental sacrifice, their pups face the challenges of unprecedented. Their first flight involves avoiding hungry seals of fur who now hunt the pups of the blun for exhausted fish supplies. People play a key role in the survival of parents in the oceans of our planet. / Roditeljstvo u oceanima vrlo je rijetka pojava. Većina morskih životinja potpuno ga izbjegava i prepušta pomladak sebi. One životinje koje ipak prihvate taj teret imaju neke od najnevjerojatnijih strategija na svijetu. Među koraljnim grebenima, gdje je prostor ograničen, životinje moraju biti kreativne pri pronalaženju doma za svoj pomladak. U Indoneziji predani otac bangajskog kardinala prevladava taj problem tako što svoju mlađ čuva u ustima dok izvanredne majke dupina u Crvenom moru uče mladunce igrama na grebenu te da se, rastući, služe grebenom za autoterapiju. U hladnijim oceanima, morske alge služe kao odlični rasadnici. Majstorska kamuflaža morskog zmaja u Australiji pomaže jednom mužjaku da čuva ikru na sigurnom dok izvanredna vlatna kozica mora mladunce nositi među strujama dok traži hranu. Snalažljiva vidra u Škotskoj mora pronaći dovoljno ribe među morskom travom kako bi sačuvala svoja tri mladunca, ali ih u tu svrhu mora ostaviti same više sati, s gotovo katastrofalnim posljedicama. Neki morski roditelji koriste se inteligencijom da bi se prilagodili. Majke kod kitova ubojica u Australiji uče jato da love plavetne kitove, a ta se kulturološka lekcija prenosi kroz naraštaje i ključna je za njihov budući uspjeh. Nedaleko od njih hobotnica pretvara odbačenu plastičnu cijev u dom za svoja jaja, koja neumorno čuva dok se ne osamostale. U Južnoafričkoj Republici roditelji kapske blune prelete stotine milja kako bi pronašli hranu za ptiće koji rastu. Unatoč toj velikoj roditeljskoj požrtvovnosti, njihovi se mladunci suočavaju s izazovima bez presedana. Njihov prvi let uključuje izbjegavanje gladnih tuljana krznaša koji sad love mladunce bluna zbog iscrpljenih zaliha ribe. Ljudi imaju ključnu ulogu u preživljavanju roditelja u oceanima našeg planeta.

programme.title: Pakleni val
programme.desc: The agile Johnny Utah (K. Reeves) is a young and inexperienced FBI agent to whom boss Ben Harp (J. C. McGinley) assigns a difficult task, an investigation by a series of skillfully derived robbery of banks. When, from his older partner, Angela Pappas (G. Busey), he learned that criminals masked into former US presidents over the last three years have made as many as 27 robberies, and that it is impossible for them to trace them, Johnny with Pappas' help on the basis of surveillance cameras concludes that a group of daring surfers is behind the mask. Therefore, Johnny gets a surfing board and on the first day, awkwardly riding on the waves, meets the attractive Tyler Ann Endicott (L. Petty). Tyler is a skilled surfer and ex -girlfriend of a striking Bodhi (P. Swayze), a group of rider rider on waves who, every year in June and July, fearlessly defy nature. Knowing that all the robberies happened just during this period, Johnny began to hang out with Bodhi through Tyler.
