Reeves) mladi je i neiskusni FBI-jev agent kojem šef Ben Harp (J. C. McGinley) dodijeli težak zadatak, istragu niza vješto izvedenih pljački banaka. Kad od svog starijeg partnera, Angela Pappasa (G. Busey), dozna da su kriminalci maskirani u bivše američke predsjednike tijekom posljednje tri godine izveli čak 27 pljački, te da im je nemoguće ući u trag, Johnny uz Pappasovu pomoć na temelju snimaka nadzornih kamera zaključi da se iza maski krije skupina odvažnih surfera. Stoga Johnny nabavi surfersku dasku te već prvog dana, nespretno jašući na valovima, upozna atraktivnu Tyler Ann Endicott (L. Petty). Tyler je vješta surferica i bivša djevojka markantnog Bodhija (P. Swayze), vođe skupine jahača na valovima koji svake godine u lipnju i srpnju neustrašivo prkose prirodi. Znajući da su se sve pljačke dogodile baš u tom razdoblju, Johnny se preko Tyler počne družiti s Bodhijem. Nakon što s djevojkom uskoro započne ljubavnu vezu, Johnny će s Bodhijem razviti neobično prijateljstvo, istodobno obilježeno razumijevanjem i nepovjerenjem...

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: A month has passed since his grandfather's death and no family member is worn well with a loss. programme.title: Legende o Zemlji
programme.desc: According to ancient philosophy, four basic elements intersection create our planet. One of them is a country. She has created exceptional places that have always enchanted and confusing a man, wonderful landscapes like Feroj islands and a centuries -old species like the Palma Lodoice Maldivica from Seychelles or California sequins. In this sequel, legends and science help explain the origin and beauty of these unusual landscapes. / Prema antičkoj filozofiji, četiri osnovna elementa međudjelovanjem stvaraju naš planet. Jedan je od njih zemlja. Stvorila je iznimna mjesta koja oduvijek očaravaju i zbunjuju čovjeka, čudesne krajolike poput Ferojskih otoka i stoljetne vrste poput palme Lodoicea maldivica sa Sejšela ili kalifornijskih sekvoja. U ovom nastavku legende i znanost pomažu objasniti postanak i ljepotu tih neobičnih krajolika.

programme.title: I.T.
programme.desc: Mike Regan is an entrepreneur who has everything: a wonderful wife, a beautiful young daughter and a fancy modern home. But suddenly he finds himself in a very dangerous cat and mouse game when his computer scientist Ed begins to use his skills to stalk Mike's daughter and threatens his family, work and life very quickly. In a world where there is no privacy, Mike must rely on her old relationships to beat a new type of enemy ... / Mike Regan je poduzetnik koji ima sve: divnu suprugu, lijepu mladu kćer i otmjeni moderni dom. No iznenada se nađe u izrazito opasnoj igru mačke i miša kada njegov informatičar Ed počinje upotrebljavati svoje vještine za uhođenje Mikeove kćeri i vrlo brzo ugrozi njegovu obitelj, posao i život. U svijetu gdje nema privatnosti, Mike se mora osloniti na svoje stare veze kako bi pobijedio novu vrstu neprijatelja...

programme.title: Inspektor Lynley
programme.desc: Lynley and Havers go into the bizarre world of online vice: they explore the violent and unusual death of young lawyer Emily Prctor. While exposing the layers of her life, they find out that four months ago she quit at Tony Wainwright's office and started working for her older sister Lisa on her pornographic channel on the Internet. Further investigation detectives came to Robert Tanner who contacted Emily and threatened her. There is also a abuse in the Proctor family and the death of Wainwright's fiancée. While Lynley faces a sharp lawyer and victim's lover, Haver visits her mentor, retired detective Robert Mills, whom she has not seen for 15 years. He entrusts him with his concerns about the case, but soon doubts the real reasons for his arrival. / Lynley i Havers zalaze u bizaran svijet internetskih poroka: istražuju nasilnu i neobičnu smrt mlade odvjetnice Emily Proctor. Dok razotkrivaju slojeve njezina života, doznaju da je prije četiri mjeseca dala otkaz u uredu Tonyja Wainwrighta i počela raditi za stariju sestru Lisu na njezinu pornografskom kanalu na internetu. Daljnjom istragom detektivi dođu do Roberta Tannera koji je kontaktirao Emily i prijetio joj. Otkrije se i zlostavljanje u obitelji Proctor te smrt Wainwrightove zaručnice. Dok se Lynley suočava s oštrim odvjetnikom i žrtvinim ljubavnikom, Havers posjeti njezin mentor, umirovljeni detektiv Robert Mills kojeg nije vidjela 15 godina. Povjeri mu svoje nedoumice glede slučaja, ali uskoro posumnja u stvarne razloge njegova dolaska.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: A month has passed since his grandfather's death and no family member is worn well with a loss. At the urging of a friend, Murray reluctantly tries to help the family go to the next step in the mourning process. Unexpectedly, the Goldbergs find themselves on a hilarious, bitter-sweet, but in the end with a cheerful daily excursion to spill his grandfather's ashes in his favorite place. By the way we pay tribute to the legendary 80s movie, "Bill and Teds Excellent Adventure." Na nagovor prijatelja, Murray nevoljko pokuša pomoći obitelji da prijeđu na sljedeći korak u procesu žalovanja. Neočekivano, Goldbergovi se nađu na urnebesnom, gorko-slatkom, ali na kraju veselom dnevnom izletu kako bi prosuli djedov pepeo na njegovu omiljenu mjestu. Usput odajemo počast legendarnom filmu iz 80-ih, "Bill And Teds Excellent Adventure." Kad susjed Goldbergovih stavi svoju kuću na prodaju, Beverly i Murray u njoj vide savršen novi dom nakon što im se djeca odsele. Ali ubrzo će shvatiti da, iako se kuća čini savršenom, već imaju savršen dom.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: In search of inspiration in the magnificent landscape of northern Yorkshire, Buckinghamshire friends are enthusiastic about the Counts and a series of houses that Nicki Chapman shows them. programme.title: The Wonderful World of Design - Australia / Čudesni svijet dizajna - Australija
programme.desc: How to turn the small, dilapidated Working House in the middle of a densely populated Sydney suburbs into a beautiful, self -sustaining home? Is that really impossible? For seven years, seven architects, 15 water specialists, 10 solar experts, 3 sustainability experts, two legalists and 1 one project manager Laura assured that the idea was impossible for her. But Laura still, with a budget of $ 900,000 and a 4 -month -old period, went into impossible. The house finally began to be built. The construction was accompanied by problems from the very beginning, from completely technical, financial to administrative _ even the local council rejected her request to install solar panels toward the street. Maybe the house is impossible to build. / Kako malu, oronulu radničku kuću usred gusto naseljenog sydneyskog predgrađa pretvoriti u prekrasan, samoodrživ dom? Je li to doista nemoguće? Sedam godina su sedam arhitekata, 15 specijalista za vodu, 10 solarnih eksperata, 3 stručnjaka za održivost, dva legalista i 1 jedan voditelj projekata Lauru uvjeravali da joj je ideja neizvediva. Ali Laura je ipak, s budžetom od 900.000 $ i rokom od 4 mjeseca, krenula u neizvedivo. Kuća se napokon počela graditi. Gradnju su od samog početka pratili problemi, od posve tehničkih, novčanih do administrativnih _ čak joj je i mjesno vijeće odbilo molbu za postavljanje solarnih panela prema ulici. programme.title: Vrtlarski klub Alana Titchmarsha
programme.desc: Alan leads us through our garden, showing the splendor of colors and seasonal flowers and helps the tips to grow the beautiful flower garden ourselves. Giovanna Fletcher is a new face of the series and in her debut invites us to our own garden as he talks about her personal gardening path and the joy of breeding herbs. Camilla Bassett-Smith looks at a beautifully designed garden in Italian style, showing his elegance and charm and encourages us to enrich our garden space with a little Italian atmosphere. / Alan nas vodi kroz svoj vrt pokazujući raskoš boja i sezonskog cvijeća te pomaže savjetima da i sami uzgojimo prekrasan cvjetni vrt. Camilla Bassett-Smith razgledava prekrasno dizajnirani vrt u talijanskom stilu, pokazujući njegovu eleganciju i šarm i potiče nas da i sami svoj vrtni prostor oplemenimo s malo talijanskog ugođaja.

programme.title: Putovanja za vikend s Greggom Wallaceom
programme.desc: Gregg goes to Barcelona, ​​a popular city for tourists who want to take a break for the weekend. Barcelona is full of excellent restaurants, beautiful arts and architecture and interesting customs. Gregg has always been attracted to food in the cities he visits, and in Barcelona he will not be disappointed. They will taste everything from a ham that you can buy on the street, to Tapas in a remote alley and dishes that cook Catalan grandmothers. So he'll find out what it means to be a Catalan. / Gregg odlazi u Barcelonu, popularan grad za turiste koji žele predahnuti za vikend. Barcelona je puna izvrsnih restorana, prekrasne umjetnosti i arhitekture te zanimljivih običaja. Gregga oduvijek privlači hrana u gradovima koje posjeti, a u Barceloni se neće razočarati. Kušat će sve, od šunke koju možete kupiti na ulici, do tapasa u zabačenoj uličici i jela koje kuhaju katalonske bake. Tako će doznati što znači biti Katalonac.

programme.title: Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: In the mountain border towards Slovenia, people who live there create an idyll associated with a lot of work and conscious renunciation. Tradition of the Janezic family from St. Jacob in Rosental, that is, Sentjakoba V Roz, can be traced back to the beginning of the 16th century, the Čertov family from the village of Zell Pfarre, that is, Sele-Fare, lives from sheep and bees as well as sheep and bees, in Arnoldstein the church year is celebrated, while in the nearby border triangle, in which they meet Italy and Austria The Marion Pucher Mountaineering House welcomes cross -border mountaineers. / U planinskom pograničju prema Sloveniji ljudi koji ondje žive stvaraju idilu povezanu s mnogo rada i svjesnog odricanja. Tradicija obitelji Janežič iz St. Jakoba u Rosentalu, odnosno, Šentjakoba v Rožu, može se pratiti unatrag sve do početka 16. stoljeća, obitelj Čertov iz sela Zell Pfarre, odnosno, Sele-Fare, živi od ovaca i pčela kao i s ovcama i pčelama, u Arnoldsteinu se slavi crkveni god, dok u obližnjem graničnom trokutu, u kojem se sastaju Italija, Slovenija i Austrija, domaćica planinarskog doma Marion Pucher dočekuje prekogranične planinare.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: In search of inspiration in the magnificent landscape of northern Yorkshire, Buckinghamshire friends are enthusiastic about the Counts and a series of houses that Nicki Chapman shows them. Nicki also visits a painter who almost completely renewed her beautiful old farm and turned it into a peculiar refuge for artists. / U potrazi za inspiracijom u veličanstvenom krajoliku Sjevernog Yorkshirea, prijateljice iz Buckinghamshirea oduševljene su grofovijom i nizom kuća koje im pokazuje Nicki Chapman. Nicki također posjećuje slikaricu koja je gotovo u potpunosti sama obnovila prelijepu staru farmu i pretvorila je u osebujno utočište za umjetnike.

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Design - Australia / Čudesni svijet dizajna - Australija
programme.desc: How to turn the small, dilapidated Working House in the middle of a densely populated Sydney suburbs into a beautiful, self -sustaining home? Is that really impossible? For seven years, seven architects, 15 water specialists, 10 solar experts, 3 sustainability experts, two legalists and 1 one project manager Laura assured that the idea was impossible for her. But Laura still, with a budget of $ 900,000 and a 4 -month -old period, went into impossible. The house finally began to be built. The construction was accompanied by problems from the very beginning, from completely technical, financial to administrative _ even the local council rejected her request to install solar panels toward the street. Maybe the house is impossible to build. / Kako malu, oronulu radničku kuću usred gusto naseljenog sydneyskog predgrađa pretvoriti u prekrasan, samoodrživ dom? Je li to doista nemoguće? Sedam godina su sedam arhitekata, 15 specijalista za vodu, 10 solarnih eksperata, 3 stručnjaka za održivost, dva legalista i 1 jedan voditelj projekata Lauru uvjeravali da joj je ideja neizvediva. Ali Laura je ipak, s budžetom od 900.000 $ i rokom od 4 mjeseca, krenula u neizvedivo. Kuća se napokon počela graditi. Gradnju su od samog početka pratili problemi, od posve tehničkih, novčanih do administrativnih _ čak joj je i mjesno vijeće odbilo molbu za postavljanje solarnih panela prema ulici. Možda je kuću ipak nemoguće sagraditi.

programme.title: Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: The herbs hunter visits Medimurje Lakes where he learns about the differences of grown and wild species of herbs. Some of the plants in this episode are Barica, Black Gavez, Dobrica, Adhesive Brokika, Rear Ivica, Winter Horse and Petrov Cross. The guests of the episode are Silvija Kolar-Fodor, the owner of the biovrt, and Ksenija Srnec, the caregiver of heritage. / Lovac na bilje posjećuje međimurska jezera gdje uči o razlikama uzgojenih i divljih vrsta bilja. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su barica, crni gavez, dobričica, ljepljiva broćika, uzava ivica, zimska preslica i petrov križ. Gosti epizode su Silvija Kolar-Fodor, vlasnica biovrta, te Ksenija Srnec, njegovateljica baštine.

programme.title: Hit dana

programme.title: Nick Knowles: In the Valley of Death / Nick Knowles: U Dolini smrti
programme.desc: Nick travels from the Golden Dina at the southern end of the death valley, through the desolate Slano Plain Badwater Basina to the north, where Rhyolite is located, the best preserved ghost town, and eventually ends the journey in Death Valley Junction where the evening will spend at Opera! / Nick putuje od zlatnih dina na južnom kraju Doline smrti, kroz puste slane ravnice Badwater Basina do sjevera gdje se nalazi Rhyolite, najbolje očuvani grada duhova, i na kraju završava put u mjestu Death Valley Junction gdje će večer provesti na operi!

programme.title: Unit 414: witnesses and victims on October 7 / Postrojba 414: Svjedokinje i žrtve 7. listopada
programme.desc: The documentary brings a unique view of the events of October 7, 2023, from the perspective of women who were on the front line at that moment. There were 23. They were called "the eyes of the state." It is a unit 414 from Nahal Oz military base. They warned, but the state did not listen to them. They saw what was preparing and were among the first victims. Today, guards guarding the border with Gaza require the truth to be told and give us the cross -section of today's Israeli society. If they had listened to them, the attack on October 7 could be prevented. Listening to their story, we are talking about the attack, of the training of Hamas's attackers to which they testified, the failures of the Israeli secret service and the Government, the fate of hostages, and the present lines of tension in Israeli society, especially the role of women in the military. / Dokumentarni film donosi jedinstven pogled na događaje od 7. listopada 2023., iz perspektive žena koje su u tom trenutku bile na prvoj crti. Bilo ih je 23. Zvali su ih "očima države". Riječ je o jedinici 414 iz vojne baze Nahal Oz. One su upozoravale, ali država ih nije slušala. Vidjele su što se sprema i bile su među prvim žrtvama. Danas stražarice koje čuvaju granicu s Gazom zahtijevaju da se kaže istina i daju nam presjek današnjeg izraelskog društva. Da su ih poslušali, napad 7. listopada mogao se spriječiti. Slušajući njihovu priču, govorimo o napadu, o obuci Hamasovih napadača kojoj su svjedočile, o propustima izraelske tajne službe i vlade, o sudbini talaca te sadašnjim linijama napetosti u izraelskom društvu, osobito o ulozi žena u vojsci.

programme.title: Kratko sjećanje

Zaposli se kao noćni čistač u lokalnoj banci, pokušavajući ponovno srediti svoj život. Upoznaje se s Garyjem Spargom (Jeff Daniels), koji ga uvlači u pljačku banke, iskorištavajući Chrisovu ranjivost i njegov posao...

programme.title: Inspektor Lynley
programme.desc: Lynley and Haves explore the death of Paparazzi Peter Roker, beaten and killed in London Soho. Detectives have learned that Rooker had an arranged meeting with the editor -in -chief of the popular tabloid Melissa Booth. She admits not only to them that Roocker is her former love, but also a war photographer who has changed after being in Bosnia during the war. Was Melissa's husband jealous or the key to the puzzle lies in Roocker's custody of young Bosnian Nin who threatens the detective to nkaka with a gun? Nina works at the Number 19 Club 19, owned by former parachutist Michael Wren, which he also went to Roocker shortly before his death. The investigation takes the detective until the 1995 massacre in Bosnia. / Lynley i Havers istražuju smrt paparazza Petera Rookera, pretučenog i ubijenog u londonskom Sohou. Detektivi doznaju da je Rooker imao ugovoren sastanak s glavnom urednicom popularnog tabloida Melissom Booth. Ona im prizna ne samo da joj je Rooker bivša ljubav, nego i ratni fotograf koji se promijenio nakon što je bio u Bosni za vrijeme rata. Je li Melissin muž bio ljubomoran ili ključ zagonetke leži u Rookerovu skrbništvu nad mladom Bosankom Ninom koja zaprijeti detektivu Nkati pištoljem? Nina radi u klubu Number 19 čiji je vlasnik bivši padobranac Michael Wren, a u koji je i nedugo prije smrti zašao i Rooker. Istraga odvede detektive sve do masakra u Bosni 1995.

Maite and Carlos put everything on a cube to build their home, but with creative differences and in combination with a limited budget, will Maite manage to achieve their exceptional vision? / U Graven Hillu u Oxfordshireu, Carlos i Maite imaju ambiciozne planove za izgradnju smjelog doma inspiriranog Španjolskom _ zemljom u kojoj je Maite odrasla. Maite i Carlos su sve stavili na kocku kako bi izgradili svoj dom, ali s kreativnim razlikama i u kombinaciji s ograničenim budžetom, hoće li Maite uspjeti ostvariti svoju iznimnu viziju?

programme.title: Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: In Trins, an idyllic village of farmers, the Maier family with 500 silver spruce lays the foundation for their own breeding of Christmas trees, a family -owned company to which the originality of Tyrol is inherent. programme.title: Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: Mljet, lost island on the open sea between Dubrovnik, Peljesac and Lastovo. It is laid parallel with Peljesac and forms the Mljet Channel with it. In the embrace of land greenery and sea blue, large and small lakes and island on the island, the monastery of St. Mary, the western part of the mainland and the sea of ​​this Croatian pearl was proclaimed in 1960 by our first sea national park. We will explore his forests, illuminate his fascinating submarine, get to know his inhabitants and live submarine gardens, the largest coral reef in the Mediterranean and his guardian Kirnja (Epinephelusmarginaatus). We will tell the story of Odysseus and his nymph, of St. Paul's shipwreck. We will get to know Blati, Mljet history, tradition and customs. / Mljet, izgubljeni otok na pučini između Dubrovnika, Pelješca i Lastova. Položen je usporedno s Pelješcem i s njim tvori Mljetski kanal. U zagrljaju kopnenog zelenila i morskog plavetnila, Velikog i Malog jezera i otoka na otoku, samostana svete Marije, zapadni dio kopna i mora ovoga hrvatskog bisera proglašen je 1960. godine našim prvim morskim nacionalnim parkom. Istražit ćemo njegove šume, osvijetliti njegovo fascinantno podmorje, upoznati njegove stanovnike i žive podmorske vrtove, najveći koraljni greben na Sredozemlju i njegovu čuvaricu kirnju (Epinephelusmarginatus). Ispričat ćemo priču o Odiseju i njegovoj nimfi, o brodolomu svetoga Pavla. Upoznat ćemo blatine, mljetsku povijest, tradiciju i običaje.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Peti dan
programme.desc: In the first show of the 16th season, we also present two new commentators, these are Ena Katarina Haler and Erik Brezovec, along with old Marijan Bijelić, Matija Štahana and Aleksandar Musić. The topics are this fifth day: 1. The right world 2. Cancellation of cultural events are commentators: Marijana Bijelić, Matija Štahan, Ena Katarina Haler and Erik Brezovec. ----- Ena Katarina Haler was born in Osijek in 1996. She graduated in architecture and urbanism from the Faculty of Architecture in Zagreb. He works at the Institute of Art History as an architect and professional associate in science and education. She is a permanent associate of the 24 Hours and Express Weekly, for whom he writes texts on literature, architectural and urban heritage, reports and feuillets. She has published novels at the time (2019) and innocent (2024). For her literary work, she was awarded the Ksaver Sandor Gjalski awards for the best prose work and Ivan and Josip Kozarac for the book of the year. Doc. Ph.D. Erik Brezovec was born in 1992 in Varaždin. He is a sociological theorist and assistant professor at the Faculty of Croatian Studies, University of Zagreb. He graduated in sociology from Croatian studies and received his doctorate from the Faculty of Philosophy, University of Zagreb. In his work, he deals with the relationship between society and technology and knowledge of knowledge, with a narrower focus on Luhmann's theory of social systems. He is the co -founder of the Cambridge Global Knowledge Nexus initiative, aimed at social implications of generative artificial intelligence and transfer of theoretical insights into practice (education, public policy, organization). He is a special edition of a special edition of Ai and Society (Springer) dedicated to the generative AI and society. He is the co -organizer of the annual "Cambridge Generation AI in Education" at the University of Cambridge. He is the author of several dozen scientific papers and one book. He cooperates with Meer.com and Sociology.hr, where he regularly publishes his popular science and philosophical texts. He is a member of the Croatian Sociological Society. / u prvoj emisiji 16. sezone predstavljamo i dvoje novih komentatora, to su Ena Katarina Haler i Erik Brezovec, uz stare Marijanu Bijelić, Matiju Štahana i Aleksandra Musića. Otkazivanje kulturnih događanja Komentatori su: Marijana Bijelić, Matija Štahan, Ena Katarina Haler i Erik Brezovec. ----- Ena Katarina Haler rođena je u Osijeku 1996. godine. Diplomirala je arhitekturu i urbanizam na Arhitektonskom fakultetu u Zagrebu. Radi na Institutu za povijest umjetnosti kao arhitektica i stručna suradnica u znanosti i obrazovanju. Stalna je suradnica 24sata i tjednika Express, za koje piše tekstove o književnosti, arhitektonskom i urbanističkom naslijeđu, reportaže i feljtone. Objavila je romane Nadohvat (2019.) i Nevini (2024.). Za svoj književni rad nagrađena je nagradama Ksaver Šandor Gjalski za najbolje prozno djelo te Ivan i Josip Kozarac za knjigu godine. Doc. dr. sc. Erik Brezovec rođen je 1992. u Varaždinu. Sociološki je teoretičar i docent na Fakultetu hrvatskih studija Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. Diplomirao je sociologiju na Hrvatskim studijima, a doktorirao na Filozofskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. U svom radu bavi se odnosom društva i tehnologije te sociologijom znanja, s užim fokusom na Luhmannovu teoriju društvenih sustava. Suosnivač je inicijative Cambridge Global Knowledge Nexus, usmjerene na društvene implikacije generativne umjetne inteligencije i prijenos teorijskih uvida u praksu (obrazovanje, javne politike, organizacije). Suorganizator je godišnje konferencije "Cambridge Generative AI in Education" na Sveučilištu u Cambridgeu. Autor je nekoliko desetaka znanstvenih radova i jedne knjige. Surađuje s portalima meer.com i sociologija.hr, gdje redovito objavljuje svoje popularnoznanstvene i filozofske tekstove. Član je Hrvatskog sociološkog društva.

programme.title: Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: From the beginning of philosophy, the human being asked her questions: to what extent, consciousness is something unique human? Do other animals have consciousness? Even the simplest? Stones, water, grasses, trees ... Could it all be aware? Such a worldview is called _ Panpsihism. Panpsihism is a set of philosophical doctrines that consciousness is not exclusively for the human species, that other living beings, and even inanimate elements, may have subjective perceptions of the world around them. Panpsihistic ideas are not all the same. Some consciousness attribute to insects, plants and even microorganisms, and the most radical Panpsihism defends the idea that the subjective experience is ubiquitous: that it is in all things ... / Od početka filozofije ljudsko biće postavilo si je pitanja: u kojoj je mjeri svijest nešto jedinstveno ljudsko? Imaju li druge životinje svijest? Čak i najjednostavnije? Kamenje, voda, trave, stabla... bi li sve to moglo imati svijest? Takav pogled na svijet naziva se _ panpsihizam. Panpsihizam je skup filozofskih doktrina koje smatraju da svijest nije nešto isključivo za ljudsku vrstu, da i druga živa bića, pa čak i neživi elementi, mogu imati subjektivne percepcije svijeta koji ih okružuje. Panpsihističke ideje nisu sve iste. Neke svijest pripisuju insektima, biljkama, pa čak i mikroorganizmima, a najradikalniji panpsihizam brani ideju da je subjektivno iskustvo sveprisutno: da se ono nalazi u svim stvarima...

programme.title: Iran: Air view / Iran: Pogled iz zraka
programme.desc: In the center of Iran is a spacious plateau with deserts and dry areas. The desert landscapes make up almost a third of the surface of the state. These are areas with a cruel climate in which a man still managed to find his place thousands of years ago. The south of Tehran rise the deserts of the Maralingab desert, the door that introduces us to that Iranian desert. On her western edge in the south direction are the cities of Oasa Kashan, Esfahan and Yazd, built in irrigated zones and in important trade and strategic directions. In the southwest, in the province of Fars, Persepolis emerges, a miracle to admire the whole world. / U središtu Irana nalazi se prostrana visoravan s pustinjama i suhim predjelima. Pustinjski krajolici čine gotovo trećinu površine države. To su područja s okrutnom klimom u kojima je čovjek ipak uspio pronaći svoje mjesto prije više tisuća godina. Južno od Teherana izdižu se dine pustinje Maranjab, vrata koja nas uvode u tu iransku pustinju. Na njezinu zapadnom rubu u smjeru juga nalaze se gradovi oaze Kashan, Esfahan i Yazd, izgrađeni u navodnjavanim zonama i na važnim trgovačkim i strateškim pravcima. programme.title: What is a classic? / Što je klasik?
programme.desc: Welcome to the anniversary season of the show seeking the holy grail of the art of words, the show in which the world is not a screen but a text! We are just entering the tenth year of searching to answer the question of what a classic is. From the moment when someone in Mesopotamia on a clay tile engraved the first signs of a king seeking immortality, the world became written. Words became the boundaries of empires, prayers to the gods, calls for the rebellion and the beacons of hope. Stories form civilizations, change history. They change us. Her power is aware of our tonight's guest, Harvard Professor Martin Puchner, who claims that she shapes people, history and civilization. / Dobro došli u obljetničku sezonu emisije koja traži sveti gral umjetnosti riječi, emisije u kojoj svijet nije ekran, nego tekst! Upravo ulazimo u desetu godinu traganja za odgovorom na pitanje što je klasik. Od trenutka kada je netko u Mezopotamiji na glinenu pločicu urezao prve znakove o kralju koji traži besmrtnost, svijet je postao pisan. Riječi su postale granice carstava, molitve bogovima, pozivi na pobunu i svjetionici nade. Priče oblikuju civilizacije, mijenjaju povijest. Mijenjaju nas. Njezine je moći svjestan naš večerašnji gost, harvardski profesor Martin Puchner, koji tvrdi da ona oblikuje ljude, povijest i civilizaciju.

programme.title: In search of actor Negromante - Pero Kvrgic / U potrazi za glumcem Negromantom - Pero Kvrgić
programme.desc: The show recorded on the occasion of the 80th birthday of the great actor Pere Kvrgic (1927 _ 2020). This excellent Negromant-Glumac-Carobnjak always poured the theater mirror to the audience, so that she would be reflected in his dramatic characters. Wishing with "light blood and lordship a quiet night and a good day," he always knew how to smiling mockingly, alluding to the time we live in. He was born on March 4, 1927 in Moravica. Of all the drama heroes played by Pero Kvrgic, the role of the sweep in the play "Dundo Maroje", directed by Mladen Škiljan in 1955, has been embodied in it. Pero Kvrgic had a Harlekina costume and a mask with a caricated long nose in the first Pomet scene and thus costly the essential parts of Negromante text. He brought the actors procession to the scene with thin ropes. In this way, a actor, wizard, a larch and a sage, who will reveal to the audience, united the secret about the right and false people of the people, "praised" and "naming" in this way. / Emisija snimljena u povodu 80. rođendana velikog glumca Pere Kvrgića (1927. _ 2020.). Ovaj vrsni negromant-glumac-čarobnjak uvijek je publici podmetao kazališno zrcalo, kako bi se ona ogledala u njegovim dramskim likovima. Zaželjevši "svijetloj krvi i gospodstvu mirnu noć i dobar dan", uvijek se znao podrugljivo nasmiješiti, aludirajući na vrijeme u kojem živimo. Rođen je 4. ožujka 1927. u Moravicama. Od svih dramskih junaka koje je Pero Kvrgić odigrao ističe se uloga Pometa u predstavi "Dundo Maroje", u režiji Mladena Škiljana 1955. U njoj se Držićev negromant Dugi Nos utjelovio u liku Pometa. Pero Kvrgić je u prvom Pometovom prizoru imao harlekinski kostim i masku s karikiranim dugim nosom i tako kostimiran govorio bitne dijelove Negromantova teksta. Tankim konopcima dovukao je na scenu povorku glumaca. Na taj se način u Negromantu sjedinio glumac, čarobnjak, lakrdijaš i mudrac, koji će publici otkriti tajnu o pravim i lažnim ljudima _ o ljudima "nahvao" i ljudima "nazbilj".

programme.title: Gorgona
programme.desc: The name Gorgon as a common denominator of his existence and behavior was taken by a group of like -minded people (D. Bašicevic, M. Horvat, M. Jevšovar, J. Knifer, I. Kozarić, M. Meštrović, R. Putar, Đ. Seder, J. Vanište), creating in Zagreb, from 1959 to 1966, one of the most unusual phenomena in Croatian art. Common belonging to the spirit of modernism, which defines it recognizing absurdity, gaps and monotony as aesthetic categories, a tendency for nihilism, and a metaphysical irony, which is still, half a century later, attracts numerous fans and researchers. Gorgona marked the Croatian art scene of the second half of the 20th century, and its members made a crucial impact on the development and valorisation of Croatian contemporary art through their artistic activity and placed it in European frameworks. / Ime Gorgona kao zajednički nazivnik svog postojanja i ponašanja uzela je grupa istomišljenika (D. Bašičević, M. Horvat, M. Jevšovar, J. Knifer, I. Kožarić, M. Meštrović, R. Putar, Đ. Seder, J. Vaništa) stvorivši tako u Zagrebu, od 1959. do 1966., jednu od najneobičnijih pojava u hrvatskoj umjetnosti. Zajednička pripadnost duhu modernizma što ga definira prepoznavanje apsurda, praznine i monotonije kao estetskih kategorija, sklonost nihilizmu te metafizička ironija ono je što i danas, pola stoljeća kasnije, privlači brojne poklonike i istraživače. Gorgona je obilježila hrvatsku likovnu scenu druge polovice 20. stoljeća, a njezini pripadnici svojim su umjetničkim djelovanjem izvršili presudan utjecaj na razvoj i valorizaciju hrvatske suvremene umjetnosti te je smjestili u europske okvire.

Između Velebitskog kanala i ličko-gacke zaravni započet ćemo naše 145 kilometara dugo putovanje od sjevera i Senjskog bila, kroz povijest važne Jozefinske ceste preko Vratnika. programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelj, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: What is a classic? / Što je klasik?
programme.desc: Welcome to the anniversary season of the show seeking the holy grail of the art of words, the show in which the world is not a screen but a text! We are just entering the tenth year of searching to answer the question of what a classic is. From the moment when someone in Mesopotamia on a clay tile engraved the first signs of a king seeking immortality, the world became written. Words became the boundaries of empires, prayers to the gods, calls for the rebellion and the beacons of hope. Stories form civilizations, change history. They change us. Her power is aware of our tonight's guest, Harvard Professor Martin Puchner, who claims that she shapes people, history and civilization. / Dobro došli u obljetničku sezonu emisije koja traži sveti gral umjetnosti riječi, emisije u kojoj svijet nije ekran, nego tekst! Upravo ulazimo u desetu godinu traganja za odgovorom na pitanje što je klasik. Od trenutka kada je netko u Mezopotamiji na glinenu pločicu urezao prve znakove o kralju koji traži besmrtnost, svijet je postao pisan. Riječi su postale granice carstava, molitve bogovima, pozivi na pobunu i svjetionici nade. Priče oblikuju civilizacije, mijenjaju povijest. Mijenjaju nas. Njezine je moći svjestan naš večerašnji gost, harvardski profesor Martin Puchner, koji tvrdi da ona oblikuje ljude, povijest i civilizaciju.

programme.title: In search of actor Negromante - Pero Kvrgic / U potrazi za glumcem Negromantom - Pero Kvrgić
programme.desc: The show recorded on the occasion of the 80th birthday of the great actor Pere Kvrgic (1927 _ 2020). This excellent Negromant-Glumac-Carobnjak always poured the theater mirror to the audience, so that she would be reflected in his dramatic characters. Wishing with "light blood and lordship a quiet night and a good day," he always knew how to smiling mockingly, alluding to the time we live in. He was born on March 4, 1927 in Moravica. Of all the drama heroes played by Pero Kvrgic, the role of the sweep in the play "Dundo Maroje", directed by Mladen Škiljan in 1955, has been embodied in it. Pero Kvrgic had a Harlekina costume and a mask with a caricated long nose in the first Pomet scene and thus costly the essential parts of Negromante text. He brought the actors procession to the scene with thin ropes. In this way, a actor, wizard, a larch and a sage, who will reveal to the audience, united the secret about the right and false people of the people, "praised" and "naming" in this way. / Emisija snimljena u povodu 80. rođendana velikog glumca Pere Kvrgića (1927. _ 2020.). Ovaj vrsni negromant-glumac-čarobnjak uvijek je publici podmetao kazališno zrcalo, kako bi se ona ogledala u njegovim dramskim likovima. Zaželjevši "svijetloj krvi i gospodstvu mirnu noć i dobar dan", uvijek se znao podrugljivo nasmiješiti, aludirajući na vrijeme u kojem živimo. Rođen je 4. ožujka 1927. u Moravicama. Od svih dramskih junaka koje je Pero Kvrgić odigrao ističe se uloga Pometa u predstavi "Dundo Maroje", u režiji Mladena Škiljana 1955. U njoj se Držićev negromant Dugi Nos utjelovio u liku Pometa. Pero Kvrgić je u prvom Pometovom prizoru imao harlekinski kostim i masku s karikiranim dugim nosom i tako kostimiran govorio bitne dijelove Negromantova teksta. Tankim konopcima dovukao je na scenu povorku glumaca. Na taj se način u Negromantu sjedinio glumac, čarobnjak, lakrdijaš i mudrac, koji će publici otkriti tajnu o pravim i lažnim ljudima _ o ljudima "nahvao" i ljudima "nazbilj".

programme.title: Ćiribirci
programme.desc: In the documentary "Ćiribirje" Tanja Kanceljak we will lead you through perhaps the least known part of Croatia. Cyribrians or Istor -Romania are a small linguistic group living in Istria. In the north, we will meet the Ciribirians in the village of Zejana, while on the southern slopes of Učka they live in Susnjevica and the surrounding villages. The Zupan people say they speak the female, and in Susnjevica they say they speak Vlach. Despite the small differences, we can say that it is one language, Istor -Romanian. But they have a common origin that has not yet been sufficiently explored. The version is many. The most likely one is that they arrived in Istria in the 14th century, fleeing in front of the Turks. Ciriberians were cattlemen and nomads, and over the centuries they merged with the local population. They brought with them a language that, although without a written trace, has remained in everyday use to this day. Interestingly, the speakers of the Istrorumanjski do not feel a minority or the Romanian diaspora, declared either Croats or regionally. According to UNESCO data, there are about a thousand Ciribirians in the world today, while only two hundred are left in Croatia. Apart from a few poems and traditions of bell -winning in Žejan, they do not have their own literature and art. They were left only language and they are a great and significant specialty for Istria and Croatia today. In the documentary Fima "Ciriborica", recorded in 2006, a life of people are shown that many in Croatia do not know exist. The team of Croatian Television toured them from oblivion. / U dokumentarnom filmu "Ćiribirci" Tanje Kanceljak provest ćemo vas kroz možda najmanje poznati dio Hrvatske. Ćiribirci ili Istrorumunji mala su jezična skupina koja živi u Istri. Na sjeveru ćemo Ćiribirce susresti u selu Žejane, dok na južnim padinama Učke žive u Šušnjevici i okolnim selima. Žejanci kažu kako govore žejanski, a u Šušnjevici kažu kako govore vlaški. Unatoč malim razlikama, možemo reći kako je to jedan jezik, istrorumunjski. No zajedničko im je porijeklo koje još uvijek nije dovoljno istraženo. Verzija je mnogo. Najvjerojatnija je ona da su u Istru stigli u 14. stoljeću bježeći pred Turcima. Ćiribirci su bili stočari i nomadi, a tijekom stoljeća stopili su se s domaćim stanovništvom. Sa sobom su donijeli jezik koji je, iako bez pisanog traga, i do danas ostao u svakodnevnoj uporabi. Zanimljivo je da se govornici istrorumunjskog ne osjećaju manjinom, ali niti rumunjskom dijasporom, deklariraju se ili kao Hrvati ili regionalno. Prema podacima UNESCO-a, Ćiribiraca u svijetu danas ima oko tisuću, dok ih je u Hrvatskoj ostalo samo dvjestotinjak. Osim nekoliko pjesama i tradicije zvončarstva u Žejanama, oni nemaju svoju književnost i umjetnost. Ostao im je jedino jezik i oni su danas za Istru i Hrvatsku velika i značajna posebnost. U dokumentarnom fimu "Ćiribirci", snimljenom 2006., prikazan je život ljudi za koje mnogi u Hrvatskoj i ne znaju da postoje. Od zaborava ih je istrgnula ekipa Hrvatske televizije.

programme.desc: The episode explores that these glittering goods have shaped the foundations of many economies and that the dedicated search for it influenced the course of human history. From the minatersraSrand pool from the mining flourishing, where 40 % of the world gold, to the "Golden Mili" mine in Western Australia, has been excavated, we explore that the search for gold has transformed landscapes and communities. From its beginnings and key roles in ancient civilizations, to the future of gold excavation in the ocean, and amateur hunters on gold that continue to be enriched, we explore why gold drives us to move the borders and exploration of new appetizers in our continuous search for this precious metal. / Epizoda istražuje kako je ova svjetlucava roba oblikovala temelje mnogih ekonomija te kako je predano traganje za njom utjecalo na tijek ljudske povijesti. Od rudarskog procvata u bazenu Witwatersrand, gdje je iskopano 40 % svjetskog zlata, do rudnika "Zlatne milje" u zapadnoj Australiji, istražujemo kako je potraga za zlatom preoblikovala krajolike i zajednice. Od svojih početaka i ključne uloge u drevnim civilizacijama, do budućnosti iskapanja zlata u oceanu te amaterskih lovaca na zlato koji se i dalje uspijevaju obogatiti, istražujemo zašto nas zlato tjera na pomicanje granica i istraživanje novih predjela u našoj neprekidnoj potrazi za tim dragocjenim metalom.

programme.title: Nitram
programme.desc: The film deals with the life and behavior of a mentally disturbed young man with nitra (based on Martin Bryant) and events that led to his participation in the Masakra at Port Arthur in Tasmania in 1996. In the mid-1990s, he lived with his mother and father in the suburbs in Australia. He is isolated and frustrated and fails to fit into society. This lasts until an unexpected friend of the withdrawn heir to Helen. However, when that connection is tragically ends and nitram's loneliness and anger start to grow, he slowly falls into a spiral leading to the disaster. / Film se bavi životom i ponašanjem mentalno poremećenog mladića Nitrama (temeljenog na Martinu Bryantu) i događajima koji su doveli do njegova sudjelovanja u masakru u Port Arthuru u Tasmaniji 1996. godine. Sredinom 1990-ih Nitram živi s majkom i ocem u predgrađu u Australiji. Izoliran je i frustriran i ne uspijeva se uklopiti u društvo. To traje dok neočekivano ne postane blizak prijatelj povučene nasljednice Helen. Međutim, kada ta veza tragično završi, a Nitramova usamljenost i gnjev počnu rasti, on polako pada u spiralu koja vodi u katastrofu.

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: The tenth edition of the Fest Jazz Koprivnica Festival in 2024 hosted a hundred musicians from Croatia, Slovenia, Austria, Italy, and even from Australia. A rich music program included concerts in the Hall of the Koprivnica Youth Hall, a music program and socializing in Jazz Garden, the Jutarnji Jazz Program, Concerts and Jam Sessione at the MMC ball club, the Vinilija Gramophon Ploče Fair, and a music workshop for children. The festival began with a concert by the Slovenian Big Band Radlje, followed by the performance of the brothers band, Tamara Obrovac Transhistria Ensemble, the Virje Wind Orchestra, Zvonimir Sestak Groove Assembly, and Brekky Boy Trio Electronic Jazz Trio from Sydney. / Deseto izdanje festivala Fest jazza Koprivnica 2024. godine ugostilo je stotinjak glazbenika iz Hrvatske, Slovenije, Austrije, Italije, pa čak i iz Australije. Bogat glazbeni program obuhvatio je koncerte u dvorani Doma mladih Koprivnica, glazbeni program i druženje u Jazz gardenu, Jutarnji jazz program, koncerte i jam sessione u klubu Mmc Kugla, sajam gramofonskih ploča Vinilija, te glazbene radionice za djecu. Festival je započeo koncertom slovenskog Big Banda Radlje, uslijedio je nastup sastava Brothers, Tamara Obrovac Transhistria ensemblea, Puhački orkestar Virje, Zvonimir Šestak Groove Assembly, te Brekky Boy Trio elektronički jazz trio iz Sydneya.

programme.title: Ćiribirci
programme.desc: In the documentary "Ćiribirje" Tanja Kanceljak we will lead you through perhaps the least known part of Croatia. Cyribrians or Istor -Romania are a small linguistic group living in Istria. In the north, we will meet the Ciribirians in the village of Zejana, while on the southern slopes of Učka they live in Susnjevica and the surrounding villages. The Zupan people say they speak the female, and in Susnjevica they say they speak Vlach. Despite the small differences, we can say that it is one language, Istor -Romanian. But they have a common origin that has not yet been sufficiently explored. The version is many. The most likely one is that they arrived in Istria in the 14th century, fleeing in front of the Turks. Ciriberians were cattlemen and nomads, and over the centuries they merged with the local population. They brought with them a language that, although without a written trace, has remained in everyday use to this day. Interestingly, the speakers of the Istrorumanjski do not feel a minority or the Romanian diaspora, declared either Croats or regionally. According to UNESCO data, there are about a thousand Ciribirians in the world today, while only two hundred are left in Croatia. Apart from a few poems and traditions of bell -winning in Žejan, they do not have their own literature and art. They were left only language and they are a great and significant specialty for Istria and Croatia today. In the documentary Fima "Ciriborica", recorded in 2006, a life of people are shown that many in Croatia do not know exist. The team of Croatian Television toured them from oblivion. / U dokumentarnom filmu "Ćiribirci" Tanje Kanceljak provest ćemo vas kroz možda najmanje poznati dio Hrvatske. Ćiribirci ili Istrorumunji mala su jezična skupina koja živi u Istri. Na sjeveru ćemo Ćiribirce susresti u selu Žejane, dok na južnim padinama Učke žive u Šušnjevici i okolnim selima. Žejanci kažu kako govore žejanski, a u Šušnjevici kažu kako govore vlaški. Unatoč malim razlikama, možemo reći kako je to jedan jezik, istrorumunjski. No zajedničko im je porijeklo koje još uvijek nije dovoljno istraženo. Verzija je mnogo. Najvjerojatnija je ona da su u Istru stigli u 14. stoljeću bježeći pred Turcima. Ćiribirci su bili stočari i nomadi, a tijekom stoljeća stopili su se s domaćim stanovništvom. Sa sobom su donijeli jezik koji je, iako bez pisanog traga, i do danas ostao u svakodnevnoj uporabi. Zanimljivo je da se govornici istrorumunjskog ne osjećaju manjinom, ali niti rumunjskom dijasporom, deklariraju se ili kao Hrvati ili regionalno. Prema podacima UNESCO-a, Ćiribiraca u svijetu danas ima oko tisuću, dok ih je u Hrvatskoj ostalo samo dvjestotinjak. Osim nekoliko pjesama i tradicije zvončarstva u Žejanama, oni nemaju svoju književnost i umjetnost. Ostao im je jedino jezik i oni su danas za Istru i Hrvatsku velika i značajna posebnost. U dokumentarnom fimu "Ćiribirci", snimljenom 2006., prikazan je život ljudi za koje mnogi u Hrvatskoj i ne znaju da postoje. Od zaborava ih je istrgnula ekipa Hrvatske televizije.

programme.title: Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: Paklina created in smoke and fire, from the harbor squeezed, named the Velebit -deeply engraved scars below the Holy Hill. Canyons Mala and Velika Paklenica, twins Introduced by the water of her streams that rush to the sea for large rains and dissolved snow. Little Paklenica is twelve kilometers long, four hundred to five hundred meters wide, and a large one is two kilometers longer. This impressive canyon beauty, wealth and diversity of forests of the source of the Bujic streams of Velika and Mala Paklenica, was proclaimed in 1949 by the Paklenica National Park for 95 square kilometers of the area. In the western part of the Ribnica Gate Park, Javornik and Debelo Hill dominate above September and Bojinac Plateau. Through the Vrh Golić, who leaned over the dry Draga, the widow of Brezimenjak and in her hidden Ramići and Parići, our gaze extends toward the northern border over which Veli Golić, Malovan and Crkljen Kuk dominated. Above the hidden and hard -to -reach canyon of the Mali Paklenica creek are Jerkovac and Badalj with great mockes. Through Jerkovac above the Lokvani Lok, we climb the mythical Holy Hill on the hair of a thick hill. Having him with him, calling him, talk about him and hang out with him, the privilege is rare. The view from the Holy Hill testifies to us about the greatness and shows us the way through the time we stopped for a moment. In Ramići we felt traces of past times. At the Straženica source, we headed through the water of Golubinka. We followed her underground path in Vrulji Modrič and Bunny. We followed the whimsical flow of Velika Paklenica water through the seasons. In the manner furnace, we flared our imagination. Of the thousands of recorded plant species, 79 are endemic. The climbers by cliffs divide the place with the divocoses (Rupicapra Rupicapra). From the sea level to the highest highs in the Paklenica National Park, many animal species have found their home. / Paklina nastala u dimu i vatri, iz luča iscijeđena, dala je ime velebitskim duboko urezanim ožiljcima ispod Svetoga brda. Kanjoni Mala i Velika Paklenica, blizanci izdubljeni vodom njezinih potoka koji se za velikih kiša i otopljenih snjegova žure prema moru. Mala Paklenica duga je dvanaest kilometara, široka četiristo do petsto metara, a Velika je duža dva kilometra. Ova dojmljiva kanjonska ljepota, bogatstvo i raznolikost šuma izvorišta bujičnih potoka Velike i Male Paklenice, proglašena je 1949. godine Nacionalnim parkom Paklenica na 95 četvornih kilometara površine. U zapadnom dijelu Parka Ribnička vrata, Javornik i Debelo brdo dominiraju iznad visoravni Velikog Rujna i Bojinca. Preko vrha Golić koji se nadvio nad Suhom dragom, udolinom Brezimenjača i u njoj skrivenim Ramićima i Parićima pogled nam seže prema sjevernoj granici nad kojom dominiraju Veli Golić, Malovan i Crljeni kuk. Iznad skrivenog i teško dostupnog kanjona potoka Male Paklenice stoje Jerkovac i Badalj s Velikim močilima. Preko Jerkovca iznad Ivanjske lokve po kosi Debelog brda penjemo se na mitsko Sveto brdo. Imati ga uz sebe, zvati ga svojim, pričati o njemu i družiti se s njim, povlastica je rijetkih. Pogled sa Svetoga brda svjedoči nam o veličini i pokazuje nam put kroz vrijeme u kojemu smo na trenutak zastali. U Ramićima smo osjetili tragove prošlih vremena. Na izvoru Stražbenica krenuli smo putem vode Golubinki. Slijedili smo njezin podzemni put u vruljama Modrič i Zečica. Pratili smo ćudljivi tok vode Velike Paklenice kroz godišnja doba. U Manitoj peći rasplamsali smo maštu. Od tisuću zabilježenih biljnih vrsta 79 ih je endemično. Penjači uz litice dijele mjesto s divokozama (Rupicapra rupicapra). Od razine mora pa do najviših visova u Nacionalnom parku Paklenica mnoge su životinjske vrste našle svoj dom.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories of sound, which are heard through the ears of a small but very active being called "sound collector", which has a passion for sound and all the concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he hears very poorly. This small being spends his days discovering and learning new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are the most common sounds of the sea, sounds that produce beings in the sea, the sounds produced by insects, including snoring his best friend and pet Marta. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just been three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the herd, he used to being all over his. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. In each episode, one day is shown in kindergarten. The daily routine of the only crazy toddler disrupts. Through various events and accidents, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki is a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanuts. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they fall into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem, they always invent a machine. The machine does not always work the way they imagined and emerge many humorous and unforeseen situations. / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije.

Each rhyme sings about the features of one character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

Serija prati zabavne pustolovine Pocoya i njegovih prijatelja, a svaka se epizoda bavi drugom temom. Veselo društvance kroz igru istražuje svijet i uči nove riječi i pojmove. I usput se dobro zabavlja. Četvrta sezona upoznaje nas s novim likom Ninom i njezinim kućnim ljubimcem robotom Robertom.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty -two -minute episodes of the series, you are waiting for unprecedented stories and posts: how to wash your paws with your puppy, how to feed it, how to put the laundry on drying and beat the clips, remove the dishes from the washing machine, prepare the orange juice, sweep the house, plant the plants in the garden, or to pack yourself for a trip. Spend the morning in the company of a two -year -old! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: Paklina created in smoke and fire, from the harbor squeezed, named the Velebit -deeply engraved scars below the Holy Hill. Canyons Mala and Velika Paklenica, twins Introduced by the water of her streams that rush to the sea for large rains and dissolved snow. Little Paklenica is twelve kilometers long, four hundred to five hundred meters wide, and a large one is two kilometers longer. This impressive canyon beauty, wealth and diversity of forests of the source of the Bujic streams of Velika and Mala Paklenica, was proclaimed in 1949 by the Paklenica National Park for 95 square kilometers of the area. In the western part of the Ribnica Gate Park, Javornik and Debelo Hill dominate above September and Bojinac Plateau. Through the Vrh Golić, who leaned over the dry Draga, the widow of Brezimenjak and in her hidden Ramići and Parići, our gaze extends toward the northern border over which Veli Golić, Malovan and Crkljen Kuk dominated. Above the hidden and hard -to -reach canyon of the Mali Paklenica creek are Jerkovac and Badalj with great mockes. Through Jerkovac above the Lokvani Lok, we climb the mythical Holy Hill on the hair of a thick hill. Having him with him, calling him, talk about him and hang out with him, the privilege is rare. The view from the Holy Hill testifies to us about the greatness and shows us the way through the time we stopped for a moment. In Ramići we felt traces of past times. At the Straženica source, we headed through the water of Golubinka. We followed her underground path in Vrulji Modrič and Bunny. We followed the whimsical flow of Velika Paklenica water through the seasons. In the manner furnace, we flared our imagination. Of the thousands of recorded plant species, 79 are endemic. The climbers by cliffs divide the place with the divocoses (Rupicapra Rupicapra). From the sea level to the highest highs in the Paklenica National Park, many animal species have found their home. / Paklina nastala u dimu i vatri, iz luča iscijeđena, dala je ime velebitskim duboko urezanim ožiljcima ispod Svetoga brda. Kanjoni Mala i Velika Paklenica, blizanci izdubljeni vodom njezinih potoka koji se za velikih kiša i otopljenih snjegova žure prema moru. Mala Paklenica duga je dvanaest kilometara, široka četiristo do petsto metara, a Velika je duža dva kilometra. Ova dojmljiva kanjonska ljepota, bogatstvo i raznolikost šuma izvorišta bujičnih potoka Velike i Male Paklenice, proglašena je 1949. godine Nacionalnim parkom Paklenica na 95 četvornih kilometara površine. U zapadnom dijelu Parka Ribnička vrata, Javornik i Debelo brdo dominiraju iznad visoravni Velikog Rujna i Bojinca. Preko vrha Golić koji se nadvio nad Suhom dragom, udolinom Brezimenjača i u njoj skrivenim Ramićima i Parićima pogled nam seže prema sjevernoj granici nad kojom dominiraju Veli Golić, Malovan i Crljeni kuk. Iznad skrivenog i teško dostupnog kanjona potoka Male Paklenice stoje Jerkovac i Badalj s Velikim močilima. Preko Jerkovca iznad Ivanjske lokve po kosi Debelog brda penjemo se na mitsko Sveto brdo. Imati ga uz sebe, zvati ga svojim, pričati o njemu i družiti se s njim, povlastica je rijetkih. Pogled sa Svetoga brda svjedoči nam o veličini i pokazuje nam put kroz vrijeme u kojemu smo na trenutak zastali. U Ramićima smo osjetili tragove prošlih vremena. Na izvoru Stražbenica krenuli smo putem vode Golubinki. Slijedili smo njezin podzemni put u vruljama Modrič i Zečica. Pratili smo ćudljivi tok vode Velike Paklenice kroz godišnja doba. U Manitoj peći rasplamsali smo maštu. Od tisuću zabilježenih biljnih vrsta 79 ih je endemično. Penjači uz litice dijele mjesto s divokozama (Rupicapra rupicapra). Od razine mora pa do najviših visova u Nacionalnom parku Paklenica mnoge su životinjske vrste našle svoj dom.

programme.title: Eternal Comedy cycle: Funny things happened on the way to forum / Vječni ciklus komedije: Smiješne su se stvari dogodile na putu za Forum

Jessel) on a shorter trip outside the city, hoping that the moment has finally arrived to gain long -desired freedom. The road to her leads him through Senex's son Hero (M. Crawford), a mad in love with beautiful slave Philia (A. Andre). But her owner, an early Lycus (P. Silvers), who in the neighborhood he runs a lucrative job of trading young women, promised her to the war hero Miles Gloriosus (L. Greene). The pseudolous therefore proposes an unhappy in love with Herou firmly a firm agreement: The pseudolous will do his best to get Hero to his beloved Philia despite Lycus' promise, and the young slave will give him freedom in return. The cunning slave soon convinced Lycus that Philia had an infectious disease and when everything was done to flow according to plan, Senex suddenly returned to the city and very prone to a rabbit slave ... / Najljeniji rob u starom Rimu Pseudolous (Z. Crawford), ludo zaljubljenog u lijepu robinju Philiju (A. Andre). No, njezin ju je vlasnik, prijetvorni Lycus (P. Silvers) koji u susjedstvu vodi unosan posao trgovanja mladim ženama, još otprije obećao ratnom junaku Milesu Gloriousu (L. Greene). Pseudolous stoga predloži nesretno zaljubljenom Herou čvrst dogovor: Pseudolous će učiniti sve kako bi Hero unatoč Lycusovom obećanju došao do voljene Philije, a mladi će mu robovlasnik zauzvrat dati slobodu. Lukavi rob ubrzo uvjeri Lycusa da Philia ima zaraznu bolest i kad se učini da sve teče po planu, u grad se iznenada vrati Senex i sam vrlo sklon zanosnoj robinji...

programme.title: Milijada

"It is not my curiosity, but the need _ life and work, for the love of God and man," Milialade will say for his art. As Milyalade creates, this documentary will reveal to us. / Milijada Barada je žena mora i kamena, boje i riječi. Iznimna pjesnikinja duha i slikarica snažnog kolorita u svojim stihovima i slikama izgara bez ostatka _ složit će se mnogi likovni i književni kritičari koji njezin rad prate već desetljećima. "To nije moja znatiželja, već potreba _ život i rad, za ljubav Boga i čovjeka", reći će za svoju umjetnost Milijada. Kako stvara Milijada, otkrit će nam ovaj dokumentarni film.

programme.title: Izvan formata
programme.desc: There is a magazine in Croatia where you will not find a single advertisement, a magazine whose texts are read several times, and each copy is kept on shelves among books. Tonight we talk about a project called "Kàko" tonight, which brings us back to the time when we enjoyed texts that require dedication and attention _ texts that bring stories about creative individuals, guardians of tradition, social phenomena and amazing places. In the studio, we talk to Nives Bosniak, Magazine editor, and Ivan Blagajic, the driver of this unique project. Vid Baric, Lucija Tunkovic, Kristina Gavran and Alen Maric also participate in the show. / U Hrvatskoj postoji magazin u kojem nećete naći ni jednu reklamu, magazin čiji se tekstovi čitaju više puta, a svaki primjerak čuva se na policama među knjigama. Večeras u emisiji razgovaramo o projektu pod nazivom "Kàko", koji nas vraća u vremena kad smo uživali u tekstovima koji zahtijevaju posvećenost i pažnju _ tekstovima koji donose priče o kreativnim pojedincima, čuvarima tradicije, društvenim fenomenima i začudnim mjestima. U studiju razgovaramo s Nives Bošnjak, urednicom magazina, i Ivanom Blagajićem, pokretačem ovog jedinstvenog projekta. U emisiji sudjeluju i Vid Barić, Lucija Tunković, Kristina Gavran i Alen Marić.

programme.title: Groznica
programme.desc: The episode explores that these glittering goods have shaped the foundations of many economies and that the dedicated search for it influenced the course of human history. From the minatersraSrand pool from the mining flourishing, where 40 % of the world gold, to the "Golden Mili" mine in Western Australia, has been excavated, we explore that the search for gold has transformed landscapes and communities. From its beginnings and key roles in ancient civilizations, to the future of gold excavation in the ocean, and amateur hunters on gold that continue to be enriched, we explore why gold drives us to move the borders and exploration of new appetizers in our continuous search for this precious metal. / Epizoda istražuje kako je ova svjetlucava roba oblikovala temelje mnogih ekonomija te kako je predano traganje za njom utjecalo na tijek ljudske povijesti. Od rudarskog procvata u bazenu Witwatersrand, gdje je iskopano 40 % svjetskog zlata, do rudnika "Zlatne milje" u zapadnoj Australiji, istražujemo kako je potraga za zlatom preoblikovala krajolike i zajednice. Od svojih početaka i ključne uloge u drevnim civilizacijama, do budućnosti iskapanja zlata u oceanu te amaterskih lovaca na zlato koji se i dalje uspijevaju obogatiti, istražujemo zašto nas zlato tjera na pomicanje granica i istraživanje novih predjela u našoj neprekidnoj potrazi za tim dragocjenim metalom.

programme.title: Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: In the mountain border towards Slovenia, people who live there create an idyll associated with a lot of work and conscious renunciation. Tradition of the Janezic family from St. Jacob in Rosental, that is, Sentjakoba V Roz, can be traced back to the beginning of the 16th century, the Čertov family from the village of Zell Pfarre, that is, Sele-Fare, lives from sheep and bees as well as sheep and bees, in Arnoldstein the church year is celebrated, while in the nearby border triangle, in which they meet Italy and Austria The Marion Pucher Mountaineering House welcomes cross -border mountaineers. / U planinskom pograničju prema Sloveniji ljudi koji ondje žive stvaraju idilu povezanu s mnogo rada i svjesnog odricanja. Tradicija obitelji Janežič iz St. Jakoba u Rosentalu, odnosno, Šentjakoba v Rožu, može se pratiti unatrag sve do početka 16. stoljeća, obitelj Čertov iz sela Zell Pfarre, odnosno, Sele-Fare, živi od ovaca i pčela kao i s ovcama i pčelama, u Arnoldsteinu se slavi crkveni god, dok u obližnjem graničnom trokutu, u kojem se sastaju Italija, Slovenija i Austrija, domaćica planinarskog doma Marion Pucher dočekuje prekogranične planinare.

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: The charismatic oeuvre of Brkan brothers, two true greats of contemporary Croatian photographs, are the foundation of the so -called Zadar schools of photography. Older brother Ante (1918-2004) in 1951 opens a photographic studio in Zadar. For the whole treasure trove of masterful works, he should not have traveled to unknown and exotic countries, seek sophisticated and aesthetic motives. He creates his works on the threshold of the family home and in the "calet" of his city. The value of these photos, far ahead of his time, was difficult to recognize at the time as a true masterpiece. Only when there were numerous awards at international photographic salons in the world, did we dare to say that the photo could be something else entirely, that the topic is irrelevant, and the motive is only an external form for multiple mean layers. / Karizmatski opusi braće Brkan, dvojice istinskih velikana suvremene hrvatske fotografije, temelj su tzv. zadarske škole fotografije. Stariji brat Ante (1918.-2004.) godine 1951. otvara fotografski atelijer u Zadru. Za cijelu riznicu majstorskih djela nije trebao putovati u nepoznate i egzotične zemlje, tražiti sofisticirane i estetizirane motive. Svoja djela on stvara na pragu obiteljskog doma i po "kaletama" svoga grada. Vrijednost tih fotografija, daleko ispred svoga vremena, bilo je tada teško prepoznati kao istinska remek-djela. Tek kada su na međunarodnim fotografskim salonima u svijetu osvojile brojne nagrade, usudili smo se ustvrditi da fotografija može biti i nešto sasvim drugo, da je tema nebitna, a motiv tek vanjska forma za mnogostruke značenjske slojeve.

programme.title: Opera Selecta Festival: Soloists Bolt theater - Kamerlengo Fortress in Trogir / Festival Opera Selecta: Solisti Boljšoj teatra - Tvrđava Kamerlengo u Trogiru
programme.desc: The thirteenth edition of the important classical music festival and the cultural and music brand of the city of Trogir _ Opera Selecta brings us the opera gala concert from 2021, whose recording of HRT displays, which featured the stars of Bolšoj Theater. These are: Olga Seliverstova (Soprano), Svetlana Shilova (Mezzo -soprano) and Konstantin Shushakov (Bariton) with the piano support of the prominent Croatian pianist Vesna Podrug Kossjanenko. The most famous opera arias, duets and solo songs of N. Roman-Korsakova, P. I. Tchaikovsky, C. Gounoda, G. Donizetti, F. Lehara, J. Offenbach and G. Bizet performed for the Trogir audience. The Opera Selecta Festival has been moving to one of the most prestigious summer music events in the Adriatic, and the fort or tower of Kamerlengo has hosted dozens of top performers. / Trinaesto izdanje važnog festivala klasične glazbe i kulturno-glazbeni brend grada Trogira _ Opera Selecta, donosi nam operni gala koncert iz 2021., čiju snimku HRT prikazuje, a na kojemu su nastupile zvijezde Boljšoj teatra. To su: Olga Seliverstova (sopran), Svetlana Shilova (mezzosopran) te Konstantin Shushakov (bariton) uz glasovirsku podršku istaknute hrvatske pijanistice Vesne Podrug Kossjanenko. Za trogirsku publiku izveli su najpoznatije operne arije, duete i solo pjesme N. Rimski-Korsakova, P. I. Čajkovskog, C. Gounoda, G. Donizettija, F. Lehara, J. Offenbacha i G. Bizeta. Festival Opera Selecta prometnuo se u jedan od najprestižnijih ljetnih glazbenih događaja na Jadranu, a tvrđava ili kula Kamerlengo ugostila je na desetke vrhunskih izvođača.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: Guest is one of the most important and read French writers Leila Slimani. Honestly and without hesitation, he will explain to us why identity perceives as a moral and ethical question. How did she answer the question _ who am I? What detects us more, our social status or national identity? Why was her own family served as an inspiration for the trilogy "in the country of others" and why did she decide to tell that story of Morocco? How to look at the immigrant policy of the European Union and what are the mistakes of integration? Why doesn't it matter that others love her? What is it like to live in the country of others is a question that gives us a reason to talk to Leil Slimani. / Gošća je jedna od najvažnijih i najčitanijih francuskih književnica Leila Slimani. Iskreno i bez zadrške objasnit će nam zašto identit doživljava kao moralno i etičko pitanje. Kako je sebi odgovorila na pitanje _ tko sam ja? Što nas više određuje, naš socijalni status ili nacionalni identitet? Zašto joj je kao inspiracija za trilogiju "U zemlji drugih" poslužila vlastita obitelj i zašto je odlučila ispričati baš tu priču o Maroku? Kako gleda na imigrantsku politiku Europske unije i koje su greške integracije? Zašto joj nije važno da je drugi vole? Kako je živjeti u zemlji drugih, pitanje je koje nam daje razlog za razgovor s Leilom Slimani.

programme.title: Kolibrić
programme.desc: Nonlinear story about Marca Carrere's life, which stretches for sixty years. Although the tragedies and various adversity, Marco manages to avoid chaos in their environment, such as the colibrator, focusing all its energy to "stand in place". The shop includes three generations of one family, whose life stories are overrated by the experiences of happiness, excitement, but also disappointments and pain. / Nelinearna priča o životu Marca Carrere, koja se proteže na šezdeset godina. Iako ga prate tragedije i razne nedaće, Marco uspijeva izbjeći kaos u svom okruženju, poput kolibrića, fokusirajući svu svoju energiju na to da "stoji na mjestu". Radnja obuhvaća tri generacije jedne obitelji, čije su životne priče premrežene iskustvima sreće, uzbuđenja, ali i razočarenja i boli.

programme.title: Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: The closest to the sky, illuminated by the sun, Milovan clouds worn winds, with thunder scars, locked snow in the wild in which only a few survive. Full of large stone blocks of desolate and impassable paths, pushed by dense forests and meadows, hidden widows and pits, North Velebit National Park with its 109 kilometers of square mystical and remembered niches to those who find peace in the listening of silence. programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed.
