programme.title: Svijet jazza
programme.desc: As Cuba marked American culture in its entirety, Cuban music has been registered with jazz history since his early days. Today, the Afrokuban jazz is one of his great genres and one of the two pillars of the music continent named Latin Jazz, and the pianist Gonzalo Rubalcab is among his leading representatives, but also the most famous jazz-pivnists in general. He began to show the unusual tendency of Rubalcab music at the youngest age, so as a six -year -old he played drums in the orchestra of Father Guillermo. Zarana labeled as a miracle of a child, Rubalcabs will attract the attention of one of the greatest popularizers of the Afrokububan jazz and jazz _ Dizzy Gillespie, who will invite him to play with him, in the mid -1980s. Shortly thereafter, another key encounter will happen _ The one with the consistent Charlie Haden, which will significantly mark Rubalcab's musical path. Since then, Rubalcaba will achieve a glittering record and concert career, with a number of notable release from Cuban and the wider tradition of jazz such as "Nocturni" and "Land of the Sun" album. The last major recognition of Rubalcabi arrived for the album "Skyline" from 2021, which he recorded with two jazz greats Jack Dejohnette and Ron Carter. It is accompanied by an excellent "Turning Point/Trio Dete", which was joined by a great Matt Brewer and Eric Harland. In addition to Ernest Simpson as a replacement for Harland on drums, Rubalcaba presented his impressive music in early July and at a small Roman theater in Pula. / Kao što je Kuba obilježila američku kulturu u cijelosti, kubanska glazba upisana je u povijest jazza od njegovih ranih dana. Danas je afrokubanski jazz jedan od njegovih velikih žanrova i jedan od dva stupa glazbenog kontinenta po imenu Latin jazz, a pijanist Gonzalo Rubalcaba među njegovim je vodećim predstavnicima, ali i najpoznatijim jazz-pijanistima općenito. Neobičnu sklonost glazbi Rubalcaba je počeo pokazivati u najmlađoj dobi, pa je već kao šestogodišnjak zasvirao bubnjeve u orkestru oca Guillerma. Zarana označen kao čudo od djeteta, Rubalcaba će sredinom osamdesetih u Havani privući pažnju jednog od najvećih popularizatora afrokubanskog jazza i ikone jazza _ Dizzyja Gillespieja, koji će ga pozvati da s njim zasvira. Ubrzo nakon toga dogodit će se još jedan ključan susret _ onaj s konstrabasistom Charliejem Hadenom, koji će bitno obilježiti Rubalcabin glazbeni put. Otad će Rubalcaba ostvariti blistavu diskografsku i koncertnu karijeru, uz niz zapaženih izdanja izniklih iz kubanske, ali i šire tradicije jazza poput albuma "Nocturne" i "Land of the Sun". Posljednje veliko priznanje Rubalcabi je stiglo za album "Skyline" iz 2021., koji je snimio s dvama velikanima jazza Jackom DeJohnetteom i Ronom Carterom. Na njega se nadovezuje izvrsni "Turning Point/Trio Dete", na kojem su mu se pridružili sjajni Matt Brewer i Eric Harland. Uz Ernesta Simpsona kao zamjenu za Harlanda na bubnjevima, Rubalcaba je svoju impresivnu glazbu predstavio početkom srpnja i u Malom rimskom kazalištu u Puli.

programme.title: Monika Leskovar and HRT Symphony Orchestra under the direction of Pascal Rophea - KD V. Lisinski / Monika Leskovar i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Pascala Rophea - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: The HRT Symphony Orchestra opens the new season of the master cycle under the guidance of Maestro Pascal Rophe, who, with this concert, begins his second term of the chief of conductor of the esteemed orchestra. The program begins with the Singing Song of Slava (Chant du Rossignol) Igor Stravinsky, derived from his opera Slavuj (1914). Stravinski's contemporary and countryman Sergei Rahmanjin's second symphony returned his faith in a composer call after a catastrophic failure of the first symphony of 1897 and the severe creative crisis that followed. Another symphony, intended for the large composition of the symphony orchestra, with as many as three instruments each in most width sections and an extended group of percussion, contains an abundance of beautiful, swollen romantic music, but at the same time a masterfully controlled tension that is released in the magnificent final. The concert soloist is one of our most awarded cellist, Monika Leskovar, who, as a thirteen -year -old, became the youngest winner of the International Tchaikovsky Competition in Japan (1995). Rich in international careers, today he teaches at the Academy of Music in Zagreb and always gladly returns to the HRT Symphony Orchestra, and on this occasion in the interpretation of the variation on the Rokoko Theme of Petra Iljic Tchaikovsky. Although his role model were classic forms and type of orchestra from Hayn's time, Petar Iljic Tchaikovsky created more than a virtuosic and romantic gorgeous work with a prose rococo theme and complex variations in his variations. / Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a otvara novu sezonu Majstorskog ciklusa pod vodstvom maestra Pascala Rophea koji ovim koncertom počinje svoj drugi mandat šefa dirigenta cijenjenog orkestra. Program počinje simfonijskom pjesmom Pjev slavuja (Chant du rossignol) Igora Stravinskog, proizašlom iz njegove opere Slavuj (1914.). Stravinskijev suvremenik i zemljak Sergej Rahmanjinov Drugom simfonijom vratio je svoju vjeru u skladateljski poziv nakon katastrofalnog neuspjeha Prve simfonije 1897. i teške stvaralačke krize koja je uslijedila. Druga simfonija, namijenjena velikom sastavu simfonijskog orkestra, s čak po tri instrumenta u većini puhačkih sekcija i proširenom skupinom udaraljki, sadrži obilje predivne, nabujale romantičarske glazbe, ali i istovremeno majstorski kontroliranu napetost koja se oslobađa u veličanstvenom finalu. Solistica na koncertu je jedna od naših najnagrađivanijih violončelistica, Monika Leskovar, koja je kao trinaestogodišnjakinja postala najmlađa pobjednica Međunarodnog natjecanja Čajkovski u Japanu (1995.). Bogate međunarodne karijere, danas predaje na Muzičkoj akademiji u Zagrebu te se uvijek rado vraća pred Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a, a ovom prigodom u interpretaciji Varijacija na rokoko temu Petra Iljiča Čajkovskog. Iako su mu uzor bile klasične forme i tip orkestra iz Haydnova doba, Petar Iljič Čajkovski u svojim je Varijacijama stvorio više nego virtuozno i romantičarski raskošno djelo s prpošnom rokoko temom i kompleksnim varijacijama.

programme.desc: Ballet Sergei Prokofiev in the choreography of Leo Mujić, April 26, 2025, HNK Ivan pl. Rijeka. The first ballet prime minister in the Rijeka mandate of Intendant Dubravka Vrgoc returns to the "city flowing" by his favorite choreographer Leo Mujic, to whom this is the fourth play with the Rijeka ballet. Wanting to find something known and attractive, which would return to Rijeka children on stage and ballerina "on the spots", select the Neoclassical Ballet of Sergei Prokofiev according to the famous story of Charles Perrault _ Cinderella _ premiered on the Moscow Podium of the Moscow Theater in 1945. Mangiole, who will soon give place to her colleague Leonard Jakovina. But the point is that he started the back of the dance "on the spikes", opening a series of auditions for new dancers. Here we get to know the old and new stars of the ensemble, these are Marta Voinea Cavrak (half -sister Zorica), Yurik Kimura (Ella/Cinderella), Leonard Cel (John/Prince) and Marta Kanazir (Cindy/Mother), as well as a number of children from Rijeka's dance schools. For the first time in Croatia, a young Belgian, otherwise chief Dirigent of the Ljubljana Opera, Maestro Ayrton Despelaere. / Balet Sergeja Prokofjeva u koreografiji Lea Mujića, 26. travnja 2025., HNK Ivana pl. Zajca Rijeka. Prva baletna premijera u riječkom mandatu intendantice Dubravke Vrgoč vraća u "grad koji teče" omiljenog koreografa Lea Mujića kojemu je ovo četvrta predstava s Riječkim baletom. Želeći naći nešto svima poznato i privlačno, što bi vratilo u Rijeku djecu na scenu i balerine "na špice", odabiru neoklasični balet Sergeja Prokofjeva prema poznatoj priči Charlesa Perraulta _ Pepeljugu _ praizvedenu na podiju moskovskoga Boljšoj teatra godine 1945. To je prvo predstavljanje novog, a sada već bivšeg ravnatelja Riječkog baleta, Talijana Paola Mangiole, koji će uskoro ustupiti mjesto kolegi Leonardu Jakovini. Ali bit je da je pokrenuo povratak plesa "na špicama" otvorivši niz audicija za nove plesače. Tu upoznajemo stare i nove zvijezde ansambla, to su Marta Voinea Čavrak (polusestra Zorica), Yurika Kimura (Ella/Pepeljuga), Leonard Cela (John/Princ) i Marta Kanazir (Cindy/Majka), ali i niz djece iz riječkih plesnih škola. Orkestrom prvi put u Hrvatskoj ravna mladi Belgijanac, inače šef-dirigent Ljubljanske opere, maestro Ayrton Desimpelaere.

programme.title: Svijet jazza
programme.desc: As Cuba marked American culture in its entirety, Cuban music has been registered with jazz history since his early days. Today, the Afrokuban jazz is one of his great genres and one of the two pillars of the music continent named Latin Jazz, and the pianist Gonzalo Rubalcab is among his leading representatives, but also the most famous jazz-pivnists in general. He began to show the unusual tendency of Rubalcab music at the youngest age, so as a six -year -old he played drums in the orchestra of Father Guillermo. Zarana labeled as a miracle of a child, Rubalcabs will attract the attention of one of the greatest popularizers of the Afrokububan jazz and jazz _ Dizzy Gillespie, who will invite him to play with him, in the mid -1980s. Shortly thereafter, another key encounter will happen _ The one with the consistent Charlie Haden, which will significantly mark Rubalcab's musical path. Since then, Rubalcaba will achieve a glittering record and concert career, with a number of notable release from Cuban and the wider tradition of jazz such as "Nocturni" and "Land of the Sun" album. The last major recognition of Rubalcabi arrived for the album "Skyline" from 2021, which he recorded with two jazz greats Jack Dejohnette and Ron Carter. It is accompanied by an excellent "Turning Point/Trio Dete", which was joined by a great Matt Brewer and Eric Harland. In addition to Ernest Simpson as a replacement for Harland on drums, Rubalcaba presented his impressive music in early July and at a small Roman theater in Pula. / Kao što je Kuba obilježila američku kulturu u cijelosti, kubanska glazba upisana je u povijest jazza od njegovih ranih dana. Danas je afrokubanski jazz jedan od njegovih velikih žanrova i jedan od dva stupa glazbenog kontinenta po imenu Latin jazz, a pijanist Gonzalo Rubalcaba među njegovim je vodećim predstavnicima, ali i najpoznatijim jazz-pijanistima općenito. Neobičnu sklonost glazbi Rubalcaba je počeo pokazivati u najmlađoj dobi, pa je već kao šestogodišnjak zasvirao bubnjeve u orkestru oca Guillerma. Zarana označen kao čudo od djeteta, Rubalcaba će sredinom osamdesetih u Havani privući pažnju jednog od najvećih popularizatora afrokubanskog jazza i ikone jazza _ Dizzyja Gillespieja, koji će ga pozvati da s njim zasvira. Ubrzo nakon toga dogodit će se još jedan ključan susret _ onaj s konstrabasistom Charliejem Hadenom, koji će bitno obilježiti Rubalcabin glazbeni put. Otad će Rubalcaba ostvariti blistavu diskografsku i koncertnu karijeru, uz niz zapaženih izdanja izniklih iz kubanske, ali i šire tradicije jazza poput albuma "Nocturne" i "Land of the Sun". Posljednje veliko priznanje Rubalcabi je stiglo za album "Skyline" iz 2021., koji je snimio s dvama velikanima jazza Jackom DeJohnetteom i Ronom Carterom. Na njega se nadovezuje izvrsni "Turning Point/Trio Dete", na kojem su mu se pridružili sjajni Matt Brewer i Eric Harland. Uz Ernesta Simpsona kao zamjenu za Harlanda na bubnjevima, Rubalcaba je svoju impresivnu glazbu predstavio početkom srpnja i u Malom rimskom kazalištu u Puli.

programme.title: Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: In the first episode, we embark on geological sides with the beautiful Slavonian mountain of Papuk. With the help of scientists, our professional guides, we get to know the exceptional geological, biological and cultural and historical heritage of this mountain. What at first glance was just a piece of rock will suddenly bring us back to the Cambria period, 450 million years back, to a global event of a sudden development of life. Following the clues, we climb the time ladder and travel for millions of years of geological past. From the rest of the ancient volcanoes, through strong tectonic movements, to traces of the Pannonian Sea. Along the way we meet the famous Charug, we also visit the Geo-Info Center in Voćin through a sensational virtual walk through the geological wealth of this area. In the House of Pannonian Sea in the Great, in the attractive lineup, we also meet Carcharodon Megalodon, a twenty -meter shark that swam in the former Pannonian Sea. And so step by step, millions of years long, in the youngest tufa deposits we will see the nose of the benign Diva Regoc. Finally, we will rest at one of the most beautiful natural spaces of Papuk, in the Gorski Kotar Valley Jankovac. / U prvoj epizodi krećemo na geološke skitnje predivnom slavonskom planinom Papuk. Uz pomoć znanstvenika, naših stručnih vodiča, upoznajemo iznimnu geološku, biološku i kulturno-povijesnu baštinu ove planine. Ono što nam je na prvi pogled bio tek komad stijene odjednom će nas vratiti u razdoblje kambrija, 450 milijuna godina unatrag, u globalni događaj naglog razvoja života. Slijedeći tragove penjemo se vremenskom ljestvicom i putujemo milijunima godina geološke prošlosti. Od ostatka drevnih vulkana, preko snažnih tektonskih pokreta, do tragova Panonskoga mora. Na putu susrećemo i znamenitog Čarugu, posjećujemo i Geo-info centar u Voćinu kroz senzacionalnu virtualnu šetnju geološkim bogatstvom ovoga kraja. U Kući Panonskoga mora u Velikoj, u atraktivnom postavu susrećemo i carcharodon megalodona, dvadesetmetarskoga morskoga psa koji je plivao u nekadašnjem Panonskom moru. I tako korak po korak, dugačak milijune godina, u najmlađim naslagama sedre ugledat ćemo nos dobroćudnoga diva Regoča. Za kraj, odmorit ćemo se na jednom od najljepših prirodnih prostora Papuka, u gorskoj dolini Jankovac.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelj, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.desc: OGGY OGGY is a computer animated series for the preschool age of the author Jean Cayrol and Cedrica Gunerry, the series follows a kitten Ogya who embarks on an adventure with friends of Mallow and Sporty into the world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Number Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines which number they carry. The series helps young children easier to learn to count and solve simple mathematical tasks. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Praščić" is a British animated TV series for preschool children. This long -standing series for children is accompanied by the events and accidents of Peppe and her friends, her brother George, their parents and other animal families living in their city. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that foists the vitalness of childhood. In age, when small bunnies (like small children) are studying in people and experience challenges in relation to their parents, they move to school, learn generally about the world, they face authorities and, of course, learn their language. Children can take Simon for an example of taking care of himself, I can learn from him and from his incompetents, from situations where simon needs to give in in his insistence and spoiling, and always remain polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on books Stephanie Blake in the edition of the French publisher Lecole des loisirs. He was directed by the TV series Julien Cayot, and it was produced by Go-N Productions. The series in France had Prime Minister 17. December 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Farmer chaos invention a machine that helps him pack agricultural products in steam numbers. But the machine loses control! Even animals cannot escape from his frantic classification. The numerals run to help and are used by steam and odd numbers to save the thing. / Farmer Kaos izumi stroj koji mu pomaže pakirati poljoprivredne proizvode u parnim brojevima. Ali stroj izgubi kontrolu! Čak ni životinje ne mogu pobjeći od njegovog pomahnitalog razvrstavanja. Brojčići dotrče u pomoć te se koriste parnim i neparnim brojevima kako bi spasili stvar.

programme.title: Pjesmica Brokula

programme.title: Up to the wine / Fino i vino
programme.desc: In the new edition, we explore the Gora, its natural beauties and local customs, with Cvicek Mobil. We visited Mimes in Zagreb, a new place on a Bundek whose concept can be described as an Italian-Croatian Bistrology. Numerous workshops, panels, presentations, dinners and culinary shows with top chefs and experts from the world of enogastronomy and tourism were held at this year's Taste The Mediterranean Festival in Mali Lošinj. We discover the richness and diversity of the Zadar region through its main symbols and trump cards, which offer visitors the best throughout the year. We also bring an exclusive report with preparation for one of the most famous culinary competitions in the world _ Bocuse Dor. / U novom izdanju istražujemo Tršku goru, njezine prirodne ljepote i lokalne običaje _ i to uz Cviček mobil. U Zagrebu smo posjetili Mimes, novo mjesto na Bundeku čiji se koncept može opisati kao talijansko-hrvatska bistrologija. Na ovogodišnjem festivalu Taste the Mediterranean u Malom Lošinju održane su brojne radionice, paneli, prezentacije, večere i kulinarski showovi uz vrhunske kuhare te stručnjake iz svijeta enogastronomije i turizma. Bogatstvo i raznolikost zadarske regije otkrivamo kroz njezine glavne simbole i adute, koji posjetiteljima nude ono najbolje tijekom cijele godine. Donosimo i ekskluzivni izvještaj s priprema za jedno od najpoznatijih kulinarskih natjecanja na svijetu _ Bocuse dOr.

programme.title: Studio 4: Diagnosis / Studio 4: Dijagnoza
programme.desc: What is the syndrome of baking your mouth? How is it diagnosed? It is very interesting that this phenomenon is widespread while little is said about it. Let's find out more about the appearance, symptoms and ways of therapy. On the show, we talk to the guest prof. Ph.D. Ivan Alajbeg from the Faculty of Dental Medicine, University of Zagreb. / Što je to sindrom pekućih usta? Kako se dijagnosticira? Vrlo je zanimljivo kako je ta pojava raširena, dok se istodobno o njoj malo govori. Doznajmo više o pojavnosti, simptomima i načinima terapije. U emisiji o tome razgovaramo s gostom prof. dr. sc. Ivanom Alajbegom sa Stomatološkog fakulteta Sveučilišta u Zagrebu.

programme.title: Otvoreno
programme.desc: After the great tragedy in Slovenia and the death of three Croatian mountaineers, we talk to experts from Croatia and Slovenia: How did the accident occur? What kind of mountain field was it and what danger do they lurk on the tops of the mountains? What can be done to make risks minimize and hiking more secure? Guests: Marko Andric, Head of the Croatian Mountain Rescue Service (HGSS) Darko Berljak, President of the Croatian Mountaineering Association Stipe Bozic, Alpinist and HGSS member, Duplex Studio Split Klemen Belhar, Vice President of the Savior Savior Slovenia, Duplex Studio Ljubljana / Nakon velike tragedije u Sloveniji i pogibije tri hrvatska planinara razgovaramo sa stručnjacima iz Hrvatske i Slovenije: Kako je došlo do nesreće? O kakvom se planinskom terenu radilo i koje opasnosti vrebaju na vrhovima planina? Što se može učiniti da se rizici minimiziraju i planinarenje učini sigurnijim? programme.title: Romano Bolkovic - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: With guest Gordan Kolak, we talk about how Koncar managed to grow 21 quarterly in a row, despite global disorders and challenges, and what were the most critical moments during this period and key decisions that made continuity. We are talking about his lead of leadership of 2019, the first moves and knowledge, as well as what he would do otherwise today, with more experience. In the show, we discover that Koncar has reached a level where more than 70% of revenue comes from foreign markets, such as the tactic of entering demanding markets such as Germany, Scandinavia, Saudi Arabia _ and how an ambitious expansion in the US develops. We also discuss the transformation of the organization's mentality with a long industrial tradition and ways of motivating employees to accept changes. We also touched on business scaning issues with a book of orders of 2 billion euros, adjustments to internal systems and challenges of maintenance and deadlines. We are talking about strategic projects _ from tram and trains to transformer for Saudi Arabia and the first battery electric motor train _ and which of them Kolak sees them as a turning point for Koncar. We are especially involved in investments worth more than 85 million euros in the last five years and plans for an additional 80+ million, as well as the logic and criteria of investment decisions. We find out why Koncar does not follow trends in the field of sustainability and ESG, but leads them, and how it positions in the context of the global green transition _ as a manufacturer, integrator and innovator. We also discuss global political-economic challenges _ market fragmentation, customs barriers and tensions between the EU, the US and China _ and the strategies to relieve these risks. Particular emphasis is placed on Končar _ Digital, the goals of this project, digitization and artificial intelligence in energy, maintenance and production. We find out how difficult it is to find and maintain top engineers in Croatia today, how Koncar resolves this challenge, but also how foreign workforce and different cultures integrate. We also asked him what he would say to those who claim that Croatia no longer has a serious industry, and what he would change in cooperation with the domestic industry and the state, the legislative and fiscal framework. On a personal level, Kolak reveals that his experience from the Homeland War and the UN missions forms his style of leadership and decisions in crises. And there are sports lessons _ triathlon endurance, planning and mental strength _ used in guiding Koncar and maintaining a balance in the demanding role of the leader. Gordan Kolak, CEO of Koncar d.d., graduated from the Faculty of Technical at the University of Rijeka and received his master's degree from the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture, University of Zagreb. During his professional career, he develops intensively knowledge and skills in the field of strategic organizations, as well as in the field of national and homeland security, through university education and later training on prestigious American and European civil and military colleges. He is an expert in the business, financial and organizational restructuring of complex business systems with exceptional management and consulting experience, which he confirms with the successful management of his own consulting company focused on business consultations in the ICT solution, strategic planning, implementation, control and corporate management and audit. He developed and applied his professional experiences as director and CEO of DOK-ING (robotic special-purpose machinery), King ICT (ICT system integration), megatrend (ICT distribution), megatrend business solutions (ICT solutions) and transmission lines. In 2019, he was appointed Deputy President, and in 2020 CEO Končar d.d. As a leading man, he conducted a comprehensive restructuring of the company with the aim of strengthening the segment of renewable energy and digital and advanced technological solutions. In doing so, revenues, profit, profit margin and newly reached jobs reached the highest levels in the history of the group. Particular emphasis puts on internationalization of business, modernization of production capacity, digital transformation, investment in research and development, and strengthening corporate culture and organization resistance. Under his leadership, Koncar positioned himself as the largest Croatian net exporter and leader of technological innovations in the region, with a clear focus on sustainability and digital transition. As a member of the Armed Forces of the Republic of Croatia, he actively participated in the Homeland War and the development of the defense system. He also participated in the UN peacekeeping mission in Sierra Leone, and is still active in the development of the national security and defense system of the Republic of Croatia. He served as president of the Croatian Association of Business Advisers and lecturers at the Zagreb School of Economics and Management. From 2015 to 2020 he was the secretary of the Homeland Security Council of the President of the Republic of Croatia. In addition, he is an active member of numerous business associations. Gordan is a feature / S gostom Gordanom Kolakom razgovaramo o tome kako je Končar uspio ostvariti rast 21 kvartal zaredom, unatoč globalnim poremećajima i izazovima, te koji su bili najkritičniji trenuci u tom razdoblju i ključne odluke koje su omogućile kontinuitet. Govorimo o njegovom preuzimanju vodstva 2019., prvim potezima i spoznajama, kao i o tome što bi danas, s više iskustva, napravio drugačije. U emisiji otkrivamo kako je Končar dosegnuo razinu na kojoj više od 70% prihoda dolazi s inozemnih tržišta, kakva je bila taktika ulaska na zahtjevna tržišta poput Njemačke, Skandinavije, Saudijske Arabije _ i kako se razvija ambiciozna ekspanzija u SAD-u. Razgovaramo i o transformaciji mentaliteta organizacije s dugom industrijskom tradicijom, te načinima motiviranja zaposlenika da prihvate promjene. Dotaknuli smo se i pitanja skaliranja poslovanja s knjigom narudžbi težom od 2 milijarde eura, prilagodbi internih sustava te izazova održavanja kvalitete i rokova. Govorimo o strateškim projektima _ od tramvaja i vlakova do transformatora za Saudijsku Arabiju i prvog baterijskog elektromotornog vlaka _ i o tome koji od njih Kolak vidi kao prekretnicu za Končar. Posebno se bavimo ulaganjima vrijednim više od 85 milijuna eura u posljednjih pet godina i planovima za dodatnih 80+ milijuna, kao i logikom i kriterijima investicijskih odluka. Saznajemo zašto Končar u području održivosti i ESG-a ne prati trendove, već ih predvodi, te kako se pozicionira u kontekstu globalne zelene tranzicije _ kao proizvođač, integrator i inovator. Razgovaramo i o globalnim političko-ekonomskim izazovima _ fragmentaciji tržišta, carinskim barijerama i napetostima između EU-a, SAD-a i Kine _ te strategijama za ublažavanje tih rizika. Poseban naglasak stavljamo na Končar _ Digital, ciljeve tog projekta, digitalizaciju i umjetnu inteligenciju u energetici, održavanju i proizvodnji. Saznajemo koliko je danas teško pronaći i zadržati vrhunske inženjere u Hrvatskoj, kako Končar rješava taj izazov, ali i kako se integriraju strana radna snaga i različite kulture. Pitali smo ga i što bi poručio onima koji tvrde da Hrvatska više nema ozbiljnu industriju, te što bi mijenjao u suradnji domaće industrije i države, zakonodavnom i fiskalnom okviru. Na osobnoj razini, Kolak otkriva kako njegovo iskustvo iz Domovinskog rata i UN-ovih misija oblikuje njegov stil liderstva i odluke u krizama. A tu su i sportske lekcije _ triatlonska izdržljivost, planiranje i mentalna snaga _ koje koristi u vođenju Končara i održavanju ravnoteže u zahtjevnoj ulozi lidera. Gordan Kolak, predsjednik uprave Končara d.d., diplomirao je na Tehničkom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Rijeci, a magistrirao na Fakultetu strojarstva i brodogradnje Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. Tijekom svoje profesionalne karijere intenzivno razvija znanja i vještine na području strateškog upravljanja organizacijama, kao i u području nacionalne i domovinske sigurnosti, kroz sveučilišno obrazovanje i kasnije usavršavanje na prestižnim američkim i europskim civilnim i vojnim učilištima. Stručnjak je za poslovno, financijsko i organizacijsko restrukturiranje složenih poslovnih sustava s iznimnim menadžerskim i konzultantskim iskustvom, koje potvrđuje uspješnim vođenjem vlastite konzultantske tvrtke usmjerene na poslovno savjetovanje u području ICT rješenja, strateškog planiranja, implementacije, nadzora te korporativnog upravljanja i revizije. Svoja profesionalna iskustva razvijao je i primjenjivao kao direktor i predsjednik Uprava tvrtki DOK-ING (robotizirani strojevi za posebne namjene), King ICT (integracija ICT sustava), Megatrend (ICT distribucija), Megatrend poslovna rješenja (ICT rješenja) te Dalekovod proizvodnja. Godine 2019. imenovan je zamjenikom predsjednika, a 2020. predsjednikom Uprave tvrtke KONČAR d.d. Kao čelni čovjek proveo je sveobuhvatno restrukturiranje kompanije s ciljem jačanja segmenta obnovljivih izvora energije te digitalnih i naprednih tehnoloških rješenja. Pritom su prihodi, dobit, profitna marža i novougovoreni poslovi dosegli najveće razine u povijesti Grupe. Poseban naglasak stavlja na internacionalizaciju poslovanja, modernizaciju proizvodnih kapaciteta, digitalnu transformaciju, ulaganja u istraživanje i razvoj te jačanje korporativne kulture i otpornosti organizacije. Pod njegovim vodstvom KONČAR se pozicionirao kao najveći hrvatski neto izvoznik i predvodnik tehnoloških inovacija u regiji, s jasnim fokusom na održivost i digitalnu tranziciju. Kao pripadnik Oružanih snaga Republike Hrvatske aktivno je sudjelovao u Domovinskom ratu i razvoju obrambenog sustava. Sudjelovao je i u UN-ovoj mirovnoj misiji u Sierra Leoneu, a i dalje je aktivan u razvoju nacionalnog sigurnosno-obrambenog sustava Republike Hrvatske. Obnašao je dužnost predsjednika Hrvatske udruge poslovnih savjetnika te predavača na Zagrebačkoj školi ekonomije i menadžmenta. Od 2015. do 2020. godine bio je tajnik Vijeća za domovinsku sigurnost predsjednice Republike Hrvatske. Uz to, aktivan je član brojnih poslovnih udruga. Gordan je odlikov

programme.desc: The weekly foreign policy magazine that informs, closer and analyzes world events, processes, challenges and threats. / Tjedni vanjskopolitički magazin koji informira, približava i analizira svjetske događaje, procese, izazove i prijetnje.

programme.title: Labirint
programme.desc: Not so long ago it wasn't enough, today sixty years later we throw it in large quantities. With about 300,000 tons of thrown food, Croatia is an average of the EU annually, but at the very top when it comes to throwing food from households. Why do we buy excessively and then throw it, how much euros so end up in the basket, how to better plan and save? / Još ne tako davno nije je bilo dovoljno, danas šezdesetak godina poslije bacamo je u velikim količinama. S oko 300.000 tona bačene hrane godišnje Hrvatska je u prosjeku EU ali je zato pri samom vrhu kada je riječ o bacanju hrane iz kućanstava. Zašto prekomjerno kupujemo a onda bacamo, koliko eura tako završi u košu, kako bolje planirati i pri tome uštedjeti?

programme.title: Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: The show brings the actualities, new scientific discoveries, curiosities from the animal and herbal world and social phenomena. We will peek into all the corners of the Earth, and we will not forget the rest of the universe. We bring serious, but also that casual, fun side of science. / Emisija donosi aktualnosti, nova znanstvena otkrića, zanimljivosti iz životinjskog i biljnog svijeta te društvene fenomene. Zavirit ćemo u sve kutke Zemlje, a nećemo zaboraviti ni ostatak svemira. Donosimo ozbiljnu, ali i onu ležerniju, zabavnu stranu znanosti.

programme.title: Global 3000
programme.desc: Eight billion people live on Earth and we are connected better than ever before. Nove ideje o tome kako to najbolje iskoristiti, donosi Global Us.

programme.desc: Extreme is an off -road race with electric jeeps, which takes place in remote places in the world like the tropical forests of the Amazon. The purpose of the competition is to direct people to climate change in the world and the reasonable use of cars. / Екстрийм Е е офроуд състезание с електрически джипове, което се провежда в отдалечени места на света като тропическите гори на Амазонка. programme.title: Cycling: Croatian Tour / Колоездене: Обиколка на Хърватия
programme.desc: The Tour of Croatia is one of the most significant events in cycling that attracts world professional teams and is part of the European Calendar of the UCI. The tour offers exciting stages that go through some of the most beautiful landscapes of Croatia-from the Adriatic coast to the interior of the country. / Обиколката на Хърватия (Tour of Croatia) е едно от най-значимите събития в колоезденето, което привлича световни професионални отбори и е част от Европейския календар на UCI. Турът предлага вълнуващи етапи, които преминават през някои от най-красивите пейзажи на Хърватия — от Адриатическото крайбрежие до вътрешността на страната.

The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Through the Time Corridors with Morgan Freeman / През коридорите на времето с Морган Фрийман
programme.desc: Together with Oscar -winner Morgan Freeman, find how scientists were searching for a particle to explain the appearance of matter in the universe. / Заедно с носителя на Оскар Морган Фрийман открийте как учените са издирвали частица, която да обясни появата на материята във Вселената.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Evulanda Slavcheva / Зала на славата: Евладия Славчева
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.desc: Dragomir Draganov will welcome viewers in the studio of "With BNT Forever" to tell with his star guests the unforgettable and exciting stories of the great Bulgarian artists and artists. programme.title: The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. Целта на състезанието е да насочи хората към климатичните промени в света и разумното използване на автомобилите.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Emil Kremenliev / Зала на славата: Емил Кременлиев
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: I know that / Това го знам
programme.desc: The entertaining teenage quiz has the ambitious goal of providing viewers with a new view of the possibility of the learning material being presented in the public space through modern and interactive television games. Participants will have to overcome different challenges at every level of the game, gather lives, and especially have fun thanks to the knowledge they have gained at school. The format includes a variety of questions, logical tasks, music and a great deal of fun. All this is a gaming regulation of a video game style competition, combined with elements of the specifics of life on social networks. Participants in the children's educational program are 15 and 17 years old, and the project focuses on education as a fun process in the entertainment segment of television. / Забавно-образователната тийнейджърска викторина има амбициозната цел да предостави на зрителите нов поглед върху възможността учебният материал да бъде представен в публичното пространство чрез модерна и интерактивна телевизионна игра. Участниците ще трябва да преодоляват различни предизвикателства във всяко ниво от играта, да събират животи и най-вече да се забавляват благодарение на знанията, които са натрупали в училище. Форматът включва разнообразни въпроси, логически задачи, музика и голяма доза забавление. Всичко това е игрален регламент на състезание по знания в стилистиката на видео игра, съчетана с елементи от спецификите на живота в социалните мрежи. Участниците в детско-юношеското образователно предаване са на възраст межди 15 и 17 години, а проектът поставя фокус върху образованието като забавен процес в развлекателния сегмент на телевизионния ефир.

Years. / Komedija je poznata je „Scary Movie 5“ u Aziji, „Horror Movie“ u Italiji, a u Njemačkoj su ga nazvali „Mega Monster Movie“. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. programme.desc: Lukas Jakobi cooks vegan. So good that the famous Michelin restaurant guide awarded it two stars. This makes the Wiesbaden native the youngest star chef among the German elite at the stove. He cooked for the first time at the age of six: spaghetti with tomato sauce. After school he studies the finest cakes in Germany. At 29 he opened his first restaurant for vegans. Now he also cooks for passengers on a German airline. A special challenge: at a height of ten kilometers the food tastes different than on the ground. How do the guests react to his food? Gate Gourmet delivers food to passengers every day. In Frankfurt alone, up to 50,000 meals are produced and delivered every day, around the clock, 365 days a day. A logistical challenge under strict hygiene rules. / Lukas Jakobi kocht vegan. So gut, dass der beruhmte Restaurantfuhrer Guide Michelin ihn gleich mit zwei Sternen gekront hat. Damit ist der Wiesbadener der jungste Sternekoch unter der deutschen Elite am Herd. Mit sechs Jahren kocht er zum ersten Mal: Spaghetti mit TomatensoSSe. Nach der Schule lernt er in den feinsten Kuchen Deutschlands. Mit 29 eroffnet er sein erstes Restaurant fur Veganer. Jetzt kocht er auch fur Passagiere einer deutschen Airline. Eine besondere Herausforderung: Denn in zehn Kilometern Hohe schmeckt das Essen anders als am Boden. Wie reagieren die Gaste auf sein Essen? Gate Gourmet liefert taglich Essen fur Fluggaste. Allein in Frankfurt werden taglich bis zu 50.000 Mahlzeiten produziert und ausgeliefert, rund um die Uhr an 365 Tagen. Eine logistische Herausforderung unter strengen hygienischen Regeln.

programme.desc: The slightly injured and confused older Mr. Zielke, whom the WaPo Bodensee rescues from the water, turns out to be an important witness in a murder case. The painter Carl Glanzer is floating lifelessly next to a sailing yacht that the shipyard owner Weyrich supposedly gave him a week ago in exchange for a picture. Mechthild's eyes widen when her daughter Nele carelessly mentions the name at dinner. Zielke was once a world-famous photographer who also photographed Mechthild in her youth. Niklas liked to see the black and white pictures from grandma's past. Meanwhile, the investigators still don't have any leads. The last text message from Glanzer's cell phone went to museum director Florian Nietzsche and also concerned his wife Hanna, who separated from him six months ago and now lives in Portugal. Julia senses that he is hiding something. When Zielke's house becomes the target of an attempted break-in, Jakob has to stay with him. While examining the pictures in the artist's studio, Paul makes a surprising discovery that excites everyone. Because Mechthild has also resumed contact with Zielke and is now in mortal danger. / Der leicht verletzte und verwirrte altere Herr Zielke, den die WaPo Bodensee aus dem Wasser rettet, erweist sich als wichtiger Zeuge in einem Mordfall. Der Maler Carl Glanzer treibt leblos neben einer Segelyacht, die ihm der Werftbesitzer Weyrich angeblich vor einer Woche im Tausch gegen ein Bild uberlassen hat. Mechthild macht gleich groSSe Augen, als ihre Tochter Nele unbedacht beim Abendessen den Namen nennt. Denn Zielke war einst ein weltberuhmter Fotograf, der auch Mechthild in ihrer Jugend fotografiert hat. Niklas mochte gerne die Schwarz-WeiSS-Bilder aus Omas Vergangenheit sehen. Die Ermittler haben wahrenddessen noch keine heiSSe Spur. Die letzte Textnachricht von Glanzers Handy ging an Museumschef Florian Nietzsche und betraf auch dessen Frau Hanna, die sich vor einem halben Jahr von ihm getrennt hat und nun in Portugal lebt. Dass er etwas verschweigt, spurt Julia genau. Als Zielkes Haus Ziel eines Einbruchsversuchs wird, muss sich Jakob bei ihm einquartieren. Paul macht bei der Untersuchung der Bilder im Atelier des Kunstlers eine uberraschende Entdeckung, die alle in Aufregung versetzt. Denn auch Mechthild hat den Kontakt zu Zielke wieder aufgenommen und schwebt nun in Lebensgefahr.

programme.title: Knowledge before eight - nature / Wissen vor acht - Natur
programme.desc: There is music in this episode, not for us humans, but for our pets. The University of Wisconsin has developed very special "cat music" to match the frequency at which cats communicate. In the test, the music was so well received that the cats not only listened to the speakers but even cuddled with them. Dogs, on the other hand, prefer reggae and soft rock, according to the study. Very cool, thinks Thomas D and raps on “Wissen vor Acht - Natur”. / In dieser Folge steckt Musik, nicht fur uns Menschen, sondern fur unsere Haustiere. Die Universitat von Wisconsin hat ganz spezielle "Katzen-Musik" entwickelt, passend in der Frequenz, in der Katzen kommunizieren. Im Test kam die Musik so gut an, dass die Katzen nicht nur an den Lautsprechern lauschten, sondern sogar mit ihnen schmusten. Hunde hingegen bevorzugen laut Studie Reggae und Softrock. Sehr cool, findet Thomas D und rappt bei "Wissen vor acht - Natur".

programme.title: Wetter vor acht
programme.desc: What will the weather be like in the next few days? This question is clarified in “Weather before eight” using clear graphics and well-founded forecasts. / Wie wird das Wetter in den nachsten Tagen? Diese Frage wird bei "Wetter vor acht" anhand von anschaulichen Grafiken und fundierten Prognosen geklart.

programme.title: The Savior - we are a lawyer / Die Heiland - Wir sind Anwalt
programme.desc: The propSite Heiko Podolke (Wanja Mues) is accused of realizations. Michaela Tampke (Kirsten Block), the leading actress of a feature film, collapsed on a folding chair during filming in the Babelsberg studio, and Heiko is held responsible for this. The expensive film production stands still, every day causes high costs. Michaela Tampke is not just the main actress: the film to which she wrote the script she recedes her life story as an actress in the GDR of the 80s. For many years, Michaela has been looking for a film production company that was able to finance and produce this film - its life dream -; In the film team in Babelsberg, you still know some from GDR times. But the folding chair itself also has a past. It is a GDR design, whose author Heiko Podolke himself is, who, however, stood out to secure his sample rights to the design. It turns out that the chair was manipulated. Who from the film team wanted to harm Michaela Tampke? Or has Heiko Podolke hung up the chair himself? Chief Prosecutor Tummler does not investigate the preload of the money washing against Romy alone, he has a vulnerable support from a young colleague. Veronica Strauss (Anne Muller) does everything possible to prove Romy errors. The fact that Romy is supposed to have a young half sister raises questions. Who is Serafina? Should Romy really believe her? What did your parents not help you? Romy's life so far has been used to be used in its foundations. / Dem Requisiteur Heiko Podolke (Wanja Mues) wird Fahrlassigkeit vorgeworfen. Michaela Tampke (Kirsten Block), die Hauptdarstellerin eines Spielfilms, ist wahrend Dreharbeiten im Studio Babelsberg auf einem Klappstuhl zusammengebrochen, und Heiko wird dafur verantwortlich gemacht. Die teure Filmproduktion steht still, jeder Tag verursacht hohe Kosten. Michaela Tampke ist nicht nur die Hauptdarstellerin: Der Film, zu dem sie selbst das Drehbuch geschrieben hat, erzahlt ihre Lebensgeschichte als Schauspielerin in der DDR der 80er Jahre. Viele Jahre hat Michaela eine Filmproduktionsfirma gesucht, die diesen Film - ihren Lebenstraum - finanzieren und produzieren konnte; im Filmteam in Babelsberg kennen sie einige noch aus DDR-Zeiten. Aber auch der Klappstuhl selbst hat eine Vergangenheit. Es handelt sich um ein DDR-Design, dessen Urheber Heiko Podolke selbst ist, der es jedoch versaumte, seine Musterrechte an dem Design zu sichern.Es stellt sich heraus, dass der Stuhl manipuliert wurde. Wer aus dem Filmteam wollte Michaela Tampke schaden? Oder hat Heiko Podolke selbst den Stuhl angesagt?Oberstaatsanwalt Tummler ermittelt nicht allein zu den Vorwurfen der Geldwasche gegen Romy, er hat tatkraftige Unterstutzung durch eine junge Kollegin. Veronica Strauss (Anne Muller) setzt alles daran, Romy Fehler nachzuweisen.Die Tatsache, dass Romy eine jungere Halbschwester haben soll, wirft Fragen auf. Wer ist Serafina? Soll Romy ihr wirklich glauben? Was haben ihr ihre Eltern nicht erzahlt? Romys bisheriges Leben wird in seinen Grundfesten erschuttert.

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: The teenage girl Greta Dahn is taken to the Saxony Clinic seriously injured after a traffic accident. For Dr. Lucia Bohm is no ordinary patient for Greta, as they both share a well-kept secret. Being unprepared to confront her past after such a long time upsets Lucia and her professionalism gives way to being overwhelmed. This also escapes Dr. Not Kai Hoffmann, who gets to know a different side of his colleague for the first time. Arzu Ritter suddenly has an emotional outburst in the morning when she looks at family photos. Dr. Philipp Brentano is affected, what about her? Further evidence led the two to believe that they were expecting a baby, which they had thought was impossible because of Arzu's onset of menopause. / Das Teenager-Madchen Greta Dahn wird nach einem Verkehrsunfall schwerverletzt in die Sachsenklinik eingeliefert. Fur Dr. Lucia Bohm ist Greta keine gewohnliche Patientin, denn sie beide verbindet ein wohlgehutetes Geheimnis. Nach so langer Zeit unvorbereitet mit ihrer Vergangenheit konfrontiert zu werden, wuhlt Lucia auf und ihre Professionalitat weicht der Überforderung. Das entgeht auch Dr. Kai Hoffmann nicht, der das erste Mal eine andere Seite an seiner Kollegin kennenlernt.Arzu Ritter hat morgens plotzlich einen emotionalen Ausbruch, als sie sich Familienfotos ansieht. Dr. Philipp Brentano ist betroffen, was ist mit ihr? Weitere Indizien fuhren dazu, dass die beiden glauben, ein Baby zu erwarten, was sie wegen der beginnenden Wechseljahre bei Arzu fur unmoglich gehalten hatten.

programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Bicycle theft on Georg Dausinger's stud farm. Hubert and Girwidz make a grisly discovery in the hayloft of the barn: next to the bicycle they were looking for, the body of the stud farm owner is pinned to the wall with a pitchfork. Dausinger's son Jens quickly comes under suspicion. During their investigation, Hubert and Girwidz become acquainted with a new trendy Finnish sport: professional riding on a stock pony, where Jens Dausinger gives lessons. It turns out that his assistant trainer Jasmin Forchhammer also has a solid motive for murder... / Fahrraddiebstahl auf dem Gestut von Georg Dausinger. Hubert und Girwidz machen auf dem Heuboden der Scheune einen grausigen Fund: Neben dem gesuchten Fahrrad ist die Leiche des Gestutsbesitzers mit einer Heugabel an die Wand gepinnt. Sehr schnell gerat Dausingers Sohn Jens in Verdacht. Bei ihren Ermittlungen machen Hubert und Girwidz dabei Bekanntschaft mit einer neuen finnischen Trendsportart: dem professionellen Reiten auf einem Stockpony, bei dem Jens Dausinger Unterricht gibt. Dabei stellt sich heraus, dass auch seine Co-Trainerin Jasmin Forchhammer ein handfestes Mordmotiv hat ...

programme.title: WaPo Duisburg
programme.desc: A young couple actually wanted to spend a romantic night in the open air at the sustainable Duisburg start-up “Green Sleeper” in the nature reserve. But they are robbed and then seriously injured while pursuing the perpetrator! WaPo boss Kruppka asks her troops to take on this case out of turn. Not entirely altruistic, as the failure of the start-up company could result in significant financial losses for some of the investors close to it. Jager suspects sabotage was behind the attack. But who could have an interest in driving the entrepreneurial couple Jonas and Lutz Hausmann into ruin? To find out, Arda and Frank check in undercover, not knowing that the "Honeymoon" package has been booked for them. While the two find themselves confronted with an overdose of romance, Lena follows a hot lead... / Eigentlich wollte ein junges Parchen beim nachhaltigen Duisburger Start-up "Green Sleeper" im Naturschutzgebiet eine romantische Nacht unter freiem Himmel verbringen. Doch sie werden ausgeraubt und dann noch bei der Verfolgung des Taters schwer verletzt! WaPo-Chefin Kruppka bittet ihre Truppe, diesen Fall auSSerhalb der Reihe zu ubernehmen. Nicht ganz uneigennutzig, denn das Scheitern des Jungunternehmens konnte einigen ihr nahestehenden Investoren machtige finanzielle EinbuSSen bescheren. Jager vermutet hinter dem Anschlag Sabotage. Aber wer konnte ein Interesse daran haben, das Unternehmer-Ehepaar Jonas und Lutz Hausmann in den Ruin zu treiben? Um das herauszufinden, checken Arda und Frank undercover ein, nicht ahnend, dass fur sie das "Honeymoon"-Paket gebucht wurde. Wahrend sich die beiden mit einer Überdosis Romantik konfrontiert sehen, verfolgt Lena eine heiSSe Spur ...

programme.title: Rote Rosen
programme.desc: When Mo and Julius are interviewed as the reigning Heathen couple, Mo realizes how different their dreams for the future are. He tries to find the right moment to talk to Julius about it. But Julius has long had other ideas: he proposes to Mo in public. How will he react? Valerie is determined to prove that Noah and Toni have had an affair. To do this, she secretly installs a surveillance camera in the shared apartment. However, it doesn't remain undetected for long...Despite his panic attack, Till refuses to resume the psychotherapy he had stopped. Only Arthur can convince him to continue to seek professional help. Meanwhile, Svenja and Arthur are worried about Bella. It seems as if they have finally lost her to Victoria - will Bella find her place in the family again? Gisela and Heiner cannot bring themselves to continue their acting towards Jorg. You decide to tell him the truth. / Als Mo und Julius als amtierendes Heidepaar interviewt werden, realisiert Mo, wie sehr sich ihre Zukunftstraume unterscheiden. Er versucht, den richtigen Moment zu finden, um mit Julius daruber zu reden. Doch Julius hat langst andere Vorstellungen: In aller Öffentlichkeit macht er Mo einen Heiratsantrag. Wie wird dieser reagieren?Valerie ist fest entschlossen, Noah und Toni eine Affare nachzuweisen. Dafur installiert sie heimlich eine Überwachungskamera in der WG. Die bleibt allerdings nicht lange unentdeckt ...Trotz seiner Panikattacke weigert sich Till, die abgebrochene Psychotherapie wieder aufzunehmen. Erst Arthur kann ihn dazu bewegen, weiter professionelle Hilfe anzunehmen.Wahrenddessen machen sich Svenja und Arthur Sorgen um Bella. Es scheint, als hatten sie sie endgultig an Victoria verloren - wird Bella ihren Platz in der Familie wiederfinden?Gisela und Heiner bringen es nicht ubers Herz, ihr Schauspiel gegenuber Jorg weiterzufuhren. Sie entscheiden sich, ihm die Wahrheit zu sagen.

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: When Markus Vincent has to cancel the planned hike again, Henry is happy to step in for Markus and he can forget his worries for a moment. But then Henry is caught up in his traumatic experiences again and is shocked to discover that he has a bigger trust problem than he previously realized. Christoph blackmails Alexandra with an incriminating document that he keeps in the safe of the "Furstenhof" office. In order to get the document into their possession, Alexandra and Markus come up with a plan: Markus should lure Christoph away from the "Furstenhof" while Alexandra tries to crack the code of the safe. She actually manages to decipher the number combination, but not before Christoph enters the office...While Michael fights resolutely against his feelings for Anja, Anja cannot make sense of Michael's contradictory behavior and, through Fanny's intervention, moves to the Sonnbichlers, where she is warmly welcomed. Michael is initially relieved that he no longer constantly runs into Anja and throws himself into his research. But then he realizes that he can't switch off his feelings for Anja so easily. / Als Markus Vincent die geplante Wanderung erneut absagen muss, zeigt Henry sich gerne bereit, fur Markus einzuspringen, und er kann seine Sorgen fur einen Moment vergessen. Doch dann wird Henry erneut von seinen traumatischen Erlebnissen eingeholt und muss erschuttert feststellen, dass er ein groSSeres Vertrauensproblem hat, als ihm bislang bewusst war.Christoph erpresst Alexandra mit einem belastenden Dokument, das er im Safe des "Furstenhof"-Buros aufbewahrt. Um das Dokument in ihren Besitz zu bringen, schmieden Alexandra und Markus einen Plan: Markus soll Christoph vom "Furstenhof" weglocken, wahrend Alexandra versucht, den Code des Safes zu knacken. Sie schafft es tatsachlich, die Zahlenkombination zu entschlusseln, jedoch nicht, bevor Christoph das Buro betritt ...Wahrend Michael entschieden gegen seine Gefuhle fur Anja ankampft, kann sich Anja auf Michaels widerspruchliches Verhalten keinen Reim machen und zieht auf Fannys Vermittlung hin zu den Sonnbichlers, wo sie herzlich aufgenommen wird. Michael ist zunachst erleichtert daruber, Anja nicht mehr standig uber den Weg zu laufen, und sturzt sich in seine Forschung. Doch dann merkt er, dass er seine Gefuhle fur Anja nicht so einfach ausschalten kann.

programme.title: Mittendrin - Flughafen Frankfurt
programme.sub-title: Fliegen kann Leben retten - Nicolas ist Stammzellenkurier
programme.desc: When Nicolas Kipping is traveling with his black special box, he always has it in a hurry. Because the 26-year-old Frankfurt stem cells transports in the heavy hand-pack. He and his employees fly more than 1000 courier orders per year - spontaneously, crisscrossed around the globe, always in a race against the time to save human life. It is the largest air freight hall at the airport: the employees at DB Schenker Jetcargo move up to 800 tons. Luxury cars, machines, components, mobile phones and tablets. The special aircraft pallets have to be weighed, searched and decorated and stand on the machine. A daily challenge under enormous time pressure. / Wenn Nicolas Kipping mit seiner schwarzen Spezialbox unterwegs ist, hat er es immer eilig. Denn in dem schweren Handgepack transportiert der 26-jahrige Frankfurter Stammzellen. Mehr als 1000 Kurierauftrage fliegen er und seine Mitarbeiter pro Jahr - spontan, kreuz und quer um den Erdball, immer im Wettlauf gegen die Zeit, um Menschenleben zu retten.Es ist die groSSte Luftfrachthalle am Flughafen: Bis zu 800 Tonnen taglich bewegen die Mitarbeiter bei DB Schenker Jetcargo. Luxusautos, Maschinen, Bauteile, Mobiltelefone und Tablets. Die speziellen Flugzeug-Paletten mussen gewogen, durchsucht und verzollt werden und punktlich an der Maschine stehen. Eine tagliche Herausforderung unter enormem Zeitdruck.

programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Riedl is buying donuts at the Rattlinger bakery when a confused woman with blood on her clothes shows up. But she is unharmed, the blood does not come from her. It's Magdalena Meier, who ran away from a closed psychiatric hospital. When Hubert and Girwidz bring the woman back, they find the clinic in a state of shock: a nurse has been murdered - and then Magdalena Meier also claims that she committed the crime on behalf of the devil. / Riedl kauft Krapfen in der Backerei Rattlinger, als dort eine verwirrte Frau mit Blut an der Kleidung auftaucht. Sie ist aber unverletzt, das Blut stammt nicht von ihr. Es handelt sich um Magdalena Meier, die aus der geschlossenen Psychiatrie ausgerissen ist. Als Hubert und Girwidz die Frau zuruckbringen, finden sie die Klinik im Schockzustand vor: Eine Pflegekraft wurde ermordet - und dann behauptet Magdalena Meier auch noch, sie habe die Tat im Auftrag des Teufels begangen.

programme.desc: What happens to our Frihstuck if there are no more bees? programme.title: Die Nichte des Polizisten
programme.desc: A group of young, ambitious priority: inside of a Baden-Wurttemberg police special unit is driven to high performance. One of them is the 23-year-old Rebecca Henselmann (Magdalena Laubisch), which will soon be used in hidden operations. She is strictly exhausting, is ambitious, just like her colleague Christoph Laurin (Max von der Groeben), to whom Rebecca comes close. The young policewoman acts highly motivated for drug and arms trade, guided by her trainer Lars Menke (Nils Strunk). In doing so, she encounters power abuse and also meets right -wing radical settings in the police. Rebecca got to know the influence of right -wing extremists in her homeland in Thuringen by the police Werner Barth (Thorsten Merten). Now she is getting between the fronts of organized crime and extreme rights, some of which partly reach into their unit. This knowledge becomes her a chance. / Eine Gruppe von jungen, ehrgeizigen Anwarter:innen einer baden-wurttembergischen Polizei-Spezialeinheit wird zu Hochstleistungen getrieben. Eine davon ist die 23-jahrige Rebecca Henselmann (Magdalena Laubisch), die schon bald bei verdeckten Operationen eingesetzt wird. Sie strengt sich an, ist ehrgeizig, genau wie ihr Kollege Christoph Laurin (Max von der Groeben), dem Rebecca naherkommt. Hochmotiviert agiert die junge Polizistin bei Einsatzen gegen Drogen- und Waffenhandel, angeleitet von ihrem Ausbilder Lars Menke (Nils Strunk). Dabei begegnet sie Machtmissbrauch und trifft auf rechtsradikale Einstellungen auch in der Polizei. Rebecca hat in ihrer Heimat in Thuringen durch den Polizisten Werner Barth (Thorsten Merten) die Einflussnahme von Rechtsextremen kennengelernt. Nun gerat sie selbst zwischen die Fronten von organisierter Kriminalitat und extremer Rechten, deren Verbindungen teilweise bis in ihre Einheit hineinreichen. Dieses Wissen wird ihr zum Verhangnis.

programme.title: Why did Michèle Kiesewetter die? / Warum starb Michèle Kiesewetter?
programme.desc: The policewoman Michèle Kiesewetter was totted in a broad day in 2007, in the middle of a big city. Of course, it is clear: You take lunch break in your patrol car when the 22-year police officer and her colleague Martin A. Kugeln are shot in the head. Years later it turns out that the deeds go to the account of the right -wing extremist terrorist organization NSU. The NSU had previously committed nine racist pattern. Then they shoot police officers, this time not out of racial hatred. This time there must be another motive. But which one? Why did Michèle Kiesewetter die? The documentary is looking for traces, researches in the documents of the committee issue and examines the evidence. The main protagonist is the ex-police officer Peter F. He was a member of the Soko "Parkplatz" of the Kripo Heilbronn as a chief crime commissioner. The clearance of the case became a life content for him. Never before spoke in front of a television camera about the case that did not let go of him all his life. / Die Polizistin Michèle Kiesewetter wird 2007 am helllichten Tag getotet, mitten in einer GroSSstadt. Klar ist nur der Tathergang: Sie machen Mittagspause in ihrem Streifenwagen, als der 22-jahrigen Polizistin und ihrem Kollegen Martin A. Kugeln in den Kopf geschossen werden. Jahre spater stellt sich heraus, dass die Taten auf das Konto der rechtsextremen Terrororganisation NSU gehen. Neun rassistische Anschlage hatte der NSU zuvor begangen. Dann schieSSen sie auf Polizisten, diesmal nicht aus Rassenhass. Diesmal muss es ein anderes Motiv geben. Aber welches? Warum starb Michèle Kiesewetter?Die Doku geht auf Spurensuche, forscht in den Unterlagen der Untersuchungsausschusse und pruft die Indizien. Hauptprotagonist ist der Ex-Polizist Peter F. Er war als Kriminaloberkommissar Mitglied der Soko "Parkplatz" der Kripo Heilbronn. Die Aufklarung des Falls wurde fur ihn zu einem Lebensinhalt. Nie zuvor hat er vor einer Fernsehkamera uber den Fall gesprochen, der ihn sein Leben lang nicht wieder loslieSS.

programme.desc: Hubert and Girwidz are on the hunt for a rampaging boar that is making Wolfratshausen unsafe. They stumble across the corpse of forester Ulf Groschel, who was in charge of the wild boars: he was shot backwards! Hubert and Girwidz set out to find the perpetrator. The officials target farmer Xaver Vogl, with whom the dead man had an argument, and the forester's wife, Resi Groschel, who seems to be hiding something. The officers are about to solve the case when they are suddenly shot at from an ambush. Is the perpetrator trying to get Hubert and Girwidz out of the way so as not to get caught? / Hubert und Girwidz sind auf der Jagd nach einem randalierenden Keiler, der Wolfratshausen unsicher macht. Dabei stolpern sie uber die Leiche des Forsters Ulf Groschel, der fur die Wildschweine zustandig war: Er wurde rucklings erschossen! Hubert und Girwidz machen sich auf die Tatersuche. Ins Visier der Beamten geraten Landwirt Xaver Vogl, mit dem der Tote Streit hatte, und die Ehefrau des Forsters, Resi Groschel, die etwas zu verbergen scheint. Die Beamten stehen kurz vor der Aufklarung des Falles, als sie plotzlich aus einem Hinterhalt heraus beschossen werden. Versucht der Tater, Hubert und Girwidz aus dem Weg zu raumen, um nicht uberfuhrt zu werden?

programme.title: Rote Rosen
programme.desc: Bella feels misunderstood by everyone - except Victoria. When Svenja and Arthur find out that Elyas did not attack Victoria, she has to admit her intrigue to Bella. But Bella reacts completely differently than expected. Mo, taken by surprise, avoids Julius' marriage proposal. He loves Julius, but first wanted to find out for himself where his career path would take him. But when Mo receives an order for his new company and Julius is overjoyed for him, Mo makes a decision: he makes Julius a counter-proposal! Will this step really change everything? Toni blackmails Valerie by threatening her to tell Noah about the surveillance camera. Valerie has no choice and gives in. However, the video footage has some unexpected surprises that suddenly bring the two sisters closer together. / Bella fuhlt sich von allen unverstanden - auSSer von Victoria. Als Svenja und Arthur herausfinden, dass Elyas Victoria nicht angegriffen hat, muss diese ihre Intrige vor Bella zugeben. Doch Bella reagiert vollig anders als erwartet.Mo weicht Julius Heiratsantrag uberrumpelt aus. Er liebt Julius, mochte aber erst fur sich selbst herausfinden, wohin sein beruflicher Weg ihn fuhrt. Aber als Mo einen Auftrag fur seine neue Firma erhalt und Julius sich uberschwanglich fur ihn freut, trifft Mo eine Entscheidung: Er macht Julius einen Gegenantrag! Wird dieser Schritt wirklich alles verandern?Toni erpresst Valerie, indem sie ihr droht, Noah uber die Überwachungskamera aufzuklaren. Valerie bleibt keine Wahl und sie lenkt ein. Das Videomaterial hat jedoch einige unerwartete Überraschungen parat, die die beiden Schwestern plotzlich naher zusammenbringen.

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: When Alexandra no longer knows what to do next, Markus is dismayed to realize that she is threatening to disappear from his life. This makes him realize that Alexandra has always been his great love. In order not to lose her, Markus makes the greatest possible sacrifice. At Werner's request, Alfons takes a close look at a new employee who tries hard to complete all tasks perfectly and not make any mistakes. While the new colleague offends some people with his overly correct manner, he finds an ally in Fanny. She immediately likes him and defends him from Lale after an incident. Since Lale can no longer stand living under the same roof as Erik, she tells Miro and Greta that she will not move back upstairs to Erik and Yvonne once the fire damage has been repaired. To Miro's delight, Greta also decides to stay with him because she is already used to living with him. / Als Alexandra nicht mehr weiSS, wie es weitergehen soll, erkennt Markus besturzt, dass sie aus seinem Leben zu verschwinden droht. Dadurch wird ihm bewusst, dass Alexandra immer seine groSSe Liebe war. Um sie nicht zu verlieren, bringt Markus das groSStmogliche Opfer.Auf Werners Bitte hin nimmt Alfons einen neuen Angestellten unter die Lupe, der sich groSSe Muhe gibt, alle Aufgaben perfekt zu erfullen und keinen Fehler zu machen. Wahrend der neue Kollege mit seiner uberkorrekten Art bei manchen aneckt, findet er in Fanny eine Verbundete. Sie findet ihn auf Anhieb sympathisch und verteidigt ihn nach einem Zwischenfall vor Lale.Da Lale es nicht mehr aushalt, weiter mit Erik unter einem Dach zu wohnen, teilt sie Miro und Greta mit, dass sie nicht wieder zuruck zu Erik und Yvonne nach oben ziehen wird, wenn der Brandschaden behoben ist. Auch Greta beschlieSSt zu Miros Freude, weiter bei ihm wohnen zu bleiben, denn sie hat sich bereits an das Zusammenleben mit ihm gewohnt.

programme.title: Mittendrin - Flughafen Frankfurt
programme.sub-title: 100 years of airport - from the basic years to destruction / 100 Jahre Flughafen - Von den Grunderjahren bis zur Zerstorung
programme.desc: Frankfurt Airport was opened 100 years ago. Its dramatic history between pomp and splendor makes the world airport a mirror of German history. In 1912, the development of aviation reached its first peak at Frankfurter Rebstock, Hesse's first airship port. In 1924, Sudwestdeutsche Luftverkehrs AG was founded. Frankfurt-Rebstock Airport quickly reached its capacity and had to move in 1936. The airships “Graf Zeppelin” and “Hindenburg” begin regular service to Rio de Janeiro and Lakehurst. On July 8th, Lufthansa opened air traffic with a Ju 52. The founding years were marked by fascinating stories, innovations and setbacks. / Vor 100 Jahren wurde der Frankfurter Flughafen eroffnet. Seine dramatische Geschichte zwischen Prunk und Stunk macht den Weltflughafen zu einem Spiegel deutscher Geschichte. 1912 erreicht die Entwicklung der Luftfahrt ihren ersten Hohepunkt am Frankfurter Rebstock, Hessens erstem Luftschiffhafen. 1924 wird die Sudwestdeutsche Luftverkehrs AG gegrundet. Schnell erreicht der Flughafen Frankfurt-Rebstock seine Kapazitaten und muss 1936 umziehen. Die Luftschiffe "Graf Zeppelin" und "Hindenburg" nehmen den Linienverkehr nach Rio de Janeiro und Lakehurst auf. Am 8. Juli eroffnet die Lufthansa den Flugverkehr mit einer Ju 52. Die Grunderjahre waren gepragt von faszinierenden Geschichten, Innovationen und Ruckschlagen.

programme.desc: The actor Burkhard Kreisel has severe pain in his abdomen and shortness of breath.
