programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes intended for children engaged in sports, irrelevant at which success level, will show the essential advantages that provide sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that in Montenegro has many talented children who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation on a bar for one step higher level. We want to draw attention to the potential belonging to us, which is indisputable, the potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.desc: Teresa discovers that Emmanuel was present at Aniza's murder and that both she and Hanna were pregnant when they died. Meanwhile, Sandro and Krisnja get closer, and Diego enters the forest to face the "monster". Entretanto, Sandro e Krisnja aproximam-se, e Diego entra na floresta para enfrentar o "monstro". Alguem entra na casa de Teresa, rouba o seu diário e deixa uma foto da família Di Lenardo.

Pela primeira vez, pressente-se a distância entre mundos que ate entao pareciam coexistir.

programme.title: Towers, Bridges, Stations: The Genius of Gustave Eiffel / Torres, Pontes, Gares: O Genio de Gustave Eiffel
programme.desc: Overshadowed by the iconic Tower that bears his name, Gustave Eiffel hides an impressive career and lesser-known works. Over the course of 59 years, the visionary French engineer left his mark on more than 500 works spread across the world. Towers, bridges, railway stations, structures, statues... nothing stopped him! With each new project he revolutionized the world of civil engineering, creating the most impressive works of his time, and his achievements, all exceptional, imposed a new style. The style of iron, that of the railways. He built the large Nyugati railway station in Budapest, a majestic building where stone and metal combine to create a new aesthetic. In Porto, he designed the magnificent Maria Pia bridge, the first single-arch iron bridge with a span of 160 meters, precursor to the incredible Garabit Viaduct. In New York, he was the only one capable of erecting the structure of the Statue of Liberty, a legendary work that has resisted the winds of New York Bay for more than 130 years. And, of course, in Paris, he supervised the construction of the Eiffel Tower, one of the most visited monuments in the world. More than a hundred years after his death, his buildings remain as iconic, robust and influential as ever. Through expert testimony, 3D models and aerial images, we relive this fascinating era to learn the story of one of the greatest geniuses of the 19th century, a man who revolutionized engineering with each new project. / Ofuscado pela iconica Torre que tem o seu nome, Gustave Eiffel esconde uma carreira impressionante e obras menos conhecidas. Ao longo de 59 anos, o visionário engenheiro frances deixou a sua marca em mais de 500 obras espalhadas pelo mundo. Torres, pontes, estações ferroviárias, estruturas, estátuas... nada o deteve! A cada novo projeto revolucionou o mundo da engenharia civil, assinando as obras mais impressionantes do seu tempo, e as suas realizações, todas excecionais, impuseram um novo estilo. O estilo do ferro, o dos caminhos-de-ferro. Construiu a grande estaçao ferroviária de Nyugati, em Budapeste, um edifício majestoso onde a pedra e o metal se combinam para criar uma nova estetica. No Porto, projetou a magnífica ponte Maria Pia, a primeira ponte de ferro em arco único com um vao de 160 metros, precursora do incrível Viaduto Garabit. Em Nova Iorque, foi o único capaz de erguer a estrutura da Estátua da Liberdade, uma obra lendária que resiste aos ventos da baía de Nova Iorque há mais de 130 anos. E, claro, em Paris, supervisionou a construçao da Torre Eiffel, um dos monumentos mais visitados do mundo. Mais de cem anos apos a sua morte, os seus edifícios continuam tao iconicos, robustos e influentes como sempre. Atraves do testemunho de especialistas, modelos 3D e imagens aereas, revivemos esta epoca fascinante para conhecer a historia de um dos maiores genios do seculo XIX, um homem que revolucionou a engenharia a cada novo projeto.

programme.title: Linha da Frente
programme.desc: It's 10 pm and Bairro Alto is transformed into a fair. The bars compete with each other to see who sells more alcohol, challenging the boundaries of those who pass. Instead of glasses, the drinks are served in buckets. Farewells of singles, finalist trips. Lisbon and the city where you drink until falling. / Sao 10 da noite e Bairro Alto está transformado numa feira. Os bares concorrem entre si para ver quem vende mais álcool, desafiando os limites de quem passa. Em vez de copos, as bebidas sao servidas em baldes. Despedidas de solteiros, viagens de finalistas. Lisboa e a cidade onde se bebe ate cair.

programme.title: Arsenal vs West Ham United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Arsenal have lost both of their last two home league games against West Ham, only ever losing three in a row once before. West Ham United are looking to become only the second side to win three successive Premier League away games against Arsenal, after Manchester City, who won six on the bounce from March 2018 to February 2023.

programme.title: Brentford vs Manchester City - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Since completing a Premier League double over Manchester City in 2022-23, Brentford are winless in their last four against the Citizens in the division. Manchester City have only lost one of their four Premier League visits to Brentford, going down 1-0 on the final day of the 2022-23 season.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Liverpool -English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: After their 3-1 win in May, Chelsea could enjoy back-to-back league wins over Liverpool for the first time since November 2014. Liverpool are winless in their last four Premier League games at Stamford Bridge and could lose away to Chelsea two seasons running in the league for the first time since losing three on the bounce from 2004-05 to 2006-07.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Sunderland - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost just two of their last 30 league games against Sunderland, with this their first since a 3-0 win in April 2017. Across all competitions, Sunderland have managed to win just one of their last 31 away games against Manchester United, winning 1-0 in May 2014 thanks to Sebastian Larsson’s winner.

programme.title: Sevilla vs Barcelona - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Sevilla have not won any of their last 19 LaLiga games against Barcelona, a run that stretches back to October 2015, losing their last seven in a row – their longest consecutive losing streak against the Catalans in the top-flight. Barcelona have avoided defeat in their last nine away LaLiga matches against Sevilla, their longest unbeaten run away to them in the competition.

programme.title: Real Madrid vs Villarreal -Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 8 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Real Madrid have not lost any of their last four LaLiga games against Villarreal, winning the last two, this after failing to win any of their previous four against the Yellows in the competition. They have not won three or more in a row against them in LaLiga since 2011. Villarreal have lost 17 of their 25 LaLiga away matches against Real Madrid, their highest number of away defeats against a single opponent in the competition.

programme.title: Lille vs PSG - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 7 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Lille have won just one of their last 13 home Ligue 1 games against Paris SG, a 5-1 victory on 14 April 2019, which remains Paris Saint-Germains biggest away defeat in the top-flight in the 21st century. Lille have lost their last two Ligue 1 matches and could suffer three consecutive defeats in the competition for the first time since December 2019-January 2020. Lille could also fail to score in three consecutive Ligue 1 games for the first time since September 2017.

programme.desc: The 2025/2026 UEFA Womens Champions League is live and exclusive only on beIN. This is the first season under a new format, which have 18 participating teams, playing six games each against different opponents in a league phase, all in a joint group. The teams are competing for a place in the final that will be played at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, Norway on May 2026. Barcelona are the current Champions.

programme.desc: Dive into the excitement of French handball with Liqui Moly Starligue, formerly LNH Division 1. Established in 1952, this premier league event features 16 top teams battling for glory. With Montpellier’s 14 Handball titles and Paris Saint-Germains 11 wins, the competition is fierce. programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Martial arts - mma / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 320 / MMA UFC 320
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Football - Europa League: Porto - Red Star / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Porto - Crvena zvezda
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. programme.title: Basketball - VTB League: Zenit - Unics / Košarka - VTB liga: Zenit - UNICS
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. programme.title: Basketball - NBA League: Oklahoma - Denver, G2 / Košarka - NBA liga: Oklahoma - Denver, G2
programme.desc: The sixth day of June of June 1946. years will change the basketball game forever. programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Buducnost - Spartak / Košarka - ABA liga: Budućnost - Spartak
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Rudar - Borac / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Rudar - Borac
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): B Dortmund - Leipzig, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): B Dortmund - Leipzig, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Avtomobiliz: FIA EXTREME H World Cup: Time Trial / Avtomobilizem: FIA Extreme H World Cup: Time Trial
Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

Sunflowers and sunflower oil Mišel Pleteršek, young farmers from Čreta, walked through the field of sunflower. We learn when the seed is ripe enough to contain the most valuable oil, while dry enough for cold pressing. Salad for farewell to the summer cucumber or acho is one of the pumpkins. programme.title: Karel X.: Burboni in Gorizia, documentary of the month, Mon. / Karel X.: Burboni na Goriškem, dokumentarec meseca, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Moravec Dušan ... Who was the only king buried in Slovenian territory? / R: Moravec Dušan... Kdo je bil edini kralj, ki je pokopan na slovenskem ozemlju?
programme.desc: The documentary introduces us to the fate of the last representatives of the French royal family, who have become refugees due to revolutions. Ironically, the term refugee, "refuge", was first recorded when Louis XIV, the Sun King, expelled a large number of Hugenots from his homeland. His grandson Karel X. was also sentenced to exile after the July Revolution - he sought refuge from Scotland, Prague to Gorizia, hoping to be safe here from cholera. After a hundred members of his entourage, they were housed in various palaces around the city. Due to the mild climate, this later became known as the Austrian Nice. In 1836, they were awaited in Gorizia the warm autumn, and formerly a vital 79-year-old became the only death toll in the city for a good two weeks. Thus, the Franciscans in Kostanjevica, whose church had previously provided a space for the tombs of aristocratic families, became the guardians of the remains of the refugee king through the contract. In the following decades, other members of the dynasty wanted to be buried. Among them was Maria Theresa Šarlot, daughter of Louis XVI. and Mary Antoaneta. Her life story was very tragic. Her parents ended under the guillotine, her brother died in crude foster care, and after years of captivity, she became the wife of her cousin, son Karl X. Together, they took care of his niece and nephew, born after his brother's death, who became a symbol of hope for French legitimists. Henrik V. later wasted the last chance that Bourbon would take over the throne again, and the descendant of his sister became the Austrian Empress. During the visit of the Isonzo Front, the Zita ordered to transfer sarcophage from the Nabrežinsko stone to Vienna Safe. After the renovation of the demolished church, they were returned to the monastery. After the end of the war and the breakup of Austria-Hungary, the area again passed under the Kingdom of Italy. Shortly after World War II, allies set new borders. It was the French that decided that the monastery remained separated from Stara Gorica. Behind him, however, a new one has grown ... The past and current conditions at Kostanjevica are presented by Pater Niko Žvokelj and the administrator of the Škrabč Library Mirjam Brecelj. The historians of Gorizia also speak about the circumstances, changes through time and today's attitude towards heritage: dr. Renato Podbersic, Ph.D. Urška Strle and curator Cristina Bragaglia. The initiative to return the remains to France is commented on by journalist Ervin Milharčič Hladnik. The documentary also lacks the shots of the flowering of roses, the interiors of the Gorizia palaces, and the restored murals and stucco. We will be convinced that the royal family found a safe harbor at the intersection of different cultures after difficult life trials, where it can finally rest in peace. / Dokumentarni film nam predstavi usodo zadnjih predstavnikov francoske kraljeve rodbine, ki so zaradi revolucij postali begunci. Ironično je bil izraz begunec, »refuge«, prvič zabeležen, ko je Ludvik XIV., Sončni kralj, iz domovine izgnal veliko število hugenotov. Njegov vnuk Karel X. je bil po julijski revoluciji tudi obsojen na izgnanstvo – zatočišče je iskal od Škotske, Prage do Gorice v upanju, da bo tu varen pred kolero. Čez sto članov njegovega spremstva se je nastanilo v različnih palačah po mestu. To je zaradi milega podnebja pozneje postalo znano kot avstrijska Nica. Leta 1836 jih je v Gorici pričakala topla jesen, prej vitalen 79-letnik pa je že v dobrih dveh tednih postal edina smrtna žrtev kolere v mestu. Tako so frančiškani na Kostanjevici, katerih cerkev je že prej nudila prostor grobnicam plemiških družin, s pogodbo postali varuhi posmrtnih ostankov begunskega kralja.V naslednjih desetletjih so ob glavi družine želeli biti pokopani tudi drugi člani dinastije. Med njimi je bila tudi Marija Terezija Šarlota, hči Ludvika XVI. in Marije Antoanete. Njena življenjska zgodba je bila zelo tragična. Njeni starši so končali pod giljotino, njen brat je umrl v surovem rejništvu, sama pa je po letih ujetništva postala žena svojega bratranca, sina Karla X. Skupaj sta skrbela za nečakinjo in nečaka, rojenega po bratovi smrti, ki je postal simbol upanja za francoske legitimiste. Henrik V. je kasneje zapravil zadnjo možnost, da bi Burboni ponovno prevzeli prestol, potomka njegove sestre pa je postala avstrijska cesarica. Ravno Zita je med obiskom Soške fronte ukazala prenesti sarkofage iz nabrežinskega kamna na varno na Dunaj. Po prenovi porušene cerkve so bili vrnjeni v samostan. Po koncu vojne in razpadu Avstro-Ogrske je območje spet prešlo pod Kraljevino Italijo. Kmalu po drugi svetovni vojni so zavezniki določali nove meje. Prav Francozi so odločili, da je ostal samostan ločen od stare Gorice. Za njim pa je kmalu zrastla Nova ...Pretekle ter zdajšnje razmere na Kostanjevici nam predstavita pater Niko Žvokelj ter skrbnica Škrabčeve knjižnice Mirjam Brecelj. O takratnih okoliščinah, spremembah skozi čas ter današnjem odnosu do dediščine spregovorijo tudi goriški zgodovinarji: dr. Renato Podbersič, dr. Urška Strle ter kustosinja Cristina Bragaglia. Pobudo za vrnitev posmrtnih ostankov v Francijo pokomentira novinar Ervin Milharčič Hladnik. V dokumentarnem filmu ne manjkajo niti posnetki cvetenja vrtnic, interierjev goriških palač ter restavriranih fresk in štukatur. Prepričali se bomo, da je kraljeva družina po težkih življenjskih preizkušnjah našla varen pristan prav na stičišču različnih kultur, kjer lahko končno počiva v miru.

programme.title: S-Prehodi: Katja Pegan, Director of the Koper Theater, Mon. / S-prehodi: Katja Pegan, direktorica gledališča Koper, pon.
programme.desc: The Jubilee 25th season is signed by the Koper Theater this year, known for its numerous collaborations with cross -border theaters and their creators. Although he is considered the second youngest Slovenian professional theater, founded in 2001, theater life in this city has a long tradition. Historical sources from the 15th century state that the theater was already in Koper during the Venetian Republic, first in the old town, near Carpacciev, then in Grison's house on the then Belveder. A century later, a new theater building was built, and today it stands today. At the studio we host the director of the Katja Pegan Theater. / Jubilejno 25. sezono letos podpisuje Gledališče Koper, znano po svojih številnih sodelovanjih z zamejskimi gledališči in njihovimi ustvarjalci. Čeprav velja za drugo najmlajše slovensko poklicno gledališče, ustanovljeno je bilo leta 2001, ima gledališko življenje v tem mestu že dolgo tradicijo. Zgodovinski viri iz 15. stoletja navajajo, da je bilo v Kopru gledališče že v času Beneške republike, najprej v starem mestnem jedru, ob Carpaccievi hiši, nato v Grisonovi hiši na takratnem Belvederju. Stoletje pozneje so zgradili novo gledališko stavbo in na tem mestu stoji še danes. V studiu gostimo direktorico gledališča Katjo Pegan.

programme.title: Osmi and, pound. / Osmi dan, pon.
programme.desc: R: Alexander vocach ... Introducing interesting stories of a company that has in different ways marked several generations of residents of the province near Mura. Particularly valuable are the personal stories of sewing - Mura's women who were the heart of the factory. At the Slovenian Cinematheque we took a look at the retrospective of Františka Čapa: the Czech period, the selection of the initial works of this director and the screenwriter that were created in his homeland. He later worked in Germany and Yugoslavia, and in 1953 he introduced himself with an unforgettable comedy Vesna. The films of Japanese director Momoko Seto are considered to be associated with science, fiction and experimentation. In them, the author points to environmental issues in an innovative way, and the main protagonists are nature and natural processes that are often invisible to the free eye. We met with the director at the recent festival of the FEKK short film. During the summer European tour, we talked to Bill Evans, a jazz musician who is very restrained until any definition in music. -The music is good and bad,- a true saxophonist who has been able to start a successful career with Miles Davis, in which he recorded as many as twenty-six solo albums. / R: Vokač Aleksandra... Predstavljamo zanimive zgodbe podjetja, ki je na različne načine zaznamovalo več generacij prebivalcev pokrajine ob Muri. Bogat arhiv razkriva vse od začetkov prek nacionalizacije in obdobja razcveta pa do zadnjih let in praznih Murinih stavb. Še posebej dragocene so osebne zgodbe šivilj – Murinih žensk, ki so bile srce tovarne. V Slovenski kinoteki smo si ogledali retrospektivo Františka Čapa: češko obdobje, izbor začetnih del tega režiserja in scenarista, ki so nastala v njegovi domovini. Kasneje je deloval tudi v Nemčiji in Jugoslaviji, slovenskim gledalcem pa se je leta 1953 predstavil z nepozabno komedijo Vesna. Za filme japonske režiserke Momoko Seto velja, da povezujejo znanost, fantastiko in eksperimentalnost. Avtorica v njih na inovativen način opozarja na okoljsko problematiko, glavni protagonisti pa so narava in naravni procesi, ki so prostemu očesu pogosto nevidni. Z režiserko smo se srečali na nedavnem festivalu kratkega filma FeKK. Med poletno evropsko turnejo smo se pogovarjali z Billom Evansom, jazzovskim glasbenikom, ki je zelo zadržan do kakršnegakoli opredeljevanja v glasbi. -Glasba je glasba, je dobra in slaba,- pravi saksofonist, ki mu je sodelovanje z Milesom Davisom omogočilo začetek uspešno kariere, v kateri je posnel kar šestindvajset samostojnih albumov.

programme.title: World: Brian Wilson - a boy from the beach who changed the direction of popular music, Mon. / Svetovno: Brian Wilson – deček s plaže, ki je spremenil smer popularne glasbe, pon.
programme.desc: When mentioning American dreams, many people probably immediately think of carefree walking under the scorching sun. At these enjoyable frequencies, Brian Wilson also searched for the perfect pop tune. The Beach Boys group was singing everything on idyllic postcards from this US state: the sun, the sea, the high waves and the carved surfers, the lack of dressed girls, the wild racing with the convertible… and then? In the spring of 1966, the band The Beach Boys released the album PET SOUNDS and changed the direction of popular music. More specifically: In the spring of 1966, Brian Wilson released five Sounds under the brand The Beach Boys and hinted at changes in popular music. With him, rock music also became an intimate and spiritual experience, and not just a carefree dance party. He was quoted every step of the way. / Ob omembi ameriških sanj verjetno marsikdo takoj pomisli na brezskrbno pohajkovanje pod žgočim kalifornijskim soncem. Ob teh uživaških frekvencah je popolno pop melodijo sprva iskal tudi Brian Wilson. Skupina The Beach Boys je namreč opevala vse, kar si na idiličnih razglednicah iz te ameriške zvezne države predstavljamo: sonce, morje, visoke valove in na njih izklesane deskarje, pomanjkljivo oblečena dekleta, divje dirkanje s kabrioleti … In potem? Spomladi leta 1966 je skupina The Beach Boys izdala album Pet Sounds in spremenila smer popularne glasbe. Točneje: spomladi leta 1966 je Brian Wilson pod znamko The Beach Boys izdal Pet Sounds in namignil na spremembe v popularni glasbi. Z njim je rockovska glasba postala tudi intimno in duhovno doživetje, in ne več samo brezskrbna plesna zabava. Na vsakem koraku so ga citirali celo Beatli.

programme.desc: The large blue sculpture of horses Marko - Marco Cavallo is a symbol of Italian psychiatric reform led by dr. Franz Basaglie, who advocated eliminating imprisoned psychiatric hospitals, human approaches and involving patients in the community. Horse Marko, which was created in the 70s in Trieste as an expression of rebellion against institutionalization, this year went through Slovenia, from Trieste to the Museum of Madness in Trat. Franca Basaglie, ki se je zavzemal za odpravo zaprtih psihiatričnih bolnišnic, humane pristope in vključevanje pacientov v skupnost. Konj Marko, ki je nastal v 70. letih v Trstu kot izraz upora proti institucionalizaciji, se je letos odpravil po Sloveniji, od Trsta do Muzeja norosti na Tratah. Obiskal je posebne zavode in sporočila njihovih stanovalcev prenesel v Muzej norosti. programme.title: As if it were yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The Institute's time made them a heterogeneous, gamber and full of life group, but life was distributed very diverse to TV3 on the table, after the end of the creek, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Ladies' paradise / El paraíso de las señoras
programme.desc: Treaty by her boyfriend, Teresa Sen goes from village and flees to the big city. There he discovers that his uncle's shop goes through difficulty due to the opening of the paradise of the ladies. / Traïda pel seu xicot, Teresa sen va de poble i fuig a la gran ciutat. Allà descobreix que la botiga del seu oncle passa per dificultats a causa de lobertura duns grans magatzems El Paradís de les Senyores.

programme.title: The jungle: Episode 20 / La selva: Episodi 20
programme.desc: Xavier Grasset presents this afternoon magazine in which a day of the day is a relaxed way. A meeting full of knowledge and monitoring of the events of the day, but also with very deDrettement and with several collaborators. / Xavier Grasset presenta aquest magazín de tardes en el que es fa un repàs a lactualitat del dia de forma distesa. Una trobada plena de coneixement i seguiment dels fets del dia, però tambe amb molt dentreteniment i amb diversos col·laboradors.

programme.title: Atrapam si pots: Episode 175 / Atrapam si pots: Episodi 175
programme.desc: Llucià Ferrer presents this Question and Answer Contest in which six contestants compete to win the jar. The questions cover the whole field of knowledge, focus on curiosities and use word games and riddles. / Llucià Ferrer presenta aquest concurs de preguntes i respostes en què sis concursants competeixen per guanyar el pot. Les preguntes abasten tot el camp del coneixement, se centren en curiositats i fan ús de jocs de paraules i endevinalles.

programme.title: It's happening: Episode 20 / Està passant: Episodi 20
programme.desc: Satirical information presented by Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre and Queco Novell, which analyzes the keys to the lactuality of the day. The space also gives voice to experts to give their opinion on the lactuality and interview their main protagonists. / Informatiu satíric presentat per Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre i Queco Novell, que analitza les claus de lactualitat del dia. Lespai tambe dona veu a experts perquè donin la seva opinio sobre lactualitat i entrevista els seus principals protagonistes.

programme.title: Telenotícies vespre
programme.desc: Daily news that collects the most prominent events in Catalan, state and international. From Monday to Friday, Toni Cruanyes is in charge of presenting the news of the day. / Informatiu diari que recull els esdeveniments mes destacats en làmbit català, estatal i internacional. De dilluns a divendres, Toni Cruanyes es lencarregat de presentar les notícies de la jornada.

programme.title: Crushes Lestafa: I'm your daughter ... even if you don't have one / Aixafa lestafa: Soc la teva filla... encara que no en tinguis
programme.desc: A daughter you do not have asks for money from the Jurassic. / Una filla que no tens et demana diners des del Juràssic.

programme.title: 8 things to do before I die: I want to be chef / 8 coses a fer abans de morir: Vull ser xef
programme.desc: Dhumor program that Joan Pera tests in the face of different vital and social challenges. The renowned actor and comic will live various situations and experiences of life. / Programa dhumor que posa a prova en Joan Pera davant de diferents reptes vitals i socials. El reconegut actor i còmic viurà diverses situacions i experiències de la vida.

programme.title: With all of you, Joan Pera / Amb tots vostès, Joan Pera
programme.desc: Joan Pera is about to be 60 years old on stage. 60 years of passio for drama, tragedy and, above all, comedy. In the documentary with all of you, Joan Pera, the actor who has laughed in whole generations stripped in front of the cameras. / Joan Pera està a punt de complir 60 anys dalt dels escenaris. 60 anys de passio pel drama, la tragèdia i, per damunt de tot, la comèdia. Al documental Amb tots vostès, Joan Pera, l’actor que ha fet riure generacions senceres es despulla davant de les càmeres.

programme.title: Mesnit
programme.desc: Informative space with Marina Romero at the helm, which aims to be a center of debate dids and danalysis of political activity. / Espai informatiu amb Marina Romero al capdavant que te la voluntat de ser un centre de debat didees i danàlisi de lactivitat política.

programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Gaza, the aid trap by Emiliano Bos Exactly two years after the start of the war in response to the Hamas massacre of 7 October 2023, while current events record peace proposals awaiting developments, we returned to Israel this time to document the traps of the aid system, also entering the large food warehouse inside the Strip where mountains of canned goods and bags of flour lie when famine strikes in Gaza half a million Palestinians. Meanwhile, thousands of civilians have now been killed while waiting for a food package. In the Gaza Strip people are not dying only from Israeli bombs. For months, an increasing number of Palestinians have been targeted as they desperately try to grab food. The very few food distribution points have turned into gigantic militarized traps. Eyewitnesses and international organizations accuse the Israeli army of war crimes for shooting at people waiting for humanitarian assistance. A version confirmed to Falò by a former contractor of the controversial "Gaza Humanitarian Foundation" (GHF), the American organization created by the White House to which Israel has contracted much of the management of aid to Gaza, taking it away from the UN. Gaza, what is Switzerland doing? by Marzio Pescia and Damiano Dignola Street demonstrations, appeals, open letters, complaints and petitions. As in many other countries, in Switzerland too there is a civil society that is mobilizing and calling for sanctions against Israel and concrete measures to put an end to the tragedy of the civilian population in the Gaza Strip. Official Switzerland, however, doesn't want to know. There is no shortage of words of condemnation and calls for a ceasefire, but nothing more. Is this right? Hebron, locked up lives by Emiliano Bos A railing to protect oneself from attacks by settlers, the military checkpoint closed on the way back from work, the curfew that makes you live like in prison. The voices from Hebron, the historic Palestinian city where soldiers protect settlers within a now deserted urban center. And the voices from Ma'ale Adumim, where the Israeli mayor instead defines the expansion of the enormous settlement as "natural" to create continuity with Jerusalem, a project just approved after thirty years of waiting. Separate, segregated lives, often locked up, in a West Bank where history and geography are inexorably intertwined while the "two states" hypothesis seems to be increasingly blurring. Falò has collected the testimonies of those who cannot escape and feel like they are in a cage. And of those who say they are convinced that "all this will be Israel". And that Palestinians will continue to have freedom of movement. A right that today, when we travel these separate paths, appears truly trampled upon. The settlers' raids by Katie Arnold Since the beginning of the war on October 7, 2023, thousands of Palestinians have been displaced in the West Bank. In Israel, it is ethnicity, not citizenship, that determines whether your home survives. This report documents an attack by settlers, this time in a Bedouin village. There are around 200 thousand Bedouins who live in the Negev desert but, despite being citizens of Israel, the state destroys their homes. And so, in some areas Israeli settlements are built on top of the rubble of Bedouin homes, whose inhabitants, having nowhere else to live, have to start building again. / Gaza, la trappola degli aiuti di Emiliano Bos A due anni esatti dall’inizio della guerra in risposta al massacro di Hamas del 7 ottobre 2023, mentre l’attualità registra proposte di pace in attesa di sviluppi, siamo tornati in Israele questa volta per documentare le trappole del sistema degli aiuti, entrando anche nel grande deposito alimentare dentro la Striscia dove giacciono montagne di scatolame e sacchi di farina quando a Gaza la carestia colpisce mezzo milione di palestinesi. Intanto sono ormai migliaia i civili uccisi in attesa di un pacco alimentare. Nella Striscia di Gaza non si muore solo per le bombe israeliane. Da mesi un numero crescente di palestinesi viene colpito mentre cerca disperatamente di accaparrarsi del cibo. I pochissimi punti di distribuzione alimentare si sono trasformati in gigantesche trappole militarizzate. Testimoni oculari e organizzazioni internazionali accusano l’esercito israeliano di crimini di guerra perche spara contro la gente in attesa di assistenza umanitaria. Una versione confermata a Falò da un ex contractor della discussa “Gaza Humanitarian Foundation” (GHF), l’organizzazione americana voluta dalla Casa Bianca a cui Israele ha appaltato gran parte della gestione degli aiuti a Gaza sottraendola all’ONU. Gaza, cosa fa la Svizzera? di Marzio Pescia e Damiano Dignola Manifestazioni di piazza, appelli, lettere aperte, denunce e petizioni. Come in molti altri Paesi, anche in Svizzera c’è una società civile che si mobilita e chiede sanzioni contro Israele e misure concrete per porre fine alla tragedia della popolazione civile nella Striscia di Gaza. La Svizzera ufficiale però non vuole saperne. Le parole di condanna e gli inviti ad un cessate il fuoco non mancano, ma niente di più. È giusto così?Hebron, vite rinchiuse di Emiliano Bos Un’inferriata per proteggersi dagli attacchi dei coloni, il check-point militare chiuso tornando dal lavoro, il coprifuoco che ti fa vivere come in prigione. Le voci da Hebron, la storica città palestinese dove i soldati proteggono i coloni all’interno di un centro urbano ormai deserto. E le voci da Ma’ale Adumim, dove invece il sindaco israeliano definisce “naturale” l’espansione dell’enorme insediamento fino a creare continuità con Gerusalemme, un progetto appena approvato dopo trent’anni di attesa. Vite separate, segregate, spesso rinchiuse, in una Cisgiordania dove storia e geografia s’intrecciano inesorabilmente mentre sembra sfumare sempre più l’ipotesi dei “due Stati”. Falò ha raccolto le testimonianze di chi non può scappare e si sente in una gabbia. E di chi si dice convinto che “tutto questo sarà Israele”. E che i palestinesi continueranno ad avere una libertà di movimento. Un diritto che oggi, quando si percorrono queste strade separate, appare davvero calpestato. Le razzie dei coloni di Katie Arnold Dall’inizio della guerra del 7 ottobre 2023, in Cisgiordania migliaia di palestinesi sono stati sfollati. In Israele, è l’etnia, non la cittadinanza, che determina se la tua casa sopravvive. Questo reportage documenta un attacco di coloni, questa volta in un villaggio beduino. Sono circa 200mila i beduini che vivono nel deserto del Negev ma, nonostante siano cittadini di Israele, lo Stato distrugge le loro case. E così, in alcune zone gli insediamenti israeliani vengono costruiti sopra le macerie delle case beduine, i cui abitanti, non avendo un altro posto dove vivere, devono ricominciare a costruire.

programme.desc: Paolo Macchiarini is a surgeon known for his innovative techniques. While Benita discovers the extent to which Paolo is willing to protect his secrets, a group of former colleagues question everything about him. / Paolo Macchiarini è un chirurgo noto per le sue tecniche innovative. programme.title: Paganini
programme.desc: "Magic Larte is the one that gives us back the wonderful to the heart of everyday life": thus the writer Andre Breton expressed himself and - thanking the father of surrealism for the quote and the starting point - it is precisely to the size of the magic that the episode of Paganini on Sunday 5 October is aimed, from 10.30 on RSI LA1. The "Livermore Sciò" - starring Davide Livermore, now acclaimed opera director - was one of the most fun and witty serial productions in the RSI music sector. In the episodium entitled "Magic Music", they alternated, next to the Holy House, Locchestra of the Teatro Regio di Torino directed by Carlo Boccadoro, a group of Madrigalists, the musicians Oliviero Giovannoni and Diego Fasolis. Sorcellerie - literally: witchcraft - it is instead a recent French show that features the duo of Pianisti Jatekok (with works by Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint -Saëns and Paul Dukas) and two mimi/magicians engaged in a suggestive Dombre theater. Finally, Fantasymphony is a limmaginific symphonic program of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra directed by Christian Schumann who - with the subtitle "A concert of magic and fire" - offers a selection of film songs, series and video games that deal with the theme of magic and fantastic. Some examples? The soundtrack of Harry Potter written by John Williams, Lorne Balfe's music for the BBC/HBO His Dark Materials series - These dark subjects, the song Breath of Life of Florence and the Machine for the Biancaneve and the Hunter film, the famous theme of Ramin Djawadi for Game of Thrones or the Music Suite from the series from the series Netflix The Witcher written by Sonya Belousova together with Ticinese Giona Ostinelli. - Livermore Sciò - Magic Music - Sorcelleries for two piano - Fantasymphony - A concert of magic and fire / "Larte magica è quella che ci restituisce il meraviglioso al cuore della vita quotidiana": così si esprimeva lo scrittore Andre Breton e - ringraziando il padre del surrealismo per la citazione e lo spunto - è proprio alla dimensione del magico che si rivolge la puntata di Paganini di domenica 5 ottobre, dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1. Il "Livermore Sciò" - con protagonista Davide Livermore, oggi acclamato regista operistico - è stata una delle produzioni seriali più divertenti e argute del settore musicale RSI. Nellepisodio intitolato "Musica magica" si alternavano, accanto allistrionico padrone di casa, lOrchestra del Teatro Regio di Torino diretta da Carlo Boccadoro, un gruppo di madrigalisti, i musicisti Oliviero Giovannoni e Diego Fasolis. Sorcellerie - letteralmente: stregoneria - è invece un recente spettacolo francese che vede protagonisti il duo di pianiste Jatekok (con opere di Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint-Saëns e Paul Dukas) e due mimi/maghi impegnati in un suggestivo teatro dombre. Fantasymphony è infine limmaginifico programma sinfonico della Danish National Symphony Orchestra diretta da Christian Schumann che - con il sottotitolo «un concerto di magia e fuoco» - propone una selezione di brani da film, serie e videogiochi che affrontano il tema del magico e del fantastico. Alcuni esempi? La colonna sonora di Harry Potter scritta da John Williams, le musiche di Lorne Balfe per la serie BBC/HBO His Dark Materials - Queste oscure materie, il brano Breath of Life di Florence and the Machine per il film Biancaneve e il cacciatore, il celebre tema di Ramin Djawadi per Game of Thrones o ancora la Suite musicale dalla serie Netflix The Witcher scritta da Sonya Belousova assieme al ticinese Giona Ostinelli. - Livermore Sciò - Musica magica - Sorcellerie per due pianoforti - Fantasymphony - Un concerto di magia e fuoco

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. He aired weekly on the CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV-Movie, until 2003 (as a wagon read with murder, the ballad of the lost boy and appointment with death). Angela Lansbury played the role of executive producer of the show in his last seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspective writer of yellow, who often finds himself dealing with mysterious murders, for whom he always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: The Titanic transatlantic, considered the most luxurious cruise steamer ever made, Salpa da Da da dallinghilterra on April 10, 1912 with over 1500 passengers on board for his inaugural journey. Travelers are placed in three classes, reflection of social differences. Among the passengers there is also the seventeen year old Rose Dewitt Bukater who embarks on the Titanic in Southmpton together with his mother Ruth and boyfriend Cal Hockley, an arrogant man full of prejudices. When Rose, desperate allide of having to marry a man who does not love, tries suicide by climbing over the parapet of the ship's stern, is dissuaded by Jack Dawson, a young and poor artist who won the Titanic ticket playing poker. Cal then gives Rose an engagement ring with a blue diamond, "The heart of the Ocean". In the meantime, between Rose and Jack, a special bond is created and plan to escape together. But heard with an iceberg crushes their dough dreams. / Il transatlantico Titanic, considerato il piu lussuoso piroscafo da crociera mai realizzato, salpa dallInghilterra il 10 aprile 1912 con oltre 1500 passeggeri a bordo per il suo viaggio inaugurale. I viaggiatori sono collocati in tre classi, riflesso delle differenze sociali. Tra i passeggeri ce anche la diciassettenne Rose DeWitt Bukater che si imbarca sul Titanic a Southampton assieme alla madre Ruth e al fidanzato Cal Hockley, un uomo arrogante e pieno di pregiudizi. Quando Rose, disperata allidea di dover sposare un uomo che non ama, tenta il suicidio scavalcando il parapetto della poppa della nave, viene dissuasa da Jack Dawson, un giovane e povero artista che ha vinto il biglietto per il Titanic giocando a poker. Cal regala poi a Rose un anello di fidanzamento con un diamante blu, "il Cuore dellOceano". Nel frattempo tra Rose e Jack si e creato un legame speciale e progettano di fuggire insieme. Ma limpatto con un iceberg frantumera i loro sogni damore.

programme.desc: In the heart of the Borneo, every day a small community of volunteers goes to a rehabilitation center for orphaned or wounded orangos, where they help them develop the fundamental skills to return to live in freedom in the jungle. / Nel cuore del Borneo, ogni giorno allalba una piccola comunità di volontari si reca in un centro di riabilitazione per oranghi orfani o feriti, dove li aiutano a sviluppare le abilità fondamentali per tornare a vivere in libertà nella giungla.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.sub-title: Agriculture of the future - Razzia on the Atlantic / L’agricoltura del futuro - Razzia sull’Atlantico
programme.desc: Thousands of civilians killed while waiting for a food parcel. In the Gaza Strip people are not dying only from Israeli bombs. For months now, an increasing number of Palestinians have been targeted as they desperately try to grab food for their families. The very few food distribution points have turned into gigantic militarized traps. Exactly two years after the start of the war in response to the Hamas massacre of 7 October 2023, Falò returns to Israel again this time to document the traps of the food aid system, amidst the complaints of international organizations and Israel which denies it. According to the Swiss Philippe Lazzarini, general commissioner of UNRWA, the UN agency for aiding Palestinian refugees: "Gaza is becoming the cemetery of international humanitarian law." / Migliaia di civili uccisi in attesa di un pacco alimentare. Nella Striscia di Gaza non si muore solo per le bombe israeliane. Da mesi ormai un numero crescente di palestinesi viene colpito mentre cerca disperatamente di accaparrarsi del cibo per la propria famiglia. I pochissimi punti di distribuzione alimentare si sono trasformati in gigantesche trappole militarizzate. A due anni esatti dallinizio della guerra in risposta al massacro di Hamas del 7 ottobre 2023, Falò torna di nuovo in Israele questa volta per documentare le trappole del sistema degli aiuti alimentari, tra le denunce delle organizzazioni internazionali e Israele che nega. Secondo lo svizzero Philippe Lazzarini, commissario generale dellUNRWA, lAgenzia ONU per il soccorso ai profughi palestinesi: "Gaza sta diventando il cimitero del diritto umanitario internazionale."

programme.title: Docteur Godard, lhomme qui voulait tout quitter
programme.sub-title: The man who wanted to make a new life / Luomo che voleva rifarsi una nuova vita
programme.desc: 1999, Britain, France. A wonderful day of September, the sun shines and the sea is calm. The case begins with the discovery of an inflatable boat off the coast, belongs to a sailing ship hired in Saint-Malo. In the rubber boat there are a sailor of ceet canvas and a check booklet. The sailing ship had been hired by a doctor with a study in Caen who then left with his two children without leaving a trace. The authorities seek the boat and the family missing everywhere, in vain. In the van and in the doctor's inhabitants, the investigators find traces of blood. The blood of Dr. Godard's wife. It is the beginning of a judicial case that will last over twelve years. The disappearance is wrapped in mystery, various clues are found in the sea in an inexplicable way. Is it a suicide masked by shipwreck? / 1999, Bretagna, Francia. Una meravigliosa giornata di settembre, splende il sole e il mare è calmo. Il caso inizia con la scoperta di un gommone al largo della costa, appartiene a un veliero noleggiato a Saint-Malo. Nel gommone ci sono una giacca da marinaio di tela cerata e un libretto degli assegni. Il veliero era stato noleggiato da un medico con studio a Caen che poi è partito con i suoi due bambini senza lasciare traccia. Le autorità cercano ovunque la barca e la famiglia scomparsa, invano. Nel furgone e nellabitazione del dottore gli inquirenti trovano tracce di sangue. Il sangue della moglie del dottor Godard. È linizio di un caso giudiziario che durerà oltre dodici anni. La scomparsa è avvolta nel mistero, vari indizi vengono ritrovati in mare in maniera inspiegabile. Si tratta di un suicidio mascherato da naufragio?

programme.title: Docteur Godard, lhomme qui voulait tout quitter
programme.sub-title: The man who wanted to make a new life / Luomo che voleva rifarsi una nuova vita
programme.desc: The second episode opens with a turning point in the investigation, the investigators receive an anonymous letter. According to Mysterious Linformer, Dr. Godard and his two children are alive and are found on the Manisola di Man, in the Mari Dirlanda. The French gendarmes go on the spot and collect the testimonies of various people who confirm the presence of the fugitive. A director Dalbergo claims to have seen him in the company of a blonde woman. But the track is a dead end. According to Jean-Paul Aubry, of the Research section of the Rennes Gendarmerie, to find the reason for the escape you have to dig into the doctor's life and past. The investigations reveal the character complexity of Dr. Godard, a shady man with multiple and surprising facets, proponent of alternative medicine, passionate about esotericism and very close to a sect that may have helped him to stage his disappearance. / Il secondo episodio si apre con una svolta nellinchiesta, gli inquirenti ricevono una lettera anonima. Secondo linformatore misterioso il dottor Godard e i suoi due bambini sono vivi e si trovano sullIsola di Man, nel Mar dIrlanda. I gendarmi francesi vanno sul posto e raccolgono le testimonianze di varie persone che confermano la presenza del fuggitivo. Un direttore dalbergo afferma di averlo visto in compagnia di una donna bionda. Ma la pista è un vicolo cieco. Secondo Jean-Paul Aubry, della sezione ricerche della gendarmeria di Rennes, per trovare il motivo della fuga bisogna scavare nella vita e nel passato del dottore. Le indagini svelano la complessità caratteriale del dottor Godard, un uomo ombroso dalle molteplici e sorprendenti sfaccettature, fautore della medicina alternativa, appassionato di esoterismo e molto vicino a una setta che potrebbe averlo aiutato nel mettere in scena la sua scomparsa.

programme.title: A bon entendeur
programme.sub-title: My apple is beautiful / Elle est belle ma pomme
programme.desc: It is perhaps the Swiss’ favorite fruit: the apple. Green, red, sweet, tangy, to chew or to cook, we enjoy it all year round. Local production is important, but also very demanding, whether organic or integrated. Farmers must constantly combat pests and fungi to produce attractive and beautiful fruits. “A word to the wise” wanted to know what treatments are necessary to obtain an organic apple or a conventional apple. Report and comparison at two producers, in Bramois (VS) and Lully (GE), Tuesday at 8:10 p.m. on RTS1. / C’est peut-etre le fruit prefere des Suisses : la pomme. Verte, rouge, sucree, acidulee, à croquer ou à cuire, on la deguste tout au long de l’annee. La production locale est importante, mais egalement très exigeante, qu’elle soit biologique ou integree. Les agriculteurs doivent constamment lutter contre les ravageurs et les champignons pour produire des fruits attrayants et beaux. « À bon entendeur » a voulu savoir quels traitements sont necessaires pour obtenir une pomme bio ou une pomme conventionnelle. Reportage et comparaison chez deux producteurs, à Bramois (VS) et à Lully (GE), mardi à 20h10 sur RTS1.

But she could hide her true intentions... / Suite au decès de sa femme, Liam vit seul avec sa fille, Corinne. Du jour au lendemain, il apprend qu’elle souffre d’une maladie respiratoire. Trop occupe, il doit faire appel à une infirmière à domicile. Liam et sa fille font ainsi la connaissance de Victoria. A première vue, cette femme souriante et attentionnee semble etre l’infirmière ideale pour Corinne. Mais elle pourrait cacher ses veritables intentions...

programme.title: Temps present
programme.sub-title: Harassment, online terror / Harcèlement, la terreur en ligne
programme.desc: It is a well-hidden reality: many people, especially women, are today targeted by strangers who harass and threaten them on social networks. Women who the police sometimes dissuade from filing a complaint because everything happens online, in a virtual world, yet their fear is very real. And harassment is not yet considered an offense in Switzerland; it therefore does not appear in Swiss crime statistics. Is this phenomenon underestimated? Temps Present went to meet victims and a cyberstalker. A report by Cedric Louis and Elisabeth Logean. / C’est une realite bien cachee : de nombreuses personnes, surtout des femmes, sont aujourd’hui visees par des inconnus qui les harcèlent et les menacent sur les reseaux sociaux. Des femmes que la police dissuade parfois de porter plainte car tout se passe en ligne, dans un monde virtuel, pourtant leur peur est bien reelle. Et le harcèlement n’est pas encore considere comme une infraction en Suisse ; il n’apparait donc pas dans les statistiques de la criminalite suisse. Ce phenomène est-il sous-estime ? Temps Present est alle à la rencontre de victimes et d’un cyberharceleur.Un reportage de Cedric Louis et Elisabeth Logean.

programme.title: 9-1-1: Lone Star
programme.desc: TK receives a surprise visit from his stepfather Enzo (Henry Ian Cusick) and his younger half-brother Jonah for his 30th birthday. Full of resentment, Owen physically attacks Enzo. Tommy is determined to overcome her latest crisis. Wyatt tries to dissuade a suicidal caller and 126 must perform dangerous field surgery to save a man impaled on a tree. / TK reçoit la visite surprise de son beau-père Enzo (Henry Ian Cusick) et de son jeune demi-frère Jonah pour son 30e anniversaire. Plein de ressentiment, Owen sen prend physiquement à Enzo. Tommy est determinee à surmonter sa dernière crise. Wyatt tente de dissuader un appelant suicidaire et le 126 doit effectuer une operation chirurgicale dangereuse sur le terrain pour sauver un homme empale sur un arbre.

programme.title: Ramdam
programme.sub-title: Poutze stars / Les stars de la poutze
programme.desc: We are going to question the figure of the housewife... The “housewife” of the time continues to make waves, in short, we love her or we hate her. She even became political. This debate on the role of women agitates and inspires French-speaking artists today, we went to meet them... / On va questionner la figure de la femme au foyer... La « menagère » de l’epoque continue de faire des vagues, bref, on l’aime ou on la deteste. Elle est meme devenue politique. Ce debat sur le rôle des femmes agite et inspire les artistes romands d’aujourd’hui, on est alles les rencontrer...

programme.title: Documentaire
programme.desc: What is the reality of life for women in Switzerland today? A collective of renowned directors answers this question by following six protagonists. There is Valeria, a retiree who falls in love again, Sela, an opera singer who comes up against gender stereotypes, or Delphine, a student who explores her non-binary identity. / Quelle est la realite de la vie des femmes en Suisse aujourd’hui? Un collectif de realisatrices de renommee repond à cette question en suivant six protagonistes. Il y a Valeria, retraitee qui tombe à nouveau amoureuse, Sela, chanteuse d’opera qui se heurte aux stereotypes du genre ou encore Delphine, etudiante qui explore son identite non binaire.

programme.title: Histoire vivante
programme.sub-title: Israel and the Palestinians / Israël et les Palestiniens
programme.desc: Hamas uses its tunnels to penetrate Israel, which responds with a ground invasion and the construction of an underground wall. Donald Trump, in his first term, is trying to make peace with several Arab countries, and Israel hopes to be able to contain Hamas in Gaza by keeping it on financial support from Qatar, then comes the attack of October 7, 2023. / Le Hamas utilise ses tunnels pour penetrer en Israël qui riposte par une invasion terrestre et la construction d’un mur souterrain. Donald Trump, dans son premier mandat, tente de faire la paix avec plusieurs pays arabes, et Israël espère pouvoir contenir le Hamas à Gaza en le maintenant sous perfusion financière par le Qatar, puis advient l’attaque du 7 octobre 2023.

programme.title: Histoire vivante
programme.desc: In Israel, everyone knows the "blue boxes" which were used in the 1950s to raise funds for the purchase of land in Palestine. Joseph Weitz, the director's great-grandfather, is famous for having planted millions of trees there, less for having orchestrated the expropriation of Palestinian land. Reading his diaries reveals a disturbing truth. / En Israël, tout le monde connaît les "boîtes bleues" qui ont servi dans les annees 50 à collecter des fonds pour l’achat de terres en Palestine. Joseph Weitz, l’arrière-grand-père de la realisatrice, est celèbre pour y avoir plante des millions d’arbres, moins pour avoir orchestre l’expropriation des terres palestiniennes. La lecture de ses journaux intimes revèle une verite derangeante.

programme.title: A bon entendeur
programme.sub-title: Medicaments with unit: Economy or illusion? / Medicaments à l’unite : economie ou illusion ?
programme.desc: The costs of the health explode in Switzerland, our insurance premiums too. Each year, more than 600 million francs in drugs leave in the trash. Attachment often linked to packaging ill -adapted to the treatments prescribed by the doctors. To change the situation, some pharmacists test the distribution of pills to the unit. Is it a real solution to reduce the costs of the health or the powder to the eyes? Another track to avoid this waste would be to have validity dates of longer drugs. Possible or not possible? The point in this emission. / Les coûts de la sante explosent en Suisse, nos primes d’assurance aussi. Chaque annee, plus de 600 millions de francs de medicaments partent à la poubelle. Du gaspillage souvent lie à des emballages mal adaptes aux traitements prescrits par les medecins. Pour changer la donne, certains pharmaciens testent la distribution des pilules à l’unite. Est-ce une vraie solution pour reduire les coûts de la sante ou de la poudre aux yeux ? Une autre piste pour eviter ce gaspillage serait d’avoir des dates de validite des medicaments plus longues. Possible ou pas possible ? Le point dans cette emission.

programme.title: Trains like no other / Des trains pas comme les autres
programme.desc: In this episode, Philippe Gougler travels through Northern Norway. An astonishing journey which takes him to the island of Spitsbergen where railway history is mainly linked to coal mining. On this lost island just 1,200 km from the North Pole, he will discover the northernmost train in the world, meet the only inhabitant of a ghost town then accompany a Pastor, armed with a rifle to protect herself from bears, to attend an open-air mass. Northern Norway is full of sumptuous landscapes. Philippe will travel by train to the grandiose scenery of the Lofoten Islands before meeting the owner of a train, unlike any other, perched on a bridge, which welcomes fishermen from all over the country to fish for the most beautiful salmon. An exciting journey during which Philippe Gougler will test his ability not to stay awake, because in June, in these latitudes, the sun never sets... / Dans cet episode, Philippe Gougler parcourt la Norvège du Nord. Un voyage etonnant qui le mène sur l’île du Spitzberg où l’histoire ferroviaire est principalement liee à l’exploitation du charbon. Sur cette île perdue à seulement 1200 km du pôle Nord, il va decouvrir le train le plus au nord du monde, rencontrer le seul habitant d’une ville fantôme puis accompagner une Pasteure, armee d’un fusil pour se proteger des ours, pour assister à une messe en plein air. La Norvège du Nord regorge de paysages somptueux. Philippe va rejoindre en train les decors grandioses des îles Lofoten avant de retrouver le proprietaire d’un train, pas comme les autres, perche sur un pont, qui accueille des pecheurs venus de tout le pays pour y pecher les plus beaux saumons. Un periple passionnant pendant lequel Philippe Gougler va tester sa capacite à ne pas rester eveille, car au mois de juin, sous ces latitudes, le soleil ne se couche jamais…
